tieu_de: Introduction
tom_tat: Author Do Chan Duc's opening statement about his journey to meet Ms. Hoa and the Mission of the Dead group, as well as his wish to share true cause and effect stories so that people can learn to be afraid and turn to goodness.
noi_dung:
{align:center|**INTRODUCTION**}

My name is Do Chan Duc, 29 years old this year - a normal person like everyone else, but blessed with the good fortune to be on the path of learning Buddhism and reflecting on myself. Amidst a life filled with clamor, worldly conflict,, gossip and ignorance, I choose to slow down, listen and contemplate Cause and Effect, to understand why people suffer, why injustices pile up, and why there are fates that, even after leaving the body, cannot find deliverance. On May 16, 2025, I created a social media channel with a simple name: "Duc is Learning Buddhism". Not to be famous, not to debate right and wrong, not to show off knowledge. My initial wish was simply to share the Buddha Dharma, retelling true stories of Cause and Effect, and the Spiritual Realm, so that readers may awaken to reverent awe before karma, pause before committing unwholesome deeds, and repent and turn back while time remains. Then fate comes - gently but deeply. I know an anonymous woman, whom I still call by her familiar name, Sister Hoa.

She does not appear in public, does not seek fame or recognition. But it was she who opened my eyes to a world that mortals rarely dare to look directly at: "The world of ghosts is still full of attachments."
Through her story, I learned about a group carrying the "Mission of Destruction" - silent, quiet, without trumpets or drums. The group consists of 4 members: 3 men and 1 woman. The three men are Dharma Masters with deep roots in spirituality, knowledgeable in many methods: from binding spirits, opening light, capturing seals - seals, recording information, communicating with superiors, to giving oral information, leading the dead to the temple to study, even painting the appearance that has faded due to resentment and time. Ms. Hoa - the only woman in the group - is the one who directly communicates, explains, listens and unties each knot in the spirit's consciousness. During the day, they live like many other normal people in society: truck drivers, business people, office workers... No one knows, no one knows.

But when night falls, when the earthly world falls asleep, they gather according to the instructions of a master whom they honor as the Mountain Immortal, to go to places with heavy yin energy - where the spirits reside - to enlighten them, transcend them and take them back to the temple. Who is the Mountain Immortal? According to Ms. Hoa, the Mountain Immortal is a spiritual practitioner who has attained supernatural powers and is currently in retreat in That Son mountain range. He has a thin figure, white beard and hair, hair pulled back, holding a dragon-headed stick in his hand - when a predestined person approaches, that stick will glow. Listening to previous Dharma Masters who came to practice, the First One was originally in the 8th heaven, with a great vow to save sentient beings in the Saha world, and borrowed his mortal body to practice that vow for nearly 100 years. In a cave in the middle of That Son mountain and forest, the Mountain Immortal sat on the Dinh Tam Boat. It is not a boat of wood or iron, but a realm of practice - where He knows which souls have met their destiny and which souls still have to wait.

Some people have to wait hundreds of years, even thousands of years, to be blessed enough to be called by name. Returning to the temple does not mean liberation. Going to the temple is to let go of attachments, to accept karma or to accept reincarnation, to continue the cycle of birth and death. But once you have a deep connection with the the Buddha Dharma, whether reincarnated as a human or an animal, that seed of practice remains, waiting to bear fruit in future lives. “MISSION OF DEPENDENCE” is the beginning of a long journey. Each story is a piece of the puzzle, each soul is a destiny. No one is the same, no suffering is the same. I am just the narrator, standing in the position of Ms. Hoa, so that readers can feel like they are accompanying them on journeys between Yin and Yang. The writing is simple, not flowery, not embellished, because the truth of spirituality is already chilling enough. This book was not created for business purposes, but to convey information from the Underworld to people on earth.

Please don't think "Death is the end", because there are mistakes, once realized there is no chance to fix them. During the compilation process, I was fortunate to connect with an enthusiastic young friend - Lam Vang Nhien, a third-year student at FPT Can Tho University, currently living in Bac Lieu. All illustrations in the book are done by you, as a magical arrangement by your superiors. I believe: "Just because you haven't seen, heard, or known, doesn't mean it doesn't exist." These words are only for those blessed enough to read. Whoever has the heart to convey and share this book with others is sowing a great merit, helping people to fear Karma and avoid evil and move towards good. Believe and meditate. Don't believe it - please watch it as an entertaining story. But once you read it…Please ask yourself again.

tieu_de: Story 1: Ten Years of Torment in the Hell of Excrement
tom_tat: People often say: "Death is the end." But only when I stepped on the path to salvation, did I understand that death is not the end, but only a door opening to a new realm...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 1: TEN YEARS OF TORMENT IN THE HELL OF EXCREMENT**}

People often say: "Death is the end." But only when I stepped on the path of spirit deliverance, did I understand that death is not the end, but only a door opening to another realm - where Cause and Effect are judged without missing anything. There are souls who, because living causes too much karma, cannot attain liberation after leaving their physical body. They are dragged down to the depths of hell, where there is no light, no compassion, only pain and regret that lasts for years and lives. 
Today, thanks to the Mountain Immortal's instructions, our group had the opportunity to meet a female spirit. Her story made everyone present shiver and chill down their spines. It is the story of a woman who had to consume filth for ten years in hell, to pay for the sins she committed while she was alive.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-01-image-001-29afc537b64f.webp)

Meeting with the female spirit Nguyen Thi Lanh, following the Mountain Immortal's instructions, we found a deserted area of ​​land in the suburbs, where the atmosphere was heavy, weeds grew luxuriantly, and the wind blew through and sounded like wailing. After buying offerings, burning incense and praying, we waited. Not long after, the female spirit appeared.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-01-image-002-e9616232a652.webp)

She gave her name as Nguyen Thi Lanh, from An Giang. Her figure is thin, her face is haggard, her eyes are always lowered, not daring to look straight. The foul smell still lingers around the soul, even though it has left hell for a while. 
When revealed, at first he was still cautious and afraid. But after listening to my gentle guidance, she began to recount her life full of mistakes - A life of theft in the name of filial piety. When she was alive, Ms. Lanh did not have a stable career. My parents are old and weak, they are constantly sick, and their medical bills are increasing day by day. No husband, no children, her parents are her only support. Initially, she worked as a hired laborer, doing all kinds of jobs but her income was unstable. When she had no other choice, she entered the path of theft. She said, every time she attacks, she will watch her prey very carefully. When she identified people with money and jewelry, she tried to approach them, anesthetized them to make them unconscious, and then took all their property.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-01-image-003-6143a3c39b4c.webp)

There were successful deals, the amount of money was enough for her and her parents to live for two to three months. When she ran out of money, she continued practicing. She did not feel that she was evil, because at that time she had only one thought in her mind: "As long as my parents can live well." Every time she stole money, she bought the most expensive things to give to her parents. But that filial piety is built on the pain of others. Time passed, her parents passed away one after another. But instead of stopping, she continued stealing to support herself, because she was used to that lifestyle. The final mission and untimely death "We travel at night, someday we meet ghosts."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-01-image-004-65379daedc3d.webp)

During a break into a rich family, she discovered that there was a cabinet full of gold bars in the house. If she gets that gold, she can live comfortably for the rest of her life. But while she was sneaking away, she tripped over the edge of the door, making a loud noise. The homeowner discovered. She was arrested again. The most horrifying thing is that they did not notify the authorities. That family locked her up and tortured her like in the Middle Ages. She was beaten and tortured in every way to satisfy her anger. The body was bruised and internal organs were seriously damaged. When they saw that she was barely alive, they threw her out onto the street. She dragged herself home in a dying state.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-01-image-005-ac604c4f99f2.webp)

13 days later, she vomited blood and died, in a cold house, no one knew. The corpse decomposed and the stench was strong. Neighbors broke open the door and discovered the rotting body.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-01-image-006-bc28f003256d.webp)

People wrapped her body and buried it poorly. When the soul left the body, two demons sent Buffalo Head and Horse Face to appear, tied her tightly and dragged her straight to the Underworld. Here, she was taken to the Reflection Mirror.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-01-image-007-b561eb63de5b.webp)

Each scene appeared clearly: During the theft, she overdosed, causing three people to die unjustly. At first, she screamed, refusing to admit guilt: "I didn't kill anyone!" But the Mirror doesn't lie. When she clearly saw that three people's lives had died because of her, she collapsed and could no longer argue. The God of Hell looked at the book of life and death and said: "You should have been sent to the 16th level of prison. But considering that you stole to support your elderly parents and were filial - although in the wrong way - I reduced you by one level. Now I punish you to go to the 15th level of prison to repent."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-01-image-008-6b53d8096349.webp)

The 15th level of prison is a dark, smelly place, with muddy ground, slimy mud mixed with blood and dirt. The air was thick with a foul smell that made the soul want to vomit. Here, those who, while living, drugged others, causing others to fall unconscious and lose their lives, will be punished by eating the dirtiest things humans eat. That's Cit.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-01-image-009-18962aec698c.webp)

Every day, the devil dumps shit into piles and forces the dead to eat. If you can't eat in time, the ghost will use a sharp iron stick to stab straight into your throat, forcing you to swallow it all. Ms. Lanh must endure this punishment for 10 years, calculated according to earthly time. Every time I mention this, I tremble and don't dare to continue. Just remembering it made her soul cringe in fear.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-01-image-010-5535884c126e.webp)

After that punishment, she had to endure many other tortures, a total of 100 years of hell. In July 2025, when the gate of Mon Quan opened, she followed the stream of souls and was allowed to go to earth. During her testimony, she choked up and told us: "It's been a hundred years... now I know what rice smells like. It feels strange when I eat it... I don't dare eat much." Those words made the group quiet.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-01-image-011-33d03de7c722.webp)

After many hours of explanation, Nguyen Thi Lanh finally agreed to let go and follow us to the temple to study, repent and transform her karma. Her story is a chilling wake-up call for the living. Doing evil for any reason, even in the name of filial piety, will not be missed by Cause and Effect. Hell has no favoritism. As long as you sow wrong causes, you will surely reap painful consequences. Please remember: One minute of greed - in exchange for hundreds of years of suffering. While you're still alive, you're still breathing, you still have a chance... Please stop!

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of Ten Years of Torment in the Hell of Excrement, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 2: The Retribution of Skinning Live Frogs
tom_tat: In this Saha world, there is suffering that can be seen with the naked eye, but there is also suffering that only when people go through birth and death can they fully understand its cause. Some people are born...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 2: THE RETRIBUTION OF SKINNING LIVE FROGS**}

In this Saha world, there is suffering that can be seen with the naked eye, but there is also suffering that only when people go through birth and death can they fully understand its cause. Some people are born poor, suffer from constant illness, and are abandoned by people. They blame fate, blame God for being unfair. But few people know that all pain in this life is the result of karma sown in previous lives. 
On the path of spirit deliverance, we met many souls carrying deep suffering. But Ms. Le Thi Hoi's story is one of those stories that makes listeners shudder, because what she endured in hell is so similar to what she did to other sentient beings when she was alive in her previous life.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-012-26ba52562494.webp)

Ms. Le Thi Hoi is a woman suffering from severe itchy scabies. Her skin was always ulcerated, peeling, blood and pus oozed out, and a fishy smell followed her body. Even though she tried to hide it, people's alienated and fearful eyes still surrounded her every day.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-013-8a13a81ee87e.webp)

No one wants to come close. Even her immediate relatives gradually abandoned her. In that extreme loneliness, she decided to take refuge in Buddha and go to the temple to ask for merit. The monks sympathized with her and allowed her to stay, giving her the heaviest tasks: cleaning the temple grounds, carrying water, chopping firewood, cooking rice... She worked quietly, not complaining about her fate, just hoping to live peacefully day by day.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-014-e7c38693fbb1.webp)

For 7 years, she stuck with the pagoda, considering this place as the final home of her life.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-015-8872c66b529a.webp)

One day, Ms. Hoi carried a pair of buckets to the stream to get water for the monks. Here, she encountered a couple fishing. With Buddha's thoughts deeply ingrained in her heart, she gently advised them: "Doing so is creating killing karma, and it will be difficult to avoid retribution in the future." The advice originally came from a good heart, but it touched the man's anger. The two sides exchanged words, the conflict became more and more tense. In a fit of uncontrolled anger, the man picked up a fork and stabbed Ms. Hoi straight in the heart. She collapsed, dead on the spot.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-016-ada03d2b046f.webp)

Frightened by the murder, the couple immediately fled, leaving her body by the cold stream. It wasn't until the monks waited forever and didn't see her carrying water that they went looking for her. But I only saw the bucket of water left behind, and there was no sign of her. A few days later, her body surfaced and drifted near the temple. The body was swollen and purple. The monks heartbrokenly picked up her body, took care of the funeral arrangements, and then buried her.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-017-60b637472993.webp)

When she died, Ms. Hoi's soul was led to the underworld. But because her positive years had not yet expired, she was not fully tried, but was pushed back into the positive world, becoming a ghost in the same stream where she died. Hungry, thirsty, cold, she wandered for a long time. At night, she watched the living pass by, but no one saw her.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-018-e11a114a2733.webp)

Until the fate was ripe, she was taken to the underworld to reflect on her old karma. In the underworld, she bathed in Giai Oan stream and then stood before the Mirror of Reflection. Each image appears clearly. In her previous life, she was a poor woman with no education. To make a living, she worked as a frog skinner for purchasing warehouses. With nearly 20 years in the profession, she skins frogs quickly, accurately and ruthlessly. She recounted each movement as if it were imprinted in her soul:
– Cut off the frog's head
– Cut off the feet
– Use scissors to make a cut along the spine 
– Then peel the skin to both sides, quickly and decisively

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-019-6132cd545080.webp)

Every day hundreds of frogs die at her hands. She doesn't think it's a crime. She just thought it was a piece of food. Until one day, while taking a shower, she suddenly became dizzy and collapsed. She had a stroke and died on the spot. 
When her relatives discovered her, her body was dark purple and cold. Her soul was led to the underworld by the Devil. When Lord of Hell declared the crime of killing, she repeatedly justified: "I just made a living, I didn't mean to kill." The King of Hell slammed the table and shouted: "You take the lives of living beings to feed yourself. Even if it's to make a living, the karma of killing is still the karma of killing. Your crime cannot find deliverance!" Devil Sai immediately weighed the number of frogs she had skinned. How many pounds of meat - so many pounds of sin. 
She was led into a dark prison door, where the stench of blood was strong. There are countless frogs with strange shapes:
– Some have human bodies and frog heads
– There is a frog body and a human head 
– Bloodshot eyes, sharp fangs

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-020-4e4d8841ca62.webp)

They jumped at her, biting and tearing her flesh.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-021-f08d2996e443.webp)

Blood splashed. She screamed in extreme pain. Die... then come back to life. Demon Sai sprinkled water to revive her, her body returned to integrity, and then continued to be punished. It doesn't stop there. She was taken to another prison door, where Demon Sai peeled her skin little by little, just like she used to do to frogs. Wherever the skin is pulled, there is pain to the soul. 
She did not dare to continue talking. Just remembering it made her soul tremble with fear. She only knew that she had to endure 45 days of punishment in hell, but the transition to the living world was as long as endless. After paying off her karma, she was reincarnated as Le Thi Hoi, carrying the disease of scabies - the retribution for her old karma of skin peeling.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-022-51ef6553af5b.webp)

When the Mountain Immortal pointed out, our group went to the stream, burned incense, and taught Ms. Hoi.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-02-image-023-4eafc96fc261.webp)

After clearly understanding her cause and effect, she agreed to let go and follow us to the temple to study, hoping to one day be liberated. Her story is a chilling warning to those who underestimate the karma of killing. There is no "accidental" crime. There is no such thing as “free” karma. The cause is sown in a second - the reward can last for many lifetimes. While you are still alive, please know how to love sentient beings. Because who knows... In one life, we were once those innocent animals.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of FROG SKIN, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 3: The Grave Sin of the Unfilial Child
tom_tat: Among the countless human sins, great filial piety is one of the heaviest. Because parents are the ones who give birth to us, raise us, give us shape, and give us our first breath. Who when...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 3: THE GRAVE SIN OF THE UNFILIAL CHILD**}

Among the countless human sins, grave unfilial conduct is one of the heaviest sins. Because parents are the ones who give birth to us, raise us, give us shape, and give us our first breath. Whoever curses, insults, and injures their parents while alive, then when they die, that karma will not only not be eliminated, but will also be magnified a hundred or a thousand times greater in the underworld. On the journey to save the dead, we met many souls with unfilial karma. But the story of Tran Van Khanh, from An Giang, is one of the stories that sends chills down the spine of listeners, because the punishments he suffered in hell were so terrible that just hearing it was enough to haunt him for the rest of his life.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-024-246560556937.webp)

Mr. Tran Van Khanh, died at the age of 31, due to being beaten by his friends and suffering a traumatic brain injury. He died on the spot. But his death was not an accidental accident, but a retribution from his own actions while alive. When he was alive, Mr. Khanh was famous for being rude to his parents. Not a day goes by that he doesn't scold his father and mother. The words that flowed from his mouth were poisonous and filthy, not sparing a single word: - "Old dog!" – “Old whore!” – “The devil!” The parents were torn apart when they heard it, but because they loved their children, they still patiently and pampered them.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-025-31cdd7dbf2e1.webp)

Not satisfied with the food - kicked over the rice tray. Not suitable for taste - threw up the soup pot. One time he wanted to eat sour eel soup, but that day his mother couldn't buy eel, so she had to buy snakehead fish instead. As soon as he saw the pot of soup, he kicked it over and cursed his mother severely, leaving his old mother trembling and crying in the middle of the cold kitchen. 
Not only is he unfilial, Mr. Khanh is also addicted to gambling and prostitutes. His parents had to work hard to earn money, giving him 10 million each month, but it was still not enough for him to spend. Listening to bad friends, he opened his parents' safe, took all the gold, silver and life savings that his grandparents had saved. When they found out, his parents were so angry that they trembled and cursed in frustration: "Let someone beat his mother to death... you bastard!"

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-026-0108df77cd4e.webp)

Mr. Khanh took the stolen money to gamble. Strangely enough, luck continued to come, he won big and filled his pockets with money. When the group of close friends saw this, their greed arose. They secretly planned to kill and rob people. One night, when Mr. Khanh took money and walked through a deserted street, they rushed out and beat the council, beating him until he suffered a serious brain injury and died on the spot. Not stopping there, they also carried his body home, making up the story that he had an accident and died. The funeral was held smoothly as if no crime had ever occurred.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-027-6fcb7fdb2a43.webp)

Because Khanh's life was so chaotic, his parents did not suspect him. The soul leaves the body, resentment fills the sky. Mr. Khanh vowed revenge. Wandering around looking for the person who harmed him, he encountered many other deaths. They pointed him to Ta Lon mountain, a place that specializes in teaching black magic. Once he learns, he will get revenge faster. 
With resentment clouding his mind, he was determined to go up the mountain. For nearly 5 months, he learned black magic, thinking he was strong enough. Going down the mountain, he met a demon, became aggressive, and immediately invited him to fight. The demon was too strong, he was beaten in extreme pain, and had to run away. While hiding, he jumped into a thick banana bush, when suddenly he saw two Black and White Vu Thuong going to capture the guilty soul.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-028-884e706e94f7.webp)

After the investigation, they coldly read the Judge's order: "Tran Van Khanh, 32 years old, from An Giang. Don't try to deny it. Studying black magic, plotting to harm others, the crime is even worse. Don't follow us - your soul will fly away!" Mr. Khanh was extremely scared and was forced to be tied to the underworld. In front of Diem Chua Palace, the books were opened. Mr. Khanh's most serious crime is the crime of GREAT UNFIELD. Lord of Hell said: "Your sins deserve to go straight to the 18th level of hell. But to let you absorb enough pain, I will let you go from the first to the eighteenth floor in turn."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-029-4f58c0186370.webp)

As soon as he walked through the first prison door, Mr. Khanh was hit straight into his soul by the stench of blood and the smell of burning rusty iron. The ground is not dirt, but black rocks covered in flesh and blood, slippery as if thousands of bodies had just been crushed. Devil Sai tied him up and pressed him hard on the stone table. Before he could scream, the cold iron blade slashed down.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-030-3e83433f56b0.webp)

His body was cut into pieces, the sound of bones breaking was terrifying, the sound was like breaking a dry branch but ten thousand times more painful. Blood spurted out into a hot, hot fountain, splashing onto the prison walls. The iron dogs immediately rushed forward. They have metal teeth as sharp as saws and eyes as red as embers. They grabbed every piece of twitching flesh, chewed loudly, the sound of broken bones mixed with desperate screams.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-031-53cc19f742f3.webp)

When his body was eaten clean, Ghost Sai sprinkled water to restore his soul. Mr. Khanh came back to life. As soon as the skin and flesh healed, it was cut again. Just like that, die - live - cut - eat, repeating for ten years in the yang world. Each time he was resurrected, the pain did not decrease, but increased, because the soul had fully remembered each knife strike.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-032-888d49d0474e.webp)

Exiting the first floor, he was dragged to the second floor. Here, the temperature is so hot that even the soul smokes. In the middle of the prison are giant bronze pillars, glowing red like embers just taken out of the furnace. Demon Sai tied his arms and legs tightly, forcing him to hug the bronze pillar. As soon as the skin touched the copper, a fierce "sizzling" sound rang out. The skin was scorched and peeling, the smell of burning human flesh mixed with the smell of hot metal made the air thick. Mr. Khanh screamed, but his throat was dry, his screams were only hoarse hisses. Wherever the skin burns, bones are exposed. But before he could die, Ghost Sai was sprinkled with water to regain his senses, his flesh healed... and then continued to be forced to hug the pole. Ten years passed in pain that burned from the outside in, without stopping for a second.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-033-17a87e94a496.webp)

The third level of hell – Hooked tongue, iron buffalo plowed. At this level, Mr. Khanh had no more tears to cry. Devil Sai used a sharp iron hook to hook straight into the tongue, pulling it out forcefully. The pain ripped from my mouth all the way down to my heart. The tongue was stretched out several meters and placed on the ground. An iron buffalo was led. Its claws are curved blades, stepped on step by step, plowing the blade like plowing a field. Every step the buffalo took, each piece of tongue was crushed, blood sprayed all over his face. Without stopping, Devil Sai cut his tongue into pieces and threw them on the ground for him to see clearly. This crime is payment for cursing your parents when they were alive.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-034-46f7832e6ca6.webp)

The fourth level of hell – Four horses dismembered He was thrown into a vast field of land. Four iron horses stood in four directions, their exhaled breath was hot black smoke. Devil Sai tied his limbs to four horses. The sound of whip cracking rang out. The horse rushed away. In just a moment, his body was ripped apart, bones and joints were torn out of place, and skin was torn apart. The feeling at that time was not death, but being torn into four parts while still conscious. Each time the body was broken, recovered, and then pulled again. Ten years... without missing a single time.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-035-1b032774d028.webp)

The fifth level of hell – Ice Snow Mountain from blazing hot to soul-shatteringly cold. The entire prison is a mountain range of white ice, the wind blows like a knife, so cold that it paralyzes consciousness. Demon Sai forced him to hug the icicle. As soon as the skin touches it, it freezes immediately, then cracks like glass, falling into pieces. The cold penetrated deep into my soul, I couldn't scream in pain, I could only tremble in despair. 
Next floors – Iron snake bridge and monsters. Then there are the levels of prison that he doesn't dare to describe clearly. Just remember that you have to cross narrow, swaying bridges. Under the bridge are iron snakes, iron tigers, iron monsters, mouths wide open, teeth as sharp as saw blades. Just slip or fall and you'll be torn into hundreds of pieces, so painful that your soul will be broken.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-03-image-036-9983678e2a9c.webp)

While being tortured, Mr. Khanh saw Hac - Bach Vu Thuong passing by, behind was a large group. Ghost Sai suddenly stopped. He risked his life to hide in their shadow, just keep walking... When he woke up, he was already on earth. Wandering for 20 days, he was instructed by the Mountain Immortal and our group came to give him advice. After many admonitions, Mr. Khanh repented and agreed to return to the temple to study, hoping to atone for some of his sins. 
Mr. Tran Van Khanh's story is a chilling warning for those who are still taking the word HIEU lightly. Cursing father - scolding mother while still alive, going to hell - hundreds of thousands of times painful. When parents are still alive, that is the greatest blessing in life. Please remember: "Disfilial piety is the deepest prison."
¬

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of THE UNPRIVATE CHILD, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 4: The Slain Pig Reborn in Human Form
tom_tat: In the Buddhist law of cause and effect, there are karmas that do not appear immediately, but once they bloom, there is no way back. The karma of killing is one such karma. The story h...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 4: THE SLAIN PIG REBORN IN HUMAN FORM**}

In the Buddhist law of cause and effect, there are karmas that do not appear immediately, but once they bloom, there is no way back. The karma of killing is one such karma. Today's story is about Mr. Son, a rural man who lived by slaughtering pigs for eight years. At first it was just a means of livelihood, but gradually, from a scalpel to earn a living, he turned it into a knife of enjoyment, a knife of greed - anger - evil thoughts. No one knew that every knife he swung on the pig's body was recorded, not in earthly books, but in the karma books of the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-037-e4673707e0bc.webp)

During eight years of working, Mr. Son slaughtered two to four pigs every day, and during the Tet holidays, the knife never left his hand. Money poured in, houses were repaired, life was better. When people look at it, they only see blessings and blessings, no one can see the blood seeping into the barn floor. From just raising pigs to sell the whole herd, Mr. Son switched to raising and slaughtering pigs, cutting the blood himself, and cutting the meat himself. His wife raises pigs well, the sows give birth many times and are healthy. The family gets fame and money. But it was in that pigsty that karma began to accumulate resentment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-038-3a933ff4eed3.webp)

Some time later, a woman came to buy breeding pigs. While catching pigs, Mr. Son accidentally kicked a piglet to death. The mother pig screamed, rushed forward, knocked Mr. Son down, causing him to twist his leg. The physical pain had not yet passed when anger arose. 
Mr. Son shouted loudly: "You dare to bully me? I'll roast your baby and eat it for you to see!" Say it and do it. He set up a charcoal stove, grilled the piglet in front of the mother pig, while roasting, breaking the legs, cutting the meat to eat, constantly teasing: "I'm eating your baby! See!" The mother pig cried, gurgled, and her body trembled. That night, the mother pig died, without injury or illness. When operated on, the head was filled with blood clots.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-039-57a59163e026.webp)

But Mr. Son did not stop. He brought the meat to the market and sold it all. Karma has turned into enemies. After leaving for a while, Mr. Son accepted to roast five pigs for a big party. At that time, there were five sows in the barn, one of the five sows was pregnant. He proposed to his wife that they should kill those five pigs. At first, his wife did not let them because they intended to breed them. Then she told her husband about her dream. I dreamed of a woman coming to beg: "Forgive us... I'm pregnant... the other four are my daughters..." Mr. Son sneered: "If I don't kill them, others will."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-040-990e9c5b6afb.webp)

Then he scolded his wife for dreaming nonsense, so she didn't say anything anymore. At noon the next day, he finished pumping the blood and waited for the pig's hair to be shaved. The wife went out to check the pot of water and crawled back in, screaming: "Murder! Murder!" Mr. Son ran out... In front of him were five naked women, their necks were slashed, lying in a pool of blood. Rub your eyes. Still see that. He and his wife cheered the villagers.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-041-97735b8161ea.webp)

When the villagers arrived, they only saw five pigs. But Mr. Son and his wife still saw the pigs becoming humans, so they decided to bury these five pigs.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-042-8d7a34b76dae.webp)

After that event, Mr. Son's wife collapsed, lost her hair, stopped eating and drinking, and died of weakness. After his wife passed away, Mr. Son still raised pigs. One time he was transporting breeding pigs to a customer, he left his two sons at home and told them to cook for themselves. Late in the afternoon, his father came home. By the time he returned, his two children were dead, unusually, with blood all over their heads. Mr. Son himself, in a panic looking for help, tripped and fell, cut his neck on the iron trough, and died on the spot.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-043-17cada54088c.webp)

His soul left his body and he was immediately taken to the Underworld. Hades is not a place of meaningless punishment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-044-c46debd78b3a.webp)

Each prison door exists to reflect the karma that the sinful soul has sown. For Mr. Son - who held a pig slaughter knife for eight years - hell is no different from a giant slaughterhouse, where the roles are absolutely reversed. 
From now on, Mr. Son is no longer the killer, but the thing being killed.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-045-260a746f61d8.webp)

Ghost Sai didn't say a word. They used long iron forks to stab straight from the anus to the top of Mr. Son's head - the exact position where he used to pierce the pig's body to roast it firmly. The first feeling was not pain, but shock. Then heat, then fire. He was suspended above the red furnace, his body began to rotate slowly, circle by circle, just like roast pigs on earth. His skin blistered, then exploded, fat from his body flowed into the fire, emitting a strong, suffocating smell.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-046-8c76cda23283.webp)

The sound of skin exploding was uneven, sometimes fast and sometimes slow, sounding like the sound of bones breaking and flesh tearing. The most terrifying thing is not the fire, but the consciousness that remains awake. Mr. Son did not die. Every time his body burned to the point of disintegration, Ghost Sai would sprinkle water to restore him, his flesh and skin would grow back intact, so he could continue filming. No time. There was no fainting. There is only pain - remembering - understanding - then more pain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-047-0d634ff02808.webp)

As soon as his body was restored, Mr. Son was thrown into a dark valley, the ground was muddy and smelled of blood. From within the fog, a loud gurgling sound rang out. Hundreds, thousands of pigs appeared. Not an ordinary pig. Their eyes are as red as coal, their fangs are long and sharp, their skin is rough and full of surgical scars, and their bodies still have finger marks, knife marks, and puncture marks. They rushed at Mr. Son without any orders. Bite, Tear…
  The flesh was torn from the bones, the intestines were pulled out, the body pieces were dismembered alive.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-048-5656c241bc46.webp)

Every time a pig bites him, memories ring in his head: this pig he slaughtered in the morning, that pig he roasted during Tet, that pig he killed while it was still in Tet. It wasn't just physical pain, it was being forced to remember every life I had taken. When the body was crushed, the pigs retreated. The devil sent water to restore the soul. The pigs rushed in again. Over and over again, without stopping.
The next prison door - This prison door is not noisy, but the most haunting. Mr. Son was tied to his knees, his head tilted back. A Demon Sai holds a thin knife, so sharp that just touching it tears the flesh. The knife cut deeply into his neck, exactly where he used to poke pigs. Blood sprayed into jets. Breath caught in throat. He died in conscious consciousness. Before he could turn it off, he regained consciousness. Continue poking. Can't scream anymore. Only panicked eyes remained. This prison door makes the soul gradually lose the concept of life and death. Only one thing remains, waiting to be killed again.
Hell does not punish with hatred. Hell teaches by experience. I once roasted a pig → I was roasted. He poked the pig's blood → got poked. He once considered life a commodity → was treated like a commodity. The most terrible thing is not the pain, but understanding it too late.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-04-image-049-bde34c0b4117.webp)

In this world, you kill to live. In hell, he lived to be killed. After a long period of punishment, Son was allowed to reincarnate. Before leaving, he followed the group to the earthly world, was instructed by the Mountain Immortal, was enlightened by our group and brought back to the temple. Death's last words were only one sentence: "If I knew hell was like this... I would rather be poor." 
This story is not intended to scare, but to remind: "Every life is a life. What a knife kills today will return tomorrow." Cause and effect need not be witnessed, but never overlooked.

tieu_de: Story 5: Under the Wings of the Wild Birds
tom_tat: In rural areas, where gardens are luxuriant and birds often reside, people often say: "Birds have nests, people have karma." The main character in this story is...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 5: UNDER THE WINGS OF THE WILD BIRDS**}

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-050-1b1c65544a65.webp)

In rural areas, where gardens are luxuriant and birds often reside, people often say: "Birds have nests, people have karma." The main character in this story is named Nhan - a man who makes a living by shooting birds and trigger guns. For him, the sound of gunfire in the midday sun is not a sin, but a piece of food and clothing. To him, the little lives that fell were just trophies. But there are karmas that don't just stop at killing. There are shots that are not aimed at the wings of birds in the sky, but are shot straight at one's own destiny.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-051-5f2542a9d523.webp)

That day, Mr. Nan chased a large flock of birds, flying across the sky, pulling him to the mango garden of a middle-aged woman. There are a lot of birds in this garden, storks make nests all over the treetops. Mr. Nen's eyes lit up. There was only one thought in his mind: "I've been tricked." Gunfire rang out continuously. Birds fall like rain. But at that very moment, the garden owner ran out, cursed, chased him away, and used harsh words to insult his honor.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-052-9c62858c9eb2.webp)

The cheap dignity of a person used to holding a gun is hurt. Mr. Nen did not leave. He hid. Wait until the woman stretches out her hammock to take a nap, her breathing is even, her eyes are closed tightly. The victim approached, covered her mouth, tied her hands and feet, and tied her tightly to the mango tree.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-053-8dede621fd80.webp)

Then he dropped the fire ant nest on her. No knives, no guns. Just ants. But each ant bites, stings, and burrows into the ears, nose, and mouth. She struggled until she was exhausted. No one heard the cry for help. Victim left home, carrying with him the thought: "Maybe he's dead." But she was really dead.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-054-d3405331b21d.webp)

When the soul left the body, the garden owner was led down to the underworld by Black and White Vu Thuong. In front of Diem La Palace, she cried and complained, detailing every detail of her painful death. Lord of Hell turned over the book of life and death and spoke a sentence as cold as iron: "Call the soul of the person who caused the karma to come down here."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-055-65ec210bdd31.webp)

The next day, Nen still went bird hunting as usual. At noon, he lay in a hammock to sleep, the wind blew gently, and as soon as he closed his eyes, two dark shadows stood on either side.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-056-3ae8d983d04d.webp)

Before he could open his mouth, the cold chains wrapped tightly around his arms and legs. Panic: "Who are you two? Where are you taking me?" Hac Bach Vu Thuong replied: "Go to the underworld. You have killed someone." Ngo shouted: "I was wronged! I only shot birds!" But the soul has left the body. The body in the hammock suddenly died on the spot.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-057-acf5b92de5c5.webp)

Before the Reflecting Mirror, everything appeared clearly: - The image of tying up people - The fire ant nest fell down - The screams faded away in despair. Victim knelt down, unable to say a word. Victim was taken to prison door number 6, where people are detained: - Stealing from charity - Corrupt - Exploiting labor - And killing people with despicable tricks.
Hell door number 6 is not like other levels of hell. This place does not kill sinners immediately, but forces them to live in constant pain, die and then come back to life, so that each pain is imprinted deeply into the consciousness. As soon as Nien was dragged by Devil Sai to the prison gate, he felt an air as thick as hot grease, mixed with the smell of blood, burning skin and endless moans. There was no light, only a dim red light shining from the giant blocks of burned bronze.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-058-07e5365be28c.webp)

Ghost Sai tied Nang's hands and feet tightly with iron chains with hooks, each thorn deeply embedded in his skin. They pulled him close to a bronze pillar, many times taller than his body, so hot that the surrounding air distorted.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-059-54b8ccd73679.webp)

As soon as the skin touches the column: - The skin sizzles like fat falling into a pan - The meat shrinks and crackles - The burning smell rushes straight into the consciousness, making the soul want to break. Before the victim could scream, his throat was dry and his screams were only wordless, broken breaths. Demon Sai stood around, expressionless, just waiting for the right moment. When the flesh was almost completely burned and the bones were exposed, they let go.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-060-1677c2180bb6.webp)

Nen's body was dropped from an unknown height, falling straight to the rock-hard prison floor. BAM! Bones shattered, internal organs scattered, heads crushed like fruit falling from above. But not dead yet. Ghost Sai immediately poured water to recover his senses. The water is as cold as ice, but when touched, it burns consciousness, pulling together pieces of soul. In an instant, the whole body returned. Victim opened his eyes, but before he could understand what was happening, he was dragged further.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-061-0ccc9320adec.webp)

This time, Ma Sai used a large knife, slashing straight from the top of the head down. Not one decisive blow. They slash slowly. Wherever the blade goes, consciousness is torn apart. The brain was separated, but Nang still had feelings. Then: - Cut each arm - Cut each calf - Break the bones and joints - Peel off the skin in small pieces. Every time the body is about to completely disintegrate, the soul-restoring water is poured down. Just like that. There is no concept of time. There is only repetition. After being punished countless times, Nien was dragged before another row of Demons.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-05-image-062-8ba820f5afc7.webp)

They held long iron spears, so sharp that they glowed cold blue. Without any warning. PHAP. The needle pierced straight from his back to his abdomen, pinning Nang's body like a mouse on a stick. The victim could not move, he could only feel each twitch of his consciousness. Then, Devil Sai lifted him up. Ahead was a giant, boiling sea of ​​oil, with oil bubbles bursting continuously. Ghost Sai threw Nang straight down. Boiling oil spilled into: - Mouth - Nose - Lungs - Every pore The feeling is not pain anymore, but consciousness being dissolved. But right before completely disintegrating, he was pulled up again, his body restored, to continue.
Prison door number 6 not only punishes murder, but also punishes evil heart and indifference. The victim: - Killed storks without mercy - Was cruel to humans - Showed no remorse until being dragged to the underworld. Therefore, the punishment does not give quick death. But forced to experience every feeling that the victim has endured. Birds that were shot down did not complain. But karma is remembered very clearly. Trieu understood, but it was too late. Hell does not create karma, it only returns what has been sown. This story is not meant to scare. But to remind: "Every life has value. Evil, no matter how small, can one day become a great disaster."

tieu_de: Story 6: Midwife to a Ghost
tom_tat: In this world, there are deaths that do not close with the last breath, but open another door - the door of injustice, pain and souls that cannot escape. That's k...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 6: MIDWIFE TO A GHOST**}

In this world, there are deaths that do not close with the last breath, but open another door - the door of injustice, pain and souls that cannot attain liberation. That is when people die in resentment, die unfinished, die while their thoughts are still attached to their cold bodies. 
Such spirits do not disappear, do not reincarnate, but lurk somewhere between the boundary of yin and yang, living an existence even more miserable than being a human. The story I tell below is such a case. 
A young couple died at the same time, with the same energy frequency, so when they became ghosts they still recognized each other, still loved each other, and still suffered together. But that bond turned into chains, pulling them deep into the darkness, where the cry of an unborn child echoed endlessly...

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-06-image-063-314250f6cdfa.webp)

His name was Trung, he died at the age of thirty-five. Her name is Hanh, she died at the age of thirty-two. When they were alive, they were a gentle, honest couple who only wanted a comfortable home. The pregnancy in Ms. Hanh's womb is the couple's greatest hope, the first child they have been waiting for with all their love. Since discovering she was pregnant, the couple took each other to a private clinic for examination. The doctor there patted her chest confidently, saying that even though Ms. Hanh had three leaky heart valves, she could still give birth normally, as long as she pushed properly. Because of trust, because of lack of understanding, they entrust their lives to someone who wears a blouse but has no conscience.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-06-image-064-0d32cb7a72f0.webp)

On the day of labor, Ms. Hanh was taken to the delivery room. Behind the closed door, the strong smell of antiseptic mixed with the foul smell of blood. Ms. Hanh was in so much pain that she had convulsions, pain tearing through her chest, her heart beating erratically as if it was about to burst. Every time she pushed, she felt her breath become shorter and her eyes turned dark. Due to pushing incorrectly, her heart could not bear the pressure. The fourth heart valve was exposed, blood refluxed, and acute heart failure occurred. When the baby was only partially out, Ms. Hanh's body convulsed violently, her mouth foamed, her eyes widened and she passed away.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-06-image-065-c975a1d9407e.webp)

The doctor panicked but had poor expertise and could not handle the situation. In the end, both mother and child died right on the birthing table. Outside, Mr. Trung waited in despair. Time passed like an eternity. The child's cry did not ring out. A bad premonition squeezed his chest. He kept knocking on the door, calling for a doctor, but only received cold dismissals. It's been too long, too unusual, Mr. Trung can't stand it anymore. He knocked on the door and rushed in. The scene before his eyes made his blood boil like lava. On the cold delivery bed, his wife's body was still warm and stained with blood, having been perverted and perverted by the doctor. An ultimate insult to the dead man, to his honor and love.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-06-image-066-de0a82e7f326.webp)

In a rage, Mr. Trung rushed to attack the doctor. But he ran out to call security. The fight took place in the hospital hallway filled with blood and screams. A security guard used a medical baton to repeatedly hit Mr. Trung in the head. A dry sound rang out, the skull shattered. He fell down and died on the spot, while still thinking that his wife and children were still in the delivery room. 
The souls of Mr. Trung and Ms. Hanh left their bodies almost at the same time. Due to an unjust death, a resentful death and having the same energy frequency, the two souls do not disappear but meet again in the dark and gloomy realm. When they knew they were both dead, the pain was no longer physical but became haunting. The most horrifying thing is that even though Ms. Hanh is dead, she still has the thought that she is pregnant. The pain of labor does not go away. Her stomach is still cramping. Her soul curled up, her hands clasped her stomach, her face was pale, her mouth was moaning. Blood as thick as asphalt dripped from the lower body, giving off the cold, fishy smell of the underworld. The baby couldn't come out, its soul was trapped, becoming a mass of distorted energy, crying soundlessly. The couple harassed the clinic to get revenge.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-06-image-067-5a5e460abb43.webp)

At first it was just a scary apparition. Then there is heavy haunting. The other doctor often saw blood flowing from his hands and heard women moaning in pain in the empty examination room. The patient came to the doctor and suddenly had a heart attack and fainted. The clinic gradually became deserted, cold as a tomb. Following the Mountain Immortal's instructions, our group found the place where the two ghosts were "dwelling". The air there was thick and cold to the point of numbing the bones. As soon as he arrived, Mr. Trung appeared, his face bruised, his head distorted, and his eyes panicked. He kept begging us: "Save my wife... please... she's about to give birth..."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-06-image-068-c8b7946d6cbd.webp)

He asked us to deliver Ms. Hanh's baby. That was the first case we encountered. Midwife a soul. No flesh and blood, no vitality, only resentment and pain. 
Ms. Hanh lay curled up, her body blurred, her belly bulging out of shape, from which cold air emitted like ice. We had to reassure Mr. Trung and ask clearly the end of the story. After hearing this, everyone shivered. This is not just one death, but a chain of crimes and karma.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-06-image-069-0c20ef1085e4.webp)

We began to enlighten Ms. Hanh, reminding her that her body was gone, the baby had also left, this pain was just a thought. Using the techniques taught by the Fairy God, we gradually untied the knot in her mind.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-06-image-070-341f0f1c4bbd.webp)

After a while, her moans became weaker, her stomach flattened, and her face became less distorted. Ms. Hanh finally let go of the idea of ​​being pregnant. Seeing his wife back to normal, Mr. Trung knelt down, tears flowing in dark streams.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-06-image-071-93c5c021c502.webp)

We offered rice to the couple. When she finished eating, Ms. Hanh choked up and said: "It's been more than ten years... it's been a long time since we last had a meal..." Ms. Hanh once heard the Ta Lon mountain bird say that there were many ghosts there who came to study for revenge.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-06-image-072-51748d9d3769.webp)

She plans to invite her husband to go. But we continue to explain: "Injustice and injustice will never end. Those who do evil will bear their karma." Finally, the couple agreed to let go and follow us to the temple to study. 
The story of Mr. Trung and Ms. Hanh is a chilling proof of the law of cause and effect. One moment of irresponsibility, one greed, one human perversion can push many lives into hell of suffering, not only during life but also after death. Demons are not as scary as human evil. Hell is not only in the underworld, but is created right in unconscionable actions on earth. And only when letting go of resentment can people - even if they have already achieved success - be able to find the path to liberation.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of Nanny for Ghosts, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 7: Exploiting Religion for Wealth
tom_tat: In the fragile boundary between life and death, there are souls who cannot escape because of the karma they created. When alive, they wear the appearance of...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 7: EXPLOITING RELIGION FOR WEALTH**}

In the fragile boundary between life and death, there are souls who cannot attain liberation because of the karma they created. When alive, they put on the appearance of monks, chanting scriptures, beating drums, but their hearts are full of greed, lust, and ignorance. When he died, that layer of morality fell off, revealing his naked face before the justice of the underworld. The story of Uncle Lanh, who tragically died on Sap Mountain, is a horrifying testament to the unfailing law of cause and effect. What he did while he was alive, the scriptures that were swallowed, the filthy desires hidden behind the sound of the bell, all turned into chains, pulling him straight down into levels of hell so terrible that he himself did not dare to continue telling...

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-073-702804f9e821.webp)

When he was alive, Uncle Lanh did not have a stable job. Living in the Sap mountain area all year round, he often went to the temple to do meritorious deeds. At first, it may be genuine kindness: sweeping the temple grounds, carrying water, chopping firewood. At the temple, he often listened to the monks chant the Daily Sutra. Over time, he got used to it and gradually memorized each passage. He asked to take a prayer book home to recite to himself, as if he were planting some good roots. One day, Uncle Lanh bought a bell and brought it home. Before I could chant at home, I heard neighbors say that someone in the village had just passed away. The family was frantically looking for a chanter but no one was willing to come.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-074-0e72e00f468b.webp)

Hearing that, Uncle Lanh had an idea and immediately came over to say: "I can recite, but I don't have a robe yet." The homeowner was confused at that time, just hoping someone would chant for the death of his loved one, so he nodded and let it go. The Lanh Mantra chants for free. At first, he stumbled and confused the words, but thanks to chanting at many free gatherings in the area, he gradually got used to it, his mouth read smoothly, his hands played the drum rhythmically. From then on, he started receiving money. Each group was given one to two million VND - not a small amount of money in the mountains at that time.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-075-b1be2784af48.webp)

Seeing that money came easily, Uncle Lanh decided to choose the profession of chanting teacher as his main livelihood. But from here, karma begins to take shape. Initially, recite the full mantra. Then read quickly. Next, remove the words and go through the scriptures to finish the job. The bell still rings, but the mind is no longer focused on the prayer. He only thought about money, about chanting quickly so he could go to another gathering.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-076-178d5abcb991.webp)

There was a special funeral where the homeowner and his wife died at the same time, leaving behind a grown, beautiful daughter. While chanting sutras in the mourning atmosphere, the sound of the gongs and the sound of the cold incense mixed with the smell of incense, Uncle Lanh could not keep his mind and glanced at the girl. Her appearance in a white mourning outfit made the desire in him rise even more. During the days he stayed and chanted, he found a way to approach and say sweet words. After burying her parents, that girl - lonely and empty - gradually fell into the wrong relationship.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-077-e110581259ed.webp)

The two live together like husband and wife. From then on, Uncle Lanh changed the price. Each chant costs three million dong - fifteen years ago, that was a huge amount of money. But the more money, the more cloudy the mind becomes. Sutras are being mutilated more and more. Every word that is swallowed is a piece of karma that is quietly recorded. Later, he accepted to recite for another family. The new husband died, leaving behind a beautiful young wife. The homeowner suggested that he come and recite once a week. But chanting is just an excuse. His real purpose was to reach the widow.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-078-74ebd874b0bc.webp)

After a long period of courtship, the woman finally fell for it. They live together like husband and wife, regardless of morality. This woman has a son who is over eighteen years old. One day, when he came home from work, the son opened the door and witnessed a horrifying scene: Uncle Lanh and his mother were entwined in bed. Anger flared up like hellfire. He put a burlap sack over Uncle Lanh's head and beat him until he lost consciousness.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-079-8f867ed3d8b0.webp)

Without stopping, he pulled him up Sap Mountain, where the abyss was deep. Uncle Lanh was thrown down from above. The body collided with the rocks, the bones were broken, the flesh was crushed, and the body was not completely dead.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-080-4e943e83e163.webp)

His soul left his body, and before he could understand what was going on, he was tied up by Devil Sai and dragged straight to the underworld. In the underworld, he was convicted of two great evil karmas: One was lacking in reading the scriptures. Second is the sin of adultery.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-081-be62f7ea76fe.webp)

The first punishment is a completely dark room. The space is damp and cold. Raised my hand but couldn't see my fingers. There was only a small light flickering like a firefly. Uncle Lanh was forced to sit there for 14 years, reciting every word of the scriptures he had swallowed.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-082-54a05fc9b6e8.webp)

His eyes must be stretched to the point of tearing his cornea. The soul trembled, the mouth read in despair. Each word is a knife cutting into consciousness. Eyes bloodshot, glaring as if about to explode.
This is terrible mental torture, where time has no concept.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-083-d62a96d3caaa.webp)

After 14 years, he was taken to the second prison door: embracing a hot bronze column. He was stripped naked and forced to hug a red copper pillar. The flesh sizzled and the fat dripped down like candle wax. When he couldn't bear it and slid down, his skin was pulled back on the pole, revealing his slimy muscles. Devil Sai used an iron whip to hit his back and forced him to climb up again. Climbing up is hot, falling down causes tearing. The heart and liver are abraded and the pain is beyond description.
At this point, Uncle Lanh trembled and screamed: "I won't tell you anymore... hell is so terrible... knowing that, I wouldn't have dared to do it..."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-07-image-084-cfd1ff09b36c.webp)

After being punished, he was sent to earth to wait for someone with fate to help him. Today, fate met, our group met him. After Khai Thi, he bowed his head in repentance and was taken back to the temple to study, hoping to one day repay his old karma. 
The story of Uncle Lanh is a chilling warning to those who wear the robe of monkhood but are filled with desire. The sutras are not for making money, the bells are not tools of seduction, and the religion does not contain evil thoughts. Hell does not need anyone to imagine, because it is built from human actions. The cause and effect is not a single word wrong, just like the words of the scriptures that Uncle Lanh once missed - in the end they had to be returned, with a thousand times more pain.
