tieu_de: Story 8: The Fatal Retribution of Harmful Speech
tom_tat: There are souls who, after death, no longer remember who they are, do not know where they are from, and do not know where they reside. They wander like tattered shadows, carrying their karma with them...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 8: THE FATAL RETRIBUTION OF HARMFUL SPEECH**}

There are souls who, after death, no longer remember who they are, do not know where they are from, and do not know where they reside. They wander like tattered shadows, carrying heavy karma, both scared and desperate, constantly running away from other ferocious spirits. These are people who sow too much evil when they are alive, create too much injustice, and when they die, their minds are shattered, their memories are shattered, leaving only constant fear and hunger.
The story of Vuong Hien, who died more than fifty years ago, is such a case. A soul filled with verbal karma, fire karma and evil mind, step by step building a hell for itself, then when it met us, it could only cry like a child lost in the endless darkness.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-085-34a65bd3524f.webp)

Hien died when he was only twenty-five years old. By the time we met, Hien no longer remembered his hometown, did not know where he died, and did not know where he was staying. Vong only vaguely remembered that he had been on earth for more than a year, and that entire time he was on the run. Flee from fiercer, more ferocious spirits, always lurking and tearing the weak apart. When we arrived, Vuong Hien was sitting on a tall coconut tree, the coconut had an unusual yellow color. The surrounding air was unusually cold, the wind blowing through coconut leaves made dry sounds like bones rubbing against each other.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-086-449b688682c4.webp)

Vong from above shouted in a threatening voice: "Watch out I'll jump down from up here and break your necks and you'll all die!" We calmly replied that today we were destined to help and wanted to take the deceased back to the temple to study. Hearing that, all the aggression disappeared. Vong burst into tears, fell from the tree, trembling and enjoying the fortune we offered. While eating rice and holding fruit, Vuong cried and said in a choked voice: "Oh my god... it's been a long time... I last ate rice today... normally I only suffer punishment in hell... hungry, thirsty, scared... don't know where my loved ones are, don't know the way home..."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-087-4e7bdde86407.webp)

When he calmed down, he told about his life - a short life but filled with karma. When he was alive, Hien was a person who liked to gossip, slander, and make up lies. When you meet your husband, you speak ill of your wife. When you meet your wife, you speak ill of your husband. Just one sentence from Hien is enough to sow seeds of suspicion. One time, Hien met Mr. Khanh and said cruelly that she saw Mr. Khanh's wife hanging out with a young man, even kissing passionately. Without needing to verify, those words were like a knife. Because of that, Mr. Khanh and his wife argued fiercely. When asked about the source and knowing that Hien was a liar, they came and scolded him.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-088-a4a39b7f6175.webp)

Having her honor damaged, Hien's evil heart arose. At midnight, Hien brought gasoline to set fire to Mr. Khanh's house. The fire flared up fiercely, licking the roof like a hungry demon. Fortunately, the whole family was able to escape, with only property damage. But Hien never woke up.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-089-f81aabc321b0.webp)

After that, Hien again spread gossip with Mr. Hai, making up a story about Mr. Hai's wife taking gold to raise boys. Mr. Hai was hot-tempered and, not knowing the truth, beat his wife. When he learned that he had been deceived, Mr. Hai found Hien and beat him severely. Hatred piled up, Hien continued to bring gasoline to set fire to Mr. Hai's house. The fire flared up again, and the smell of burning smoke filled the whole neighborhood. Luckily, no one died.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-090-de0aaebc8348.webp)

The crime did not stop there. Hien became friends with Tuan, a carefree, jobless person. Seeing Tuan's beautiful wife, Hien became lustful. He arranged for Tuan to work far away, only coming home once or twice a month. During that time, Hien often visited other people's houses, bought things, flirted, and gradually broke up other people's families.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-091-4b9ce0b064a6.webp)

One day, Tuan returned suddenly and encountered a disgraceful scene. Hien was tied up, dragged out to the middle of the neighborhood, and humiliated in front of everyone. Outraged and humiliated, Hien used a familiar method: arson. While burning Tuan's house, Hien saw a wad of money fall out of the closet wall. Greed arose. He rushed into the fire and bent down to pick up the money.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-092-d72e4c29b94f.webp)

At that moment, the beam on the rotten roof collapsed, crushing Hien. Fire covers. The screams were swallowed up.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-093-c4320a3825de.webp)

Hien died in the fire he created. As soon as the soul left the body, the devil dragged Hien down to the underworld. Three major crimes were immediately declared: arson and murder, blasphemy and fabrication to cause division. Punishment begins.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-094-703494655fb6.webp)

At the first prison gate, Hien had her fingernails and toenails pulled out. Each nail was pulled out, black blood flowing out. The tongue - the tool that causes oral karma - is cut off, the feeling of pain spreads throughout the consciousness.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-095-5430b982b991.webp)

But the most terrible is the punishment of tendon extraction. Hien was placed on a spinning table. The devil used a sharp hook to dig deep into the soles of his feet.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-096-7e0604e59d18.webp)

The turntable begins to rotate. The tendon is slowly pulled out, no matter how long it is, blood flows there. The hiss of the soul mixed with the cold laughter of the devil, creating an endless hellish music.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-097-e8a3fe911418.webp)

After a long period of torture, in a chaotic moment when a group of dead people was being escorted past, Hien blended into the crowd and suddenly woke up on earth. From then on, he wandered, starved, and ran for more than a year, until he met us. After receiving instructions, Hien bowed his head in repentance and agreed to follow us to the temple to study, hoping to atone for some of the karma he had caused.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-08-image-098-c7df8fd3771f.webp)

Vong Hien's story is a chilling warning about the destructive power of evil speech and mind. One false statement can burn an entire family. One bad thought can open the door to hell. Hell is not far away. It starts from the mouth of the person who speaks evil, from the hand that sets fire, from the heart full of hatred. And when cause and effect are ripe, no soul can run away forever.

tieu_de: Story 9: Vegetarian in Life, Yet Born a Hungry Ghost
tom_tat: There are people who consider themselves honest all their lives: do not kill, are vegetarian, and often visit temples. But evil does not only lie in killing with cutlery, but also lies deep...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 9: VEGETARIAN IN LIFE, YET BORN A HUNGRY GHOST**}

There are people who consider themselves honest all their lives: do not kill, are vegetarian, and often visit temples. But evil lies not only in killing with cutlery, but also hidden deep in greed, in stinginess, in every small deceitful act that people take lightly. Cause and effect does not look at appearances, does not look at chants or vegetarian meals, but looks straight into the true heart and behavior of people. The story of the couple Huynh - Lan, who died more than thirty years ago, is a chilling testament to that.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-099-ab6303413bf1.webp)

When our group met them, both of them were in the form of hungry ghosts: large deformed heads, needle-thin necks, swollen bellies, and bodies that could only crawl on the cold ground. Behind that hideous appearance is a chain of karma spanning many lifetimes, which even they did not expect. While still alive, Mr. Huynh and his wife, Ms. Lan, opened a small grocery store in the village. The two of them are vegetarians, do not kill people, eat only raw vegetables and white rice all year round.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-100-2fb93d1fc892.webp)

But their reason for being vegetarian is not because of compassion, but because of fear of wasting money. Fish meat to them is a waste. Selling groceries with thin profits, instead of accepting a subsistence lifestyle, the couple chose the path of fraudulent trading. Customers buy two kilograms of rice, but they only weigh one kilogram eight, sometimes one kilogram nine. Fish sauce, salt, dried food... everything is reduced. A little bit every day, a little bit every month, but lasting for many years, creating a silent but heavy mass of karma.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-101-aeac3060bab9.webp)

Occasionally, they go to the temple to eat vegetarian rice and ask for food to take home to use. On the outside, he is humble, but on the inside, he calculates every grain of rice. One day, there was a monk who went begging for alms.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-102-213bdc77d1d7.webp)

The sun was hot, the hungry monk stopped by his grandparents' house to ask for food. Instead of giving alms, Huynh and Lan couple coldly chased the monk away. Unable to ask for anything, the monk went to another house and was given a lot of food. When returning to the temple, the monk passed by his grandparents' house again, asking to sit and eat some alms.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-103-5cf8988197b3.webp)

Seeing the monk being given a lot of food, his greed arose. The couple pretended to agree to let the monk sit, but when the monk wasn't paying attention, they secretly took some food and brought it inside. It's not just theft, it's theft from monks, from spiritually meaningful alms.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-104-be56deb1489b.webp)

Not long after that incident, Ms. Lan became sick. A strange disease: the person is skinny, the skin is pale, the body begins to have ulcers, and the more you eat, the more you vomit. Her body felt like it was being gnawed by something from inside.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-105-5ecc9fc0344a.webp)

Mr. Huynh loves his wife and runs everywhere. Some people say that you have to drink fresh turtle blood, cut directly from the neck, to heal. At first, Mr. Huynh was scared, because he had never killed anything in his life. But with his wife increasingly emaciated, he decided to break his precepts. He bought a big turtle. Holding the knife with trembling hands, he chopped off the turtle's head. The head was thrown into a tree, the turtle's body was turned upside down so that the blood flowed straight into Ms. Lan's mouth. The blood was still warm and fishy, ​​flowing down her throat.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-106-162da1151b02.webp)

Less than twenty minutes later, Ms. Lan convulsed violently, her eyes went white, blood spurted out of her mouth, and she died on the spot. Mr. Huynh panicked and cried for his neighbors. People ran over and asked where the turtle's head was to see if it was poisonous.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-107-0b401b581b9a.webp)

In a panic, Mr. Huynh ran to the base of the tree and reached into the hole to grab the turtle's head. But in that damp darkness, a poisonous snake was hidden. It bit his hand. Less than twenty minutes later, Mr. Huynh had a severe heart attack and died.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-108-8255e199e01c.webp)

His soul left his body, Mr. Huynh was immediately escorted to the underworld by two Ghosts. Down there, he met Ms. Lan again - also being tried. In front of the palace of the underworld, the Judge said: "You two were also husband and wife in many previous lives, wealthy families. But because of greed, exploiting workers, and killing for enjoyment, you created countless unjust bondholders.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-109-335689824813.webp)

In this life, even though he is a vegetarian, his mind is not good, he trades fraudulently, and steals from practitioners. The turtle you killed was the one who did it, and whose life you killed in your previous life. It's the same with the snake that bites you. Network debt must be paid with network.”
The punishment was announced: "Turn into a hungry ghost". When we met the deceased couple, their appearance made even the living shudder. The head is as big as a drum, the neck is as small as a needle, the belly is distended as if pregnant, and the hair is as stringy as bamboo roots. The two corpses could not walk and could only crawl on the cold ground. The food we offered was placed before them, but they could not swallow it. The hungry ghost's food is only the sick person's saliva, phlegm, and foul-smelling blood.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-09-image-110-5fa4e9c56b19.webp)

Seeing others eat and drink without enjoying it is an endless torment for those who are stingy while they are still alive. The Judge clearly said: 'If their relatives know how to repent and do good deeds, then the punishment will be considered reduced." Our group asked for a decree from the superiors, allowing them to make offerings so that the deceased could temporarily enjoy a small amount of blessings. After the revelation, the couple nodded and agreed to follow us to the temple to study.
The story of Huynh and Lan couple is a cold warning to those who think that just being vegetarian and not killing is enough. Fraudulent trading, theft, stinginess and greed are also invisible knives, cutting into one's own blessings every day. Cause and effect are not hasty, but are never wrong. What people avoid while alive, when they die, they will have to face in the most horrifying form. Hell is not far away, it is created from petty greed and hypocrisy that lasts a lifetime.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of VEGAN AND STILL BE A HUNGRY DEMON, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 10: Scattering Road Nails for Profit
tom_tat: There are souls who, when they die, are not doomed to do evil, but they also do not have to be completely innocent to be saved. They are stuck on the line between injustice and karma,...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 10: SCATTERING ROAD NAILS FOR PROFIT**}

There are souls who, when they die, are not doomed to do evil, but they also do not have to be completely innocent to be saved. They are stuck on the line between injustice and karma, between coercion and complicity, between victims and perpetrators. Those spirits are often very afraid of humans, afraid of being caught, afraid of being cast, afraid of being taken advantage of again, because when they were alive, they were so used to being trampled. The story of Kim Hoang, a woman living in Hue, is such a case. When our group was directed by the Fairy God to the place where the ghost was residing, the first thing that happened was not begging or telling stories, but running away in panic, like an animal cornered in a dark corner. And when he sat down and told us about his life, we understood: there are hells that begin on earth, before people even die.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-111-f71a59e0c38c.webp)

Kim Hoang married a husband named Minh Le. The two lived together in Hue, in a small, damp house that smelled of oil. Minh Le works as a car repairer, repairing bicycles and motorbikes.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-112-062c25c3fd98.webp)

The job is unstable, guests are few. Kim Hoang does not have a stable job, and his life is poor and miserable. But poverty is not what kills their happiness, but the husband's brutal nature.
Minh Le beat his wife as a habit. Every time he was free, every time he had no customers, every time he was frustrated, he poured it all out on Kim Hoang's body. Punches without warning, kicks aimed straight at the stomach, back, face.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-113-9f12e30aaf57.webp)

There were times when Kim Hoang was beaten to death, his ears were ringing, his eyes were dark, and his mouth was full of blood. After fighting, Minh Le did not stop there. He forced his wife to spread nails. Each spraying is four kilos of various types of nails. Steel nails, sharp nails, curved nails, put them in bags, wait until nightfall when people are fast asleep, then Kim Hoang has to secretly carry them out onto the street and spread them all over the road. After spreading it, you can go home. If she didn't go, Minh Le tied her to the house post, used rope to tighten her arms and legs, beat her until she trembled and urine flowed into her pants because of the pain, then let her go.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-114-fd9d1fe3b02c.webp)

Kim Hoang knew it was unethical, knew he would be guilty, knew it would harm innocent people. She begged, she advised her husband, but the more she advised, the more she was beaten. His face was bruised, his body was full of whip marks and rope marks. In Kim Hoang's life, being tied up and beaten was a daily occurrence. Since the nails were spread, people ran over their cars, punctured their tires, and took them to a repair shop. Minh Le started to have money. Money comes from the blood and accidents of others.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-115-90a23cb590ba.webp)

That immoral act lasted nearly twenty years. Then the retribution began to bear fruit. When Minh Le was forty-nine years old, while driving up a mountain pass, halfway up, the car stalled. The car went downhill. Minh Le fell down, hit his head hard, broke his neck and died on the spot. When the news came, Kim Hoang cried outside, but inside he was secretly happy. Hell on earth has finally ended. She organized a full funeral and still invited the monk to pray for her husband's death, but it was all just a formality. The resentment in my heart has never gone away.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-116-9e23302416dd.webp)

Some time later, Kim Hoang celebrated his 53rd birthday. At that moment, she became sick. My throat started to hurt, then ulcerated, I couldn't eat or drink. The disease that today is called nasopharyngeal cancer torments her every day. Kim Hoang's body was skinny, skin and bones, and his breath smelled of blood. In less than a year, she died in pain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-117-7c75501e1a2c.webp)

With her soul leaving her body, Kim Hoang was led by two Demons to the 11th level of hell. Here, she saw Minh Le. Her husband was tied to a stone pillar.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-118-f651dd21f983.webp)

Demon Sai uses giant nails - many times larger than earthly nails - to drive through his arms, legs, and abdomen. The sound of nails piercing flesh rang out dryly. Finally, Demon Sai stabbed the nail straight into his eye, the eyeball exploded, blood and white fluid shot out, all over the ground.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-119-2bb0e7ce4a2f.webp)

The strong fishy smell rushed straight into my consciousness. Not stopping yet, Ghost Sai used a large ax to drill holes in Minh Le's body.
Each time he drilled, Minh Le could only scream once before fainting. After fainting, Ghost Sai sprinkled water to regain his senses and his body immediately revived to continue being punished.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-120-7dcbc7429f3d.webp)

Repeated torture, no actual death. Kim Hoang witnessed that scene, her limbs became weak, she knelt down and begged for her husband's forgiveness. But Ghost Sai coldly said: "That was his retribution. Now, it's your turn." Kim Hoang was brought before the court. The Judge turns over the book of life and death. In the book, it is clearly written: Kim Hoang committed evil deeds under duress and did not have an active mind, so the crime was less serious than her husband's. Her punishment is to enter another prison door. There, Kim Hoang had to kneel on both knees, crawl on the hot ground, crawling and picking up the nails he had spread while living. Each nail turns into a giant and heavy. The knee rubbed against the ground, bleeding, the flesh peeling off piece by piece, the pain was sharp to the bone. But she still had to pick and rearrange each tree, one by one.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-121-40592414729a.webp)

That punishment lasted fifteen years. During his punishment, Kim Hoang saw an acquaintance at the prison door next to him: Luu Yen, his neighbor when he was still alive. This person died at the age of fifty, for stealing salt. At that time in Hue, salt was as precious as gold. Luu Yen's punishment is to swallow red-hot salt grains falling from the sky. Every time she swallows, her throat tears and blood flows freely. After serving his punishment, Kim Hoang was allowed to reincarnate. But at that moment it fell on the full moon of the seventh month, and the dead followed the group to earth. Busy wandering, busy looking at the lives of people on earth, Kim Hoang lost his way and could no longer return to the underworld. Hungry, cold, scared, until the Mountain Immortal pointed out and met our group.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-10-image-122-f2d00ddbb362.webp)

At first, they thought we were forcing them to practice talismans, so they ran away. But when he was revealed, Kim Hoang burst into tears, sat back, enjoyed the fortune, and then agreed to follow us to the temple to study, hoping to redeem the remaining karma.
Kim Hoang's story is not just a horror story, but a profound warning about the karma of complicity, about the evil born of fear and that even though you know clearly that the evil deed is still willing to do it, you will be punished in hell. Not all sins start from an evil heart, but if you don't stop and don't find a way to escape, karma will still form. Hell is not just in the underworld. For Kim Hoang, hell began from the small house in Hue, from the trembling nights of scattering nails, and only ended when she truly bowed her head and repented.

tieu_de: Story 11: Riding the Sacred Elephant
tom_tat: Amidst the bustling flow of people in the modern world, where cars roar, red and green lights flash, high-rise buildings grow close together, there are lost souls standing in the middle of that world without...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 11: RIDING THE SACRED ELEPHANT**}

Amidst the bustling flow of people in the modern world, where cars roar, red and green lights flash, high-rise buildings grow close together, there are lost souls standing in the middle of that world without belonging anywhere. They are no longer living people, but they have not completely left this earthly world. These are spirits that have existed for too long, too far away from this era, carrying with them memories of a world that disappeared hundreds, even thousands of years ago.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-11-image-123-71b0f3d62cb4.webp)

Today, we continue the story of an old woman named Bach Binh, who left her body nearly a thousand years ago. A soul with the blessing of practicing, but witnessed with his own eyes the levels of hell so horrifying that just hearing about it is enough to send chills down the spine. Her story is not only a horror story, but also a warning about the strict law of cause and effect of the underworld. While wandering on earth, Mrs. Bach Binh was extremely confused. She stood on the side of the road, watching the stream of people passing by like a waterfall. The roaring motorbikes, the speeding iron cars, and the constantly flashing red, yellow, and green traffic lights scared her. The tall buildings seemed to poke straight into the sky, completely different from the low, rolling mountains she once knew. She told us that, for a thousand years, she mainly stayed in the underworld, only when she had a special opportunity was she allowed to come to earth to visit. The world has changed so much that she no longer recognizes it.

When asked where she was born, she just shook her head. Her hometown is a remote land, surrounded by mountains, without dense houses like today. Too much time has erased all specific memories, leaving only a feeling of desolation and silence. After a while of chatting, Mrs. Bach Binh began talking about her two lives. In her first life, she was born as a girl in a poor countryside. She did not marry, remained chaste, kept the eight precepts, worshiped Buddha statues, and took care of her parents wholeheartedly. She was a vegetarian, only ate boiled vegetables, and lived frugally until the day she passed away.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-11-image-124-7b728c073fd6.webp)

That merit helped her to be reincarnated as a female. In her second life, she was named Bach Binh. From a young age, she practiced at home, read scriptures, recited Buddha's name, and worshiped her parents and Buddhas at home. She still did not get married and kept her body pure. But the accumulated merit was not outstanding enough for her to be born in a higher realm.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-11-image-125-47238c265c12.webp)

At the age of twenty, she passed away. The moment the soul left the body, two gods riding white elephants appeared. Two huge white elephants, surrounded by halos. They came to take her to the underworld. At that time, Bach Binh did not want to leave, just wanted to stay in the human world, but the two gods made it clear: "This is the decree of Lord Yama."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-11-image-126-538e49577671.webp)

She complied, rode on the back of a white elephant, and flew through the heavens. Looking down from above, she saw a breathtakingly beautiful scene: endless blue sky, white clouds drifting lazily, bright yellow sunshine, vast ocean, and lush green forests. That scene was no different from a fairyland.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-11-image-127-063e74118f33.webp)

But suddenly, in the midst of that beautiful scene, a giant black hole appeared. The two gods led her straight down. That black hole is the entrance to the underworld. Here, she met Diem Chua, his body was large and majestic, his eyes seemed to penetrate all karma. He welcomed her and said: although she was dead, she was a person of great merit. For many generations, he kept the precepts, was vegetarian, practiced at home, was filial, pure, had no husband or children, and was pure in body and mind. Therefore, according to the decree of her superiors, she was ordained to govern the prisoners in the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-11-image-128-1694c619eb18.webp)

With this position, she is free to move around in the underworld and hell. But if she wants to go to heaven or earth, she must resign from her position. On her first day in office, she met an old neighbor. This person was thrown into hell because of petty theft. Her punishment was to have her fingernails and toenails removed, tendons pulled, and then stuffed back into her throat with the things she had stolen. The pain was so painful that the soul screamed endlessly. The neighbor could only cry and say: "If I had known such a terrible punishment, I would not have dared to take even the smallest thing."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-11-image-129-3c7c801e61be.webp)

She also met another acquaintance who specialized in illegally cutting valuable wood. Despite using the excuse of poverty, this person was still tied up by Devil Sai, his body was cut into three pieces like sawing a tree, and then thrown to the crocodile to eat. The sound of sawing and flesh being torn apart echoed throughout the prison door. After that, she was taken to visit the gates of hell. 
At a prison door, a rain of blades fell from the sky. The knife pierced the head, eyes, body, blood spurted out like a stream, and the flesh was torn to shreds. She stood and watched, her limbs shaking. At the icy prison door, naked sinners are crushed to death by falling snow, die and then come back to life.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-11-image-130-b2db131bb5af.webp)

She was moved by compassion and recited Nam-Mo-A-Di-Da-Buddha. Immediately, the ice and snow stopped falling, and Bodhi leaves appeared at her feet. But Ghost Sai immediately stopped him, saying he must not interfere with karma.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-11-image-131-b40d073992a4.webp)

At the door of the burning prison, sinners are burned alive, their flesh sizzles like grilled meat, their mouths breathe fire, their hands and feet are chained tightly to iron beds. Struggling in despair but unable to escape. Finally, after a long period of governing, she asked the King of Hell for permission to come to earth to visit. And on that trip, she met our group. Her only wish: to recite Buddha's name every day. We connected her and took her to the temple to study, so that she could feel secure in continuing her path of practice. 
Before leaving, Mrs. Bach Binh's ghost said one thing: "Do everything you do, think carefully. Don't wait until you go to the underworld to regret it. Save yourself through the path of practice." Her story is not only a horror picture of hell, but also a cold warning: the law of yin is not wrong, no matter how small, karma is not lost. Living people listen to wake up, evildoers listen to be afraid, and good people listen to reassure themselves on the right path.

tieu_de: Story 12: The Cruel Dog Thief
tom_tat: On the journey of the mission to save the dead, every time we receive instructions from Tien Ong, we understand a little more about the absolute severity of the law of cause and effect. There are souls who meet us...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 12: THE CRUEL DOG THIEF**}

On the journey of the mission to save the dead, every time we receive instructions from the Mountain Immortal, we understand a little more about the absolute severity of the law of cause and effect. There are souls who, upon meeting us, have gone through levels of hell so painful that their memories are erased, their names no longer exist, and their hometowns are completely forgotten. It's not because they don't want to remember, but because the pain is so intense that it causes confusion in their six senses and their minds are shattered. Today, we continue with the story of a couple, in which the main character is the wife - a ghost that we temporarily call Ms. Anh, because she herself can no longer remember her real name. This story is not only horror, but also a bloody warning for those who live by killing, stealing and plotting to harm others. After receiving instructions from the Fairy God, our group prepared a simple ceremony and went to the exact location where the ghost was residing.

When the ghost appeared, Ms. Anh was in an extremely emaciated state, her energy was exhausted, her spiritual body was trembling, her eyes were panicked as if she had just stepped out of hell fire. She has just finished serving her punishment in the underworld. Being beaten, tortured, and tortured so much that it hurt so much that I forgot my name and who I was. Someone asked: "Can you recite Buddha's name when going to hell?" The answer is impossible. In extreme pain, mental confusion, not even remembering my name, how can I maintain mindfulness?

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-12-image-133-b7d3548fba95.webp)

Ms. Anh's husband - we call him Mr. Ba. The couple got married when they were very young. During the day, they open a small car repair shop, seemingly an honest profession. But when night falls, the true face is revealed. At night, the couple stole dogs, cats, chickens, and ducks. If you can't steal it, then spread nails right on the road near your car repair shop. Anything that sells for money – aluminum pots, scrap iron, metal objects – they steal. If they steal a fat dog with delicious meat, they will kill it, process it into a seven-dish dog, grill it, steam it, and serve it to guests from A to Z.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-12-image-134-cf7283cfb096.webp)

When customers book in advance, they are ready to steal it. Unlike the forced cases, this couple was completely voluntary and plotted together. That's why the retribution is many times heavier. Their hometown is sparsely populated. When there were no more thieves in the village, they moved to the next village.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-12-image-135-004a0b78f395.webp)

And then, even if you walk at night, you will encounter ghosts. One fateful night, Mr. Ba targeted a house with puppies and a mother dog. In just a moment, he caught them all and stuffed them into a sack. But before he could escape, he was discovered by the homeowner and captured on the spot. People in the village, who already hated dog theft, immediately shouted.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-12-image-136-feac8684e1f0.webp)

Mr. Ba was beaten to death on the spot, his body covered in blood. The motorbike was burned to cinders. Ms. Anh was able to run away, narrowly escaping. Receiving her husband's body, she held a funeral.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-12-image-137-e6dc648a6989.webp)

But karma does not stop because of the funeral. After her husband died, Ms. Anh continued spreading nails and repairing cars to earn money. Collect prices arbitrarily: if you see someone who is rich, you will cut them handsomely, if you see someone who is poor, you will take a little. The blood of killing has seeped deep. Thinking of dogs means thinking of plum meat, the addiction to meat cannot be stopped. 
One day, she continued stealing cats and dogs, and on the eighth cat, she was bitten deeply on her hand and had to get vaccinated.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-12-image-138-b84361af73c2.webp)

Less than a week later, she stole another dog and was slapped again. Thinking that she had just finished getting vaccinated, she subjectively did not get vaccinated again. Ten days later, while cooking for her neighbors, she rolled over and howled like a dog, her mouth was foaming, she was scratching the floor, her eyes were wild. People tied her up and took her to the hospital. The doctor concluded: rabies has entered the brain and cannot be saved. Two days later, she died in a struggle. As soon as the soul leaves the body, the devil immediately drags it down to the underworld. Discussing merits and crimes are as dense as mountains: killing, stealing, spreading nails to harm people, creating organized evil karma.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-12-image-139-3b4ba5fc775d.webp)

In prison, Ms. Anh saw her husband being punished. Huge nails pierced Mr. Ba's body. The rain of nails fell from above, piercing the head and chest, bleeding continuously. Without stopping, the devil ordered him to cut him into pieces, removing his intestines, liver, eyes, and brain. Each time he fainted, he regained consciousness and continued to endure exile.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-12-image-140-127bb0ccb932.webp)

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-12-image-141-358fca6071b2.webp)

When it was Ms. Anh's turn, her punishment was to stuff giant nails into her mouth, tear her throat, and then cut her to pieces. The pain was so painful that he lost all concept of time.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-12-image-142-59ee43ca7c83.webp)

Mr. Ba was sentenced to about 200 years, and Ms. Anh was sentenced to 50 years. In hell, each year is as long as a thousand lifetimes. There are souls that have not been able to reincarnate for hundreds or thousands of years. After serving her punishment, thanks to the karma of Buddhism from a long ago life, Ms. Anh was instructed by the Fairy God to meet our group. After receiving offerings and instructions, she agreed to return to the temple to practice - an extremely rare blessing. Before leaving, Ms. Anh's death reminded the worldly people: "Never do jobs related to killing and stealing. His crime is very serious, so heavy that no one can bear it for him." This story is a chilling wake-up call. A little immediate benefit can be exchanged for hundreds of years of hell. A human life is difficult, please do not sell your conscience and then have to pay the price with terrible punishments that cannot be described in words.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of DOG THIEF, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 13: Sparing Neither the Young nor the Old
tom_tat: People often say: "If life is evil, let it be, death is the end." That thought has made many people commit crimes without fear. But if I once heard the souls from the underworld tell...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 13: SPARING NEITHER THE YOUNG NOR THE OLD**}

People often say: "If life is evil, let it be, death is the end." That thought has made many people commit crimes without fear. But if one hears stories from souls from the underworld, perhaps no one will dare to take the words cause and effect lightly. 
Hell is not a story to scare children, nor is it a product of the imagination. That is the place of true existence, where all sins are exposed and paid for with punishments far beyond the endurance of any living being. Today, on our journey to save the dead, we met a spirit named Hoan - who had just finished suffering a hellish punishment lasting hundreds of years. What the ghost recounted was a series of days of such agony that when the soul returned to earth, it was no longer able to speak and could only scream in fear.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-143-a03ad20fd01e.webp)

Hoan's story is not just a tragedy, but a cold warning for the living. The day we met Vong Hoan, the space where Vong resided was unusually cold. Vong appeared with a distorted appearance, his body was opaque, his mouth was open but he could not utter a word.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-144-5bb7ae11a540.webp)

Only intermittent sounds of "ah... a..." came out from his throat, sounding like the sound of a wounded animal stuck in an iron trap. After using the seal and performing the opening ceremony, it took a long time before the deceased could speak again.
Every sentence that came out trembled, as if just mentioning the word "hell" would cause that soul to be dragged back down to that dark place again.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-145-3716c132f866.webp)

Hoan said that from the moment he was born, his biological parents abandoned him. But fate brought death to a rich, gentle family that adopted him. His adoptive parents loved Hoan like his own blood, provided him with adequate education, and did not lack anything. As Hoan grew older, he became more handsome and was constantly praised by people.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-146-035e5ce0a229.webp)

But it is that unconditional pampering that ruins a person. Hoan doesn't know how to work, doesn't know how to appreciate money, he's only used to playing and enjoying himself. When Hoan turned eighteen, tragedy struck: his adoptive parents died suddenly, leaving Hoan a huge fortune.
Without a single real tear falling, Hoan accepted everything as a gift from heaven.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-147-5eb95d0fa7df.webp)

Before that, two neighboring families had made a marriage contract. After the funeral, Hoan asked the girl to marry him. The wedding took place splendidly, everyone thought Hoan was a lucky person. After getting married, Hoan did not do business, sold all the assets left by his adoptive parents, gave the money to his wife's parents to keep, and then returned to live with his son-in-law. Some time later, Hoan and his wife gave birth to a daughter. The tragedy began when his wife's parents contracted a strange disease that could not be cured. Instead of worrying, Hoan began to pay attention to asset division.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-148-47571b350b82.webp)

The wife's family is very rich, there is also a brother-in-law with two sons. Hoan's greed gradually turned into loneliness. Hoan discussed with his wife to buy poison and secretly poisoned his two nephews. The medicine slowly absorbed, causing the two children to weaken and wither like a tree with its life drained. Ten days later, both died in pain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-149-295b6c75d381.webp)

Not stopping, Hoan continued to poison his brother-in-law. Then he plotted to slander his sister-in-law, pushing her out of the family with nothing. Finally, Hoan silently put a high dose of poison into his wife's parents' porridge. In just one afternoon, two more lives passed away. Five lives were lost without knives or guns, but the crime was colder than blood.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-150-ad8a3270ae67.webp)

In a drunken state, Hoan bragged about his crimes. Hoan's wife heard everything. Hatred smolders. One day, the wife put poison in the food. After Hoan finished eating, he vomited blood, collapsed, and died in the cold eyes of the person on his knee. As soon as Hoan's soul separated from his body, before he could regain his composure, two ghosts with faces as black as coal and eyes as red as embers rushed towards him.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-151-b2f5783ef4e1.webp)

Without saying a word, they used an iron chain the size of a wrist, cold as ice, to wrap tightly around Hoan's neck, arms and legs. Every time the chain tightened, Hoan's soul seemed to be crushed piece by piece, in so much pain that he screamed but the sound was swallowed up in nothingness. The ghost dragged Hoan on the dark road, under his feet was mud mixed with blood and pus, the fishy smell rushed straight to his mind, making Hoan's soul tremble in fear.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-152-abb8efe78d6c.webp)

In front of the King's Palace, the space was suffocatingly gloomy. The glimmering light from the blue flames clearly illuminated the five unjust souls waiting. Their faces were distorted, their eye sockets were sunken, their bodies were devastated, their mouths were open, screaming for their lives. The cry of injustice resounded like thunder, hitting straight into Hoan's soul, causing his whole body to tremble. Hoan knelt down, still trying to argue: "I didn't kill them... I didn't do it..."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-153-74202063da9d.webp)

Immediately, the Judge ordered the Mirror to be examined. The black glass, like a bottomless pit, suddenly lit up. In it, each scene appears more clearly than a living person can see: each drop of poison that Hoan secretly put into a bowl of porridge, each cunning look, each fake smile, each night Hoan lay awake calculating to kill more people to gain property. Not only the actions, but also the cruel thoughts in his mind appeared, without missing a single detail. Hoan screamed, held his head, tried to turn away but couldn't. Each image is like a knife stabbed straight into the soul, making Hoan extremely desperate.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-154-cf799fa9fc31.webp)

The Lord of Hell delivered a cold voice like a thunderbolt in hell: "Fall to Hell Thiet Tru!" Immediately, Hoan was dragged away by the devil. In Thiet Tru hell, red iron pillars penetrate deep into the ground, hot steam rises, distorting the air. The ghost hooked Hoan's feet with iron hooks and hung him upside down high. Each sharp, cold knife cut open Hoan's stomach, his intestines were pulled out, hanging, thick black blood poured out, falling to the ground and hissing smoke. Before Hoan could faint, the devil used a sharp iron whip to whip him. With each whip, the flesh is crushed, the skin is torn, blood is splattered, and the bones are exposed white. The sound of the whip screeching mixed with ear-piercing screams echoed throughout hell.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-155-fe86ed7f2284.webp)

When his body was no longer intact, the devil threw Hoan into a deep pit full of sharp iron spikes. The entire soul's body was pierced like a porcupine, spikes pierced through the chest, abdomen, and throat, causing Hoan so much pain that he could only howl in despair. But before it could disintegrate, the soul was pulled up again to continue suffering another punishment.
After Thiet Tru, Hoan was banished to Bat Thiet hell. Here, the ghost used iron clamps to clamp Hoan's tongue, stretching it out bit by bit, the tongue was torn open, blood flowed into streams. Hoan was forced to open his mouth wide, swallowing burning embers, his throat was burned, black smoke spewed from his mouth. Next was boiling red copper, poured straight into the throat, spreading down to the internal organs, burning from the inside. Not stopping yet, the devil ordered Hoan to be locked in a giant steamer. The steam is as hot as fire, the skin gradually cooks, peels off in pieces, falling to the bottom of the pot. Every time the skin falls off, the soul is forced to recover to continue absorbing from the beginning. There was no fainting, no death, just endless pain, year after year.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-13-image-156-7302e5f5c1d5.webp)

Hoan said tremblingly with tears and extreme fear: "In hell... there is no death to escape. There is only pain... eternal pain... and late regret." When he met us, Vong Hoan was still trembling in fear. Before going to the temple to practice, he only asked for one thing: "Tell mortals that hell is real." Hoan's story is a bloody and tearful wake-up call. Don't think death is the end. Don't sell your conscience for short-term benefits. Because once the cause has been sown, the result will definitely come - sooner or later, whether on earth or in hell.

tieu_de: Story 14: Blind Passion Without Escape
tom_tat: Young people who are in love, if possible, should read this story completely. Not to be afraid, but to understand that there are relationships, once entangled with attachment, there is a price to pay...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 14: BLIND PASSION WITHOUT ESCAPE**}

Young people who are in love, if possible, should read this story completely. Not to be afraid, but to understand that there are relationships that, once entangled with attachment, the price to pay can last for many lifetimes.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-157-1fa4046b1d53.webp)

That night, following the Mountain Immortal's instructions, our group found a deserted area at the edge of the village. There was an old mango tree with a rough trunk and broken branches hanging like the withered arms of a dead man. The surrounding air was unusually cold, even though there was no wind. As soon as the incense stick was lit, a female spirit appeared. She was climbing on a mango tree, her figure blurred, her long hair covering half of her face. Suddenly, the branch made a dry "crack" sound and broke. The female spirit fell straight to the ground. Not a painful physical fall, but pent-up humiliation and resentment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-158-e24cb919e1da.webp)

She burst into tears, her cries echoing in the middle of the night as if someone had torn her heart apart. Seeing that, we approached, both comforting and explaining.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-159-372deb341fda.webp)

It took a long time for the crying to gradually subside. Finally, the ghost girl nodded and agreed to follow us back to the temple. Before leaving, she would like to tell her story — the story of four lives, four loves, and four painful deaths.
FIRST LIFE – POVERTY BUT FULL OF MEANING

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-160-4ec72d42537b.webp)

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-161-e6d7fece0807.webp)

In her first life, she was an ordinary woman. She got married at the age of twenty-five, her husband was three years older than her. Two people came together with empty hands, no land, no money, only love as capital. Life is poor but warm. The couple saved every meal, worked hard, hoping that one day they could change their lives. But because of too much work, the husband fell seriously ill when he was only thirty-nine years old.

She ran everywhere to borrow money for treatment. The sympathetic villagers also helped, but her husband's condition worsened and he could not survive. Her husband died, leaving her at the age of thirty-six — still young, still beautiful. Many rich and powerful people came to ask for her hand in marriage. But she shook her head at all. She vowed to worship her husband and live alone until she breathed her last at the age of seventy-eight. Descending to the underworld, the King of Hell praised her virtue, saying that she lived a virtuous and meaningful life and did not do bad things. He told her to be reincarnated into a wealthy government family. But she knelt down, tears falling: "I don't need wealth. I just want to see my husband again."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-162-d220adea16bd.webp)

SECOND LIFE – MEET AGAIN, BUT AT THE WRONG TIME

The King of Hell said that her husband was reincarnated a long time ago. If you want to meet again, there is only one way: accept being born in poverty, reincarnated in the same neighborhood as that person. She did not hesitate and immediately chose the path of suffering. In this life, she was born into a poor family. Her mother and her children make a living by renting clothes. Life is difficult every day. At the age of sixteen, when she had just reached the age of love, she suddenly remembered her past life. She knew clearly that the fifty-three year old man in the neighborhood was her husband in her previous life.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-163-fa0790dd9120.webp)

She went to his house and said frankly: "In my previous life, you were my husband. In this life, I still only want to be with you." The man was startled and did not dare to answer. Her mother heard the story and was angry, thinking that he had seduced her daughter. She scolded and insulted him severely. The man was frustrated, clutching his chest, collapsed and died of a heart attack at the age of fifty-seven. Hearing the news, she ran to the grave and cried until she was exhausted. From then on, he stopped eating, suffered mental breakdown, and died at the age of twenty. The attachment still does not disappear. Going down to the underworld, she asked to see her husband again.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-164-a5283ae8d7fd.webp)

THIRD LIFE – TWO SISTERS, ONE LIFE

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-165-3a7f8d0b4665.webp)

This time, fate teased. She and her ex-husband were reincarnated as twin sisters in the same family. The older sister who was born first was her husband in her previous life. As for her, born later, she is the younger sister who always listens and loves her sister unconditionally.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-166-562f082f3c34.webp)

In the neighborhood there is a guy named C, from a powerful family, good at studying, and handsome. Both sisters fell in love with him. But Mr. C only loves his younger brother. The jealous older sister cursed and insulted her younger sister every day. The younger sister endured everything, still loved her sister, and did not dare to protest. Cornered, she drank poison.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-167-d0994ddaacfc.webp)

Cannot be saved. The sister and mother were frightened and secretly buried her body in the garden, planting flowers to hide it. Mr. C waited for three years. In the end, because of their identical appearance, he married the older sister — as a painful replacement. But the marriage quickly fell apart. In regret and obsession, the older sister went to her brother's grave to apologize, then also chose death for herself.
FOURTH LIFE – LATE LET GO

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-14-image-168-bd9866daf886.webp)

When he went down to the underworld again, Lord Diem asked: "Do you still want to reunite?" For the first time, she shook her head. She realized that love, if it is just attachment, will only bring suffering. Being reincarnated in the fourth life. But that life has passed more than four hundred years. After death, she refused to be reincarnated, wandering the world, wandering until the day she met us. Before returning to the temple, she only said one sentence: "Please send a message to mortals... Don't promise things you can't keep. Because of an oath, you may have to pay for it with many lifetimes of suffering." The story ends with the sound of the temple bell ringing in the middle of the night. Believe it or not is up to you. But if you are in love, love with awareness. Because there are love relationships... that don't end in separation, but in reincarnation.
