tieu_de: Story 15: The Corpse Beneath the Bed
tom_tat: In human life, adultery is often considered a moral mistake, a crack in marriage. But few people really think that, behind those seemingly "unholy" moments of desire...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 15: THE CORPSE BENEATH THE BED**}

In human life, adultery is often considered a moral mistake, a crack in marriage. But few people really think that behind those moments of desire that seem to "harm no one", there can be a terrible chain of karma, lasting not only within a person's life but also beyond the boundary of life and death.
The story below is told during the mission of the Salvation Mission, where wandering souls are enlightened and led to a place of practice. Believe it or not is each person's right, but if you are living in a love relationship, marriage or family, this is a story worth pondering. Because it not only talks about adultery, but also the consequences of betrayal, insulting the gods and crimes driven by lust. The main character in the story is a female spirit who cannot remember her real name. For convenience, we call her Ms. Ca. This is not just a horror story, but a verdict of cause and effect, a wake-up call for those who disregard morality and ethics.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-169-dea67ed785b4.webp)

Ms. Ca got married for the first time when she was twenty-three years old. That marriage produced two children. But her happiness did not last long, she betrayed her husband, had an affair and left with her lover, becoming her second husband. 
With this husband, she continued to give birth to two more children. She thought she was at peace, but her passion for stimulation and the feeling of being sneaky and wrong made her unable to stop. Once again, she had an affair, leaving her second husband for another man - her third husband. With her third husband, she gave birth to another child. But when the child was eight years old, her habit of adultery resurfaced. The only difference is that the third husband - called Mr. Tai - is incredibly patient. Even though he knew his wife was having an affair, he still endured it silently, just hoping to keep the family for his children. It was that patience that later became his greatest injustice.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-170-bafb46e8c7fd.webp)

Occasionally, when he caught his wife eating, drinking, and having fun with her lover right in his own house, he just remained silent. When his lover left, he gently begged: "Go back to your family. As for the children... I won't blame you." That patience did not awaken Ms. Ca. On the contrary, the more she despises morality, the more she considers betrayal to be normal.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-171-5d71e2a82982.webp)

Once returning home from work, Mr. Tai picked up an altar of the God of Wealth - Tho Dia that was thrown away on the side of the road. He brought it home, cleaned it, and worshiped it carefully. From that day on, every time Ms. Ca brought her lover home to have fun, Mr. Tai was surprised to see her, even though he came home from work very late. Ms. Ca does not believe in spirituality, does not believe in cause and effect.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-172-62336081b8b3.webp)

She thought it was just a coincidence. Until one night, she dreamed of two gods wearing brocade clothes and serious faces. A cold voice rang out: "Do you know why every time you have sex with your lover, your husband finds out? It was a dream we had."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-173-7a4160b6f2be.webp)

She woke up in fear but did not repent. The next morning she knelt before the altar of the God of Wealth - Tho Dia, not to repent, but to ask the gods not to point out her husband anymore, so that she could rest assured that her adultery would not be bothered. She promised to make full offerings.
Sure enough, since then Mr. Tai has not been seen again. But the god gave a dream to the neighbor. The incident broke out and neighbors witnessed it with their own eyes. In anger, Ms. Ca threw the statue of the God of Wealth - Tho Dia into the river, officially insulting the god. From here, evil karma begins to bear fruit.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-174-8db5fcdc4f1d.webp)

Together with her lover, Ms. Ca planned to murder Mr. Tai. Late at night, when Mr. Tai was fast asleep, Ms. Ca held Mr. Tai's head for her lover to cut off, causing Mr. Tai's head in one place, his body in another, and blood all over the room. The crime took place in cold silence.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-175-f0238f9e86d8.webp)

His body was buried right under the bed - the place that used to be the resting place for the two of them. After that, the two criminals were still alive, still sleeping on that same bed, underneath was the undissolved body. Since then, every night, cries of anguish resound from the ground.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-176-a54568172d21.webp)

Mr. Tai's unjust soul appeared, harassing and wailing. But the two villains were still not afraid. Until Mr. Tai told his father in a dream. The dream was terrifyingly real.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-177-5d43844ba3f7.webp)

The next morning, the father led someone to dig under the bed and discovered the horrifying truth.
Ms. Ca and her lover were arrested. In the camp, she constantly saw Mr. Tai appearing, his eyes staring angrily. Some time later, she went crazy and died in detention.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-178-014249c764ea.webp)

When her soul left her body, Ca was dragged down to the underworld by the devil. The air here is cold to the bone, not the cold of the world, but the cold that makes the soul tremble. In front of the King's Palace, her crime was read clearly:
 – Having an affair many times
 – Murdering people
 – Insulting the gods

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-179-c3f2ba9497c6.webp)

Ms. Ca was pushed onto a high platform, in front of her was a giant mirror with three words written on it: Reflecting Mirror. Here we do not torture the body, but torture the consciousness. In the air appeared every scene of her life when she was still alive: 
– The times of secret adultery
– The painful eyes of my husband and children
– The moment Mr. Tai knelt down and begged
With each image that appeared, her heart was squeezed, a hundred times more painful than when she was alive. Even if you want to close your eyes, you can't. Here, the sinner is forced to look directly at himself. 
Without further consideration, the King of Hell ruled: “Impose the most severe punishment.” She was dragged away by the devil, in front of her was the Gate of Hell, towering high, carved with screaming faces, eyes wide open, mouths wide open in eternal pain. The ghost said coldly: "This is a place where there is no injustice. There is only cause and effect."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-180-5f39ea45d7c3.webp)

This place is dark, with only the sound of dripping water and the strong smell of blood. Two cold iron hooks slowly approached. Not a quick hook, but a slow hook, letting each painful moment last forever. When the soul's eyes were pulled out of their sockets, Ca could still see - seeing her own eyes being gouged out, seeing the sin reflected in them. The ghost said: "Your eyes used to see lies. Now let your eyes see hell." The devil continued to torture her soul. The sharp points went from ear to ear, back to belly. Each time through, the memories of the betrayals come back, resonating with the pain that almost breaks the soul. There is no fainting here. Hell does not allow pain to stop even for 1 second.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-181-a1a20534883b.webp)

She was sent by the devil to push her into a prison door, with countless bronze pillars standing in the middle of a sea of ​​fire. But the fire did not burn fiercely, but smoldered, dark red like embers. Ms. Ca's soul was pressed tightly against the column. It doesn't burn up in an instant. But it melts little by little, from the skin, to the bones, to the consciousness. High above, a flock of black crows waits. When the soul's body begins to crack, they rush down, pecking at the head, sucking up brain fluid - the more painful the memory, the more enjoyable it is.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-182-864fa9e58c68.webp)

At the next prison door, Ms. Ca was placed on a stone chopping block. Everything happened exactly like the way she and her lover did with Mr. T when they were alive. Don't miss a single detail, don't die, don't end. The devil said coldly: "As you sow, so will you reap." After beheading Ms. Ca, her tongue stuck out. The Devil used a hook to pull and cut. Each cut is not intended to kill, but to prolong consciousness in pain. Here, the screams do not become sounds, only vibrate in consciousness.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-183-c7a3175d5ac4.webp)

After finishing this prison, Sister Ca was thrown into the river of the underworld - a place colder than all the cold on earth combined. The water here does not kill, but freezes the soul. She had to grope in the endless darkness to find the two statues of the God of Wealth and Tho Dia that she had offended. Every time I was about to touch it, the water swept me away, prolonging the endless despair. As soon as he emerged from the river, the devil was waiting. No need to ask, just hit. Every blow is a reproach. The soul is smashed and then gathered again, gathered and then dissolved again.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-15-image-184-4cdc1ac4920a.webp)

The punishments in hell are terrible, far exceeding the pain of earth. That is a worthy payment for what she has done - not only with her body, but also with her soul. After a long time of being punished, Ms. Ca finally finished her punishment, but considering that her life on earth was still there, she was sent to earth as a hungry and thirsty ghost. She had to face herself, with her late regret that seemed to last forever. Twenty years later, thanks to the Mountain Immortal's guidance, the rescue group found Ms. Ca, opened her eyes, and took her to the temple to practice. That is a rare blessing remaining after a long chain of evil karma.  
Believe it or not is everyone's right. But if you are in love or living in marriage, remember: There are pleasures that only last a moment, but their karma can last a lifetime - even more.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of THE DEAD UNDER THE BED, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 16: The Vast, Inescapable Net of Heaven
tom_tat: The ancients said: "The sky's net is vast, although it is thin, it is difficult to penetrate." There are people who live their whole lives in scheming, using the blood of others to build their own stairs, thinking that they only need to change one layer of clothing...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 16: THE VAST, INESCAPABLE NET OF HEAVEN**}

The ancients said: "The sky's net is vast, although it is thin, it is difficult to penetrate." There are people who live their whole lives in scheming, using the blood of others as a ladder for themselves, thinking that just by changing a layer of clothing, changing an identity, they can escape retribution. But the cause and effect doesn't need to be urgent, it just needs to be heavy enough. The story of Boc - a man who lived in ancient times - is the clearest proof. His crime lies not only in the act of murder, but also in his cruel mind, false cultivation, breaking the precepts, deceiving Buddha and deceiving people. And when his soul fell into hell, what awaited was no longer death, but pain that lasted for countless eons. Boc was originally a servant in a mandarin's palace. Thanks to his agility and ability to bend, he was trusted by the mandarins and became a close friend. But that favor grew in him arrogance and hatred. Being ordered around, beaten and scolded, he did not see it as a servant's duty but as a humiliation that needed to be paid. From small things, he began to push others to death.

Just because he wanted to anger the official, he deliberately gave the wrong orders, causing an innocent servant to be tortured to death. Another time, he secretly poured oil under the carpet, causing the mandarin to slip and fall, and another servant had to suffer the death penalty. Two people died unjustly, but in Boc's heart there was not a trace of regret.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-16-image-185-ba4b213a9504.webp)

Resentment accumulates like venom. Finally, Boc decided to destroy the entire mandarin's family. He bought extremely strong, colorless, odorless poison and dissolved it into the dish. Before that, he cleverly found a way to let all the servants out, leaving only the mandarin, two wives and a few trusted people. The meal that day was normal. But after only half an hour, the poison began to take effect. The mandarin clutched his stomach and writhed, his eyes rolling back, his mouth foaming with white foam. The two ladies screamed, vomited black blood, and their whole bodies convulsed. The remaining people died in prolonged pain, their intestines felt like they were being torn apart from the inside. Boc pretended to be poisoned, rolled around, groaned, and acted to the point that no one would suspect him. When everyone thought he was dead, he was taken to be buried. It was dark, he quickly escaped when others weren't paying attention, with the gold and silver already buried. Seven lives in exchange for a life of escape. Later, Bo put on his monk's robe. The mouth chants sutras but the heart is full of desire. He ate salty food, tricked his fellow monks into eating meat, and seriously broke the precepts.

When discovered, he was kicked out of the temple, then returned to destroy the Buddha statue, the altar, and insulted the Three Jewels - a crime on top of a crime. Not stopping, he built a temple, cheated people of money, and turned the place of worship into a place of prostitution. In the end, it was his greed that led to his end: being murdered by his accomplices in a basement full of gold and silver.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-16-image-186-82f82348dcc6.webp)

As soon as the soul left the body, the devil did not tie him up or judge him, just a black hand like an iron nail pulled Boc straight to hell. There was no light, only screams and cries echoed from all four directions. He fell into the sea of ​​fire. Hell's fire does not burn but corrodes every fiber of the soul. "I don't know when I died. I just remember the moment the cold blade pierced my chest, blood spurted out like a stream, then the darkness was not fainting, but being pulled out of the world. There was no judgment. There was no mercy. A hand as black as hot iron, with long, winding nails, grabbed the back of the soul's neck, pulling me down. Not falling in a straight line, but being torn apart in space, my ears ringing with the screams of tens of thousands of other souls."
Vong Boc recounted:
"I fell into a sea of fire. There was no bottom. There was no shore. Only fire. Hell's fire is not like earthly fire. It does not burn to the end, but gradually eats, savoring every fiber of the soul like a wild animal nibbling at its prey. The skin burns first. The flesh boils later. The bones are as red as coal.

I screamed, but the scream was burned by fire right in my throat. Every time I inhale, fire fills my lungs, and my lungs explode like thin bags of skin. When the whole body turns into ash, a cold air sweeps through, the body grows fully again, to continue being burned. One day. One year. One hundred years. No one counts. I only know that 700 years have passed in the fire, but my consciousness is still intact to endure the pain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-16-image-187-5764e1c21375.webp)

I was pulled out of the sea of ​​fire by the devil and thrown straight to a steep mountain. Mountains have no rocks. Only knives. The knife is stuck as thick as grass. The blade is thin, curved, and so sharp that just a light touch causes the skin to separate from the meat. "Climb." Demons don't need to fight. Just one word. I climb. With each step, the hand was split into many pieces, the nails peeled off, clinging to the blade of the knife. The knee was split open, the bone scraped against the steel and made a screeching sound. The blood did not drip but poured down like red rain. Reaching the top, I collapsed. The devil ordered a strong kick. I fall. Knives pierce through people like a forest of spears. Before hitting the ground, the body was put back together and forced to continue climbing. I don't know how many times. Only know until consciousness can no longer distinguish where the pain is. I have been stripped clean. Not clothes – but skin. In front of it is a giant copper column, glowing red, the heat distorting the air. "Hug." I touch. The skin sticks together like melted fat. Each time it slid down, a piece of flesh was torn off, leaving behind a bronze column covered in blood and human skin.

Before I could fall to the ground, the devil used an iron whip to whip me hard, cracking my spine, forcing me to climb back up. Climb - slip - tear - fall. Repeat. Continuous. The smell of burning flesh mixed with the smell of blood was so strong that it made even the soul nauseous. Our body is stretched. A devil holds the head. A devil holds the leg. "Drag." The tearing sound did not come from flesh, but from consciousness being torn in half. The upper half was dipped into boiling copper, metal foam poured into the mouth, nose, and ears. The lower half was placed on the ice bed, so cold that the bones cracked into pieces. Hot – cold – painful – broken. There is no stopping. My mouth was clamped open with an iron clamp. The devil grabbed his tongue and stretched it until it seemed to tear from his throat. The tongue was clamped, rolled, or pinned to the iron table. Embers are stuffed straight into the mouth, can't be swallowed - can't be spit out. Boiling copper poured down his throat and poured out of his nose. Can't faint. Can't die. It's just so painful that you no longer have a concept of yourself. The last place is the longest. The knife mountain is sky high. Below his feet was a sea of ​​boiling blood, in which countless hands pulled down those who fell.

I climb. The knife stabbed from below, blood flowed into the sea. Every time it falls, it is pierced by ten thousand blades, the soul is broken, and then put back together again. No date. There is no night. There is only endless fear. I want to scream: "Let me die!" But hell has no escape from death.”

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-16-image-188-482a754f9cb7.webp)

Thanks to some merit from chanting sutras, he was released to earth to continue suffering. Seventy years of wandering, hunger, thirst, fear, being chased away, and being bullied by others. Only when the conditions were right did he receive instructions and be taken to the temple to truly practice. Boc's story is a living sentence for those who think they can escape cause and effect. Killing, poisoning, false cultivation, breaking the precepts – each crime is recorded, and when paid, not an inch is missing. Hell is not scary because of fire or knives, but because there is no way out for those who have not truly repented. May the world take it as an example: "Don't sow big karma for small gain. Don't put on a monk's robe and harbor evil thoughts. Because the retribution, once it comes, no one will bear it for you."

tieu_de: Story 17: Abortion and Sexual Misconduct
tom_tat: In the human world, there are sins hidden behind desires, disguised with the word "freedom", but when they die, they are all exposed to the law of cause and effect. One can...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 17: ABORTION AND SEXUAL MISCONDUCT**}

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-17-image-189-f82957da7253.webp)

In the human world, there are sins hidden behind desires, disguised with the word "freedom", but when they die, they are all exposed to the law of cause and effect. People can fool people, but no one can fool the law. Today, we look directly at a horrifying retribution, related to the act of not maintaining chastity and abortion, through the case of a ghost named Dao Thi - a soul who was tormented for 500 years in hell. This story was not baselessly passed down by word of mouth, but was known to our group thanks to the Mountain Immortal's advice, who then directly worshiped, revealed, and brought Dao Thi back to the pagoda. What this ghost tells about hell is not for the faint of heart, but is a warning for the living.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-17-image-190-c0516eded9bb.webp)

According to Dao Thi's legend, she was born in feudal times - an era where morality and chastity were considered the roots of women. However, at the age of 25, Dao Thi began to let herself go and seriously indulge in adultery. Initially, she dated 5 men, each for two to three years. These people are all rich, using money and desire to tie her down. In each relationship, she gave birth to a child, a total of 5 children born in relationships without status and without marriage.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-17-image-191-9438f89aa173.webp)

After a period of living alone, Dao Thi continued to deteriorate more severely. This time it's no longer living together, but every day a man, exchanging back and forth like a commodity. During this period, she became pregnant many times, but had no intention of keeping it. Four abortions, one of which was a 7-month-old fetus, with every shape, heart and lung, and pain. In total, Dao Thi was pregnant 9 times: - 5 times giving birth - 4 times having abortions. During her 10th pregnancy, she decided to keep it, but the karma was too heavy. The birth turned out to be dangerous, the baby died stillborn in the mother's womb, and Dao Thi died with her baby, called a difficult birth, carrying extreme resentment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-17-image-192-660dc462b9fd.webp)

As soon as her last breath passed away, before Dao Thi could understand that she was dead, two ghosts with the head of a buffalo and the face of a horse appeared, bound her soul with black iron chains, and dragged her down to the underworld. No time to cry.
No chance to beg. In front of the King of Hell's Palace, the corpses of aborted fetuses were standing all over, deformed, with damaged limbs, crying without making a sound, only emitting a muffled sound like the whistling wind in a deep cave. The eyes they looked at Dao Thi were not the eyes of children, but the eyes of resentment of living beings who were robbed of their right to live.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-17-image-193-7ea367d04aea.webp)

King of Hell's verdict: - Extremely serious adultery - Killing through abortion - Destroying morality, creating deep resentment. Punishment: “Fall into a prison reserved for those who have abortions.”

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-17-image-194-3a42194d28f1.webp)

Dao Thi was dragged by the devil to a black dungeon door, on the gate were engraved blood-red words: "SAT TU CANCER". Inside, the space was horrifyingly noisy: screams, children's cries, the sound of organs being torn apart, the sound of needles piercing flesh. The strong smell of blood and the stench of intestines mixed together, so thick that it was impossible to breathe. The devil did not use the knife immediately. They used their bare hands to thrust straight up from Dao Thi's vagina, hooking deep into her stomach and pulling hard. The internal organs were pulled out, the intestines were torn apart, the liver and lungs were exposed, and blood was gushing out. Dao Thi screamed, but the scream was muffled in her throat, leaving only a gurgling sound like an animal being slaughtered alive.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-17-image-195-7bce38ea5f8c.webp)

After removing the internal organs, the devil used a giant needle to sew the abdomen back stitch by stitch. The needle penetrates the skin, stretches, tightens, and is a thousand times more painful than the pain of childbirth, but does not cause death.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-17-image-196-27627be67ab3.webp)

While executing, the ghost shouted: "This is retribution for those who do not maintain chastity and treat life like trash!" Before stopping, iron dogs and iron birds flew from all directions. They bite and tear the body, chew bones, and tear pieces of flesh, but their consciousness is still intact to feel each pain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-17-image-197-a400c973b98f.webp)

When the body is broken, the soul is restored to continue being tortured. There was no fainting, no ending, only pain that continued year after year.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-17-image-198-18775af7e3d7.webp)

Dao Thi said: "In hell, pain is not a feeling, but a state of existence." For 500 years in earthly time, she lived in that hell, every day hearing the sounds of children crying for their mothers, the sound of demons laughing horribly, and the sound of flesh and skin being torn apart. After 500 years of suffering, thanks to enough karma, Dao Thi was released to earth, met our group, received enlightenment and was taken to the temple to continue repaying karma and be reincarnated.
Through this story, we want to emphasize one thing: "Abortion is no different from murder. Fetuses that are pulled by their arms, legs, eyes gouged out, and thrown away like trash do not disappear, but become unjust spirits holding hatred. The mother is the one who bears the heaviest sin." Many people after abortion have poor health, broken families, and difficult jobs - that is not a coincidence, but karma that has begun to bear fruit. Dao Thi's story is a wake-up call filled with blood and tears. Please be alert and responsible for your body, mind and karma. Never think that death is the end. Never sow evil deeds.

Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 18: Distortion of Truth and Slander
tom_tat: In the human world, people are often afraid of evil retribution from big things: killing people, robbing people, physically harming others. But very few people are afraid of words, because words leave no blood in sight...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 18: DISTORTION OF TRUTH AND SLANDER**}

In the human world, people are often afraid of evil retribution from big things: killing people, robbing people, physically harming others. But very few people are afraid of words, because words do not leave blood before their eyes, and do not make people collapse immediately. However, in the law of cause and effect, speech karma is the most silent, persistent and cruel karma. It is like an invisible knife, slowly cutting into the fate of others, and finally turning back, cutting straight into the very soul of the person who said the words. 
The story of Liu Yizhang is a vivid verdict on the oral profession. A woman who did not directly hold the murder weapon, but only through cruel words, jealousy and manipulation, caused many families to be destroyed, many people's lives to die unjustly, and she personally pushed herself into the most terrible levels of hell.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-18-image-199-a726aca174cc.webp)

Liu Yi Thuong was born into an infertile family. Her parents prayed everywhere to have their only child. That's why, since childhood, Thuong has been pampered without limits. She gets whatever she wants, whatever she says is right, and when she does wrong, no one dares to scold her. That blind love sowed the seeds of disaster. Often growing up with a princess mentality, arrogant, selfish, considering themselves the center of the universe. But the most dangerous thing is not the temperament, but the mouth. She scolds like every day, speaks ill of her like she breathes, says things without thinking, bullies the weak to satisfy her feeling of superiority.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-18-image-200-981f8a535f35.webp)

Every sentence uttered is a poisoned needle, piercing the honor, dignity and life of others. That's why, when he grew up, Luu Nghi Thuong did not have a decent relationship, no one truly loved him, no one dared to stay close for a long time.
In her twilight years, Luu Nghi Thuong fell in love with Mr. An, a man younger than her.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-18-image-201-42e7164cbe0b.webp)

But contrary to that selfish wish, Mr. An had feelings for Mrs. Can, a gentle woman who lived quietly and did not compete. Jealousy in the heart often does not turn into sadness, but into poisonous plans.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-18-image-202-98cca8fd9930.webp)

She set up a dirty slander, deliberately creating "false evidence" in the form of Ms. Can's underwear left behind after a moment of lovemaking with another man, to sow doubt. With a voice full of guidance and salt, she pulled Mr. An to see and aroused his anger.
Thuong's words at that time were no different from a devil's incitement, every sentence and every word carried murderous intent. Mr. An lost control, his anger clouded his reason, leading to a terrible fight. When the madness passed, a life lay down, Mrs. Can lay in a pool of blood, unjust blood had no place to cry.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-18-image-203-f071697d94de.webp)

After that, Liu Yi Thuong left the village and left behind an unnamed grave and a man who was imprisoned. She thought she had escaped. But karma never misses.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-18-image-204-391a194fa351.webp)

In the new land, Luu Nghi Thuong remains unchanged. That mouth continues to spread poison. This time, she targeted the neighbor's family, defamed Mr. Duong and his wife, Mrs. Phi, fabricated stories that did not exist, causing suspicion to spread like an epidemic.
Mr. Duong explained it to his wife, drop by drop, accumulating into resentment. When Mr. Duong saw that his honor was being insulted because of a stranger's fabrication and family discord, his anger exploded. He brought the murder weapon to Thuong. The panicked chase ended at the ditch bank. Before Thuong could call for help, his fate was over. Mr. Duong threw a fork and stabbed her from the back to the chest. She died on the spot, her eyes wide open.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-18-image-205-663023e50932.webp)

Her death was not accidental. That is the direct retribution of verbal karma, the words that come back to kill the very person who created them. As soon as Luu Nghi Thuong's soul left his body, he was tied up by demons and dragged down to the underworld. In front of the King of Hell's Palace, every cruel word she said throughout her life appeared as clearly as engraved on stone.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-18-image-206-c73ed6098931.webp)

Not a single sentence is missing, not a single idea is missing. Lord of Hell said: "You used your mouth as a weapon, causing people to die unjustly and families to be destroyed. This crime cannot be lightened."
She was banished to hell for those who gossip. There, punishment not only torments the body and soul, but attacks directly the root cause of sin. 
Every cruel word that Liu Yi Thuong ever uttered appeared as an image, like thick black smoke, tightly wrapping around her soul. Slanderous words turn into needles piercing the chest, curses turn into strangling barbed wire, words sowing suspicion turn into thin blades cutting along the spine.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-18-image-207-10037919d5a3.webp)

Often pushed by demons into Bat Thiet Hell - This is the most crowded level of hell. Not because many people kill, but because everyone once took words lightly. The space here is dark red, as if stained with dried blood and resentment. The ground was not hard, not soft, but moved, as if made up of countless tongues and mouths piled on top of each other. Punishment does not come en masse, but comes periodically, so that the soul never gets used to the pain. The sinner's tongue is stretched, not by hand, but by the force of karma. Every time the tongue is pulled, the memory of an evil sentence appears clearly: who hears, who gets hurt, who dies because of that sentence. Pain is not just a feeling, but an inescapable awareness. The tongue is then divided into countless segments. Not to end, but to recreate, and then continue to suffer. No blood flows out, because the blood here flows back into the heart, causing fear to grow.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-18-image-208-8f71983780c0.webp)

There is a deeper level where those who cause great karma are sent to. There is no physical torture here. Only audio. Every evil word ever uttered by tens of thousands of spirits was compressed and forced into sound waves. That wave crashed straight into the soul, crushing consciousness like a mill grinding grain. Liu Yi Thuong not only listened to his own words, but also listened to all the evil words of others, overlapping and tearing his mind. It is impossible to distinguish between one's own words and those of others - because verbal karma is inherently contagious. Here, the soul cannot faint. Unforgettable. Can't die. 
The most cruel thing is not torture, but being forced to witness the consequences. Liu Yi Thuong was forced to watch each scene of his family being torn apart because of his words, each moment the resentment spread like a plague. Each tear of another person turned into a drop of hot lead that dripped into her soul. In hell, there is no “I didn't mean it”. Only I caused it.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-18-image-209-92dc0988c09a.webp)

After a long period of suffering, thanks to the remaining blessings and guidance from the Fairy God, my group went to the place of the dead to explain. For the first time in her life, she was truly silent – ​​no argument, no denial, no blame. She understood that: "An evil word may not kill someone right away, but its retribution is never late." Even though she was qualified to be reincarnated, Luu Nghi Thuong voluntarily returned to the temple to practice, because she was afraid that if her mind was not clean and her mouth was not pure, even if she were to reincarnate as a human, she would still continue to sow karma. Luu Nghi Thuong's story is a cold warning to those who take words lightly. In the law of cause and effect, there is no innocent sentence, no word that is "said for fun" without paying a price. Keeping your mouth shut is not only moral, it's saving your soul. Because when cause and effect bear fruit, no one can stand up and speak for them, and hell - as the ghosts tell it - has never been a lie. Hell is not scary because of demons. Hell is not scary because of the punishment.

The scariest thing is: everything is created by yourself. Liu Yi Thuong understood that when it was too late. And her final warning rang out not in sound, but in thought: “Hold your mouth, and keep your life – not your life, but your soul.”

tieu_de: Story 19: Fresh Blood as the Silent Accusation
tom_tat: In the human world, there are coins that are exchanged with sweat. But there are also coins exchanged with blood, with the pitiful cries of murdered creatures. Killing karma is not noisy...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 19: FRESH BLOOD AS THE SILENT ACCUSATION**}

In the human world, there are coins that are exchanged with sweat. But there are also coins exchanged with blood, with the pitiful cries of murdered creatures. Killing karma is not noisy when sown, but when it bears fruit, no one is spared. The story of Moc Linh, which happened more than seven hundred years ago, is a vivid verdict on the law of cause and effect: the one holding the knife is punished, the beneficiary cannot attain liberation, and the relatives standing by are still implicated by shared karma. It's not just a story about death, but a journey through hell, where blood, fire and screams never stop.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-210-fb5ce84e9c85.webp)

Moc Linh was born into a well-off family. But that prosperity does not come from fields or honest work, but from a scalpel. Her father, Moc Tung, killed pigs, buffalos, and cows every day. With each strike of the knife, a life stops breathing, blood flows red in the yard, resentment seeps into every fiber of the ground. Her mother, Linh Huong, took in chickens and ducks to be slaughtered, and her screams echoed throughout the night. Even scarier, Linh Huong also offered dumplings mixed with minced meat to the temple.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-211-ca1dd211ed5f.webp)

The form is offering, but the essence is lying to Buddha, using killing karma in the guise of good karma. The monks do not know, but heaven and earth are not blind. As for Moc Linh, since childhood, she has been afraid of killing. Every time she heard the sound of a pig screaming, she trembled and her heart sank. But not participating does not mean not being involved. She still lives on that blood-stained money.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-212-86ea3ef00cf1.webp)

When Moc Linh turned 20 years old, the killer started to collect debt. During the day, Moc Tung still holds the knife as usual. But at night, he suddenly rolled over, convulsed, his neck turned purple as if he was being strangled.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-213-864dc2bad1fa.webp)

His scream was no longer human, but exactly like the sound of a pig having its throat cut – long, hoarse, desperate. The 84-year-old spiritual teacher who was invited just shook his head: "The karma of killing is too heavy. It can't be saved, it can only help make death easier."
A few days later, Moc Tung died in pain. The family quit the job, but it was too late.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-214-034b410d2315.webp)

Not long after, Linh Huong kept having nightmares: her eyes were pecked out by chickens and ducks, her stomach was crushed by pigs, and her bones were broken by buffaloes.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-215-1e09add62a02.webp)

The abbot looked at her dark seal and said only one sentence: "The karma of killing is added to the crime of deceiving the Buddha. It is difficult to escape."
She fell ill and died, carrying with her a fear that had not yet been resolved.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-216-f68a15cd3439.webp)

Moc Linh lives alone, without a husband or children. At the age of 38, she was bitten by a poisonous snake while cutting firewood and died at home. The moment the breath stops, the sound opens the door.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-217-18fe34e76232.webp)

No light, no direction. The devil took her soul down a dark road thick with the smell of blood. On both sides are countless souls screaming, their bodies distorted, their skin torn - these are the murderers.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-218-82dc94a59659.webp)

Before Moc Linh's eyes, her father - Moc Tung - was being punished. The devil used a sharp iron stick to skewer him from the top of his head straight down to his anus, then turned it over the sea of ​​fire. The meat is sizzling, fat is dripping, and the smell is strong. When his body burned, the devil took out his internal organs, threw them into a pan of boiling oil, and then forced him to eat his own intestines. Every time he screamed, the screams turned into animal sounds - just like the creatures he had killed. Moc Linh recounted:
"My father was suspended in mid-air. Not by a rope, but by two iron hooks that pierced the shoulder blades, hooked backwards. Every time the body moved, the iron hooks would spiral deeper, ripping flesh and bones, emitting a chilling sound like a razor on stone. The ghost was not in a hurry to kill. Here, death was not allowed. A tall ghost, with burnt black skin, his hand holding an iron rod as long as a pillar, sharp tip, glowing red from being burned in the earth's fire. He didn't stab right away. He lightly touched the tip of the iron rod to my father's scalp. With just one touch, the scalp burned and the smell of burning hair rose.

Before the scream could escape, the iron rod stabbed straight down from the top of the head, pierced the brain, throat, chest, abdomen, and locked in the anus. There was no blood splashing out like on earth. The blood in hell boils, thickens, turns black, flows back into the body, making the pain unable to escape, but reverberates back into every fiber of the body. Roasting on fire - recreating the death of animals. The devil ordered the iron rod to rotate, exactly like the way mortals rotate meat skewers on embers. My father's body was spun around in a sea of ​​red and blue flames. The flames licked along his skin, burning from the outside to the inside, not missing an inch of flesh. The skin cracks and curls up like a pig's skin when used to burn straw. The fat dripped down and fell into the fire, making a terrifyingly familiar sound - the same sound my father used to hear every day while butchering meat. The most terrible thing: His cry was no longer human. The throat was burned by fire and the iron rod pierced, every time he opened his mouth only came out: - the sound of a pig having its throat cut, - the sound of a cow bellowing when the knife touched the heart, - the sound of a buffalo screaming when its tendons were split.

All the sounds he once considered normal, now converged in his own throat.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-219-901ba6981b2f.webp)

Extracting internal organs - reliving one's own karma When the body was so burned that only the flesh was scorched to the bones, the devil pulled out the iron rod. Not to forgive, but to move on to the next punishment. Another demon uses a large knife with a thick blade, not as sharp as an earthly scalpel but blunt and serrated. He cut open my father's stomach bit by bit, not cutting it all the way, but sawing it, so that every millimeter of skin torn away would prolong the pain. The intestines were exposed, but were not immediately removed. The devil pulled each piece of intestine, smashed it on the hot stone floor, and then threw it into the boiling oil pan next to it. As soon as the internal organs touched the oil, they swelled and exploded, the fishy smell filled the air. Then, the devil forced those things back into my father's mouth. "Eat it. When you're alive, you like it a lot." The mouth was opened, the jaw was broken, and the hot internal organs were stuffed into the throat. If you can't swallow, you have to swallow. Every time I swallow, I feel like my intestines are being taken out and torn apart from the inside. The Lord of Hell spoke down like thunder: “One life for each life.

No matter how many living beings you kill, you will have enough." 
Moc Linh stood watching, her legs were weak, her soul trembled. She understood something cruel but absolutely fair: In hell, there is no injustice. How the knife is held, the body will bear the same. Whoever the fire burns, the fire will burn again.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-220-f3a09a7360fc.webp)

Her mother suffered an even more terrible punishment. Ms. Linh Huong was stripped naked and sat on an iron nail table. The head is wearing a burning dumpling - a symbol of the crime of using killing karma to fake good karma.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-221-92e332c3f79c.webp)

The devil ordered her body to be ground into shreds, then reincarnated as a hungry ghost, forcing her to swallow embers and drink boiling copper.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-222-af27dfe8f2d4.webp)

After that, she was locked in a steaming cage, her skin gradually cooked, peeling off piece by piece.
The screaming never stopped, but no one saved me. The God of Hell said: "After the punishment, be reincarnated as an animal. Pay the blood debt."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-19-image-223-dcf477b3b9e2.webp)

Moc Linh did not commit a serious crime and was allowed to reincarnate early. But her attachment was too strong, she refused. She was taken to the common area in the tenth palace, wandering in pain, watching her parents suffer for hundreds of years. In the 7th lunar month, the lunar door opens. Thanks to the Mountain Immortal's guidance, my group met Moc Linh, opened her eyes and took her to the temple to practice. Moc Linh's story is a chilling warning: the karma of killing does not stop at the killer, but spreads to those who benefit, those who ignore it, and those who consume it. That's called communal karma. If you want to reduce karma, there is no shortcut. Only:
 – Do not kill 
– Be vegetarian, even if only on the 1st and 15th 
– Release animals properly
 – Sincere repentance 
– Reciting Buddha's name, dedicating it to the unjust bondholders,...
Because when the door to the underworld opens, there is no excuse that can save the karma that has been sown.

tieu_de: Story 20: The Ocean Grave of Wandering Souls
tom_tat: There are crimes that are covered up by ocean waves, there are cries that are swallowed by salt water, and there are lives that disappear without leaving a grave. The people who cause these deaths often believe that...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 20: THE OCEAN GRAVE OF WANDERING SOULS**}

There are crimes that are covered up by ocean waves, there are cries that are swallowed by salt water, and there are lives that disappear without leaving a grave. Those who cause these deaths often believe that as long as no one sees, no one will judge. But in the invisible order of the universe, cause and effect need no witnesses. It just takes time. 
Tran Van Thoi's story is a chilling proof of the rule: "If luck runs out, disaster will arise. If retribution does not come early, it will come late." From a poor man in the midst of war, Thoi became rich by selling human lives, and then when he died, his soul had to pay the price in the deepest levels of hell, where every crime was engraved with hundreds, thousands of times more pain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-224-c0fbd22cdb8e.webp)

Tran Van Thoi lived during a chaotic period of war, when the law was fragile and human lives were disregarded. Initially, he was just a poor man, invited by his friends to work as a transporter across the border, taking gold as wages. The first trips went smoothly, gold gradually accumulated, houses became more spacious, life changed rapidly. But at that moment, greed awakened. Thoi realized that people who cross the border often bring with them a fortune – gold, gems, cash – because they know they may never return.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-225-59fa2013fc92.webp)

A cruel thought arose: if we didn't bring them to shore, no one would know they were dead. So the trains changed direction.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-226-03a6a157d77a.webp)

Instead of landing safely, Thoi took them to deserted islands, where there were only sea breezes and sharp rocks. He drugged them, searched them thoroughly, and then threw each body into the sea.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-227-c2c75b552763.webp)

Some people woke up in the middle of the black water, struggling in despair, their mouths opened but only salt water filled their lungs. The cry died out amid the waves.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-228-d6653fbb54b1.webp)

For ten years, Thoi got rich that way. The sea became a mass grave, and he bought land, built a house, and made friends with local soldiers to make things go smoothly. On earth, Thoi thought he had won. But in the underworld, every human life has been recorded. Tran Van Thoi's life ended not by revenge or war, but by a seemingly accidental moment: accidentally pulling the trigger while cleaning the gun.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-229-ff72aabcde8a.webp)

The bullet ends the body, but is only the beginning of the real sentence. As soon as his breathing ended, Thoi's soul was tied tightly by a buffalo's head and a horse's face, pulled from his still warm body. No last words, no time for regrets.
He was pulled straight down to the underworld, standing in front of the Reflecting Mirror. On the glass surface, the sea appears. Hundreds of faces were swollen with water, their eyes were white, their hair was matted with moss, and their hands were reaching up from the depths.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-230-1107c85b23bf.webp)

Each face is a life he threw into the sea. The cry made no sound, but struck straight into the soul. Tran Van Thoi was banished to the eighteenth level of hell.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-231-e868f153a0a0.webp)

The eighteenth hell is not dark, but is bright with fire and metal. That light does not warm, but burns the soul. Thoi was thrown onto a table holding a sharp knife. Thousands of steel shots pierced his back, chest, and throat. The devil stepped on his body, each step causing his bones to crumble like crushed coral at the bottom of the sea. The limbs were chopped off, not decisively, but slowly sawed off. The sound of metal grinding against bone was deafening. Fingernails and toenails are pulled out one by one, pulling red nerves along with them. His intestines were pulled out and before he could fall, he was stuffed back into his mouth and forced to swallow his own internal organs.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-232-9d293f8673b8.webp)

Before he could faint, his body was skewered with a pitchfork, hung up and then dropped into a pan of boiling oil. The flesh exploded, the burning smell spread throughout the prison. The screams were no longer human voices, but were exactly like the drowning people who had screamed in their salty throats in the past.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-233-2abb6ee38318.webp)

When the body was broken, the devil ordered black water to be poured on it.
The body immediately regenerates. And the round of torture began again. Here, there is no escape from death, only infinitely repeating pain.
In extreme despair, thanks to a rare fate that cannot be clearly explained, Tran Van Thoi was allowed to tell his wife, Uyen, a dream in 1995.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-234-64e1c4b11106.webp)

In the dream, he appeared no longer human: his body was crushed, black blood flowed from his eyes, his distorted voice seemed to echo from the bottom of the sea. He knelt down and begged: "Uyen, save me... only your blessing can pull me out." Believing her husband, Ms. Uyen sold all her assets, devoted herself to doing great deeds: building bridges, building pagodas, building roads, building schools, doing Buddhist work and dedicating all her merits to her husband's spirit.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-20-image-235-85b50ad34333.webp)

Thanks to that blessing, Tran Van Thoi was pulled out of hell. But that is not complete liberation. Having escaped hell, Thoi still had to endure another punishment: two large rocks squeezed his soul, crushing it but not allowing it to disappear. That is the remaining retribution for the lives that have not yet been paid. That punishment lasted from 1995 to 2025. Thirty years, every moment was painful, no screams, no one saw. 
In 2025, thanks to the Buddhist dharma that Ms. Uyen created, my group was found by the Mountain Immortal. After asking permission from his superiors, Tran Van Thoi was taken to the temple to practice. But practice does not erase karma. It only helps the soul to repent. After completing the penance period, Thoi still has to enter reincarnation: he can be an animal, he can be a poor person, to continue paying the blood debt he sowed.
Tran Van Thoi's story is a cold warning to all: Evil can profit, but only when happiness exists. Blessings run out, karma rises – no one can escape. There is no deep sea that can bury cause and effect. There is no escaping death. Only sincere repentance and true virtue can open a path with light.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of SEA BURIES BODIES, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 21: Alcohol, Domestic Violence, and Ruin
tom_tat: During the teaching sessions in our series of "Journey to the Mission of the Lost", under the guidance of the Tien Ong who retreated in the That Son mountain range, that day there was a female ghost who cried until her eyes dried up...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 21: ALCOHOL, DOMESTIC VIOLENCE, AND RUIN**}

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-236-d702411ce760.webp)

During the enlightenment sessions in our series of "Journey to the Mission of Restoration", under the guidance of the Mountain Immortal who retreated in the That Son mountain range, that day there was a female spirit who cried until she recounted her fate. That is Ms. Le - a woman who lived her whole life in resignation, seemingly gentle and patient, but when she closed her eyes and gave up, she realized: karma is not only created by malice, but also by the habit of killing, accepting mistakes and harboring the sins of loved ones. 
Ms. Le's story is not just the tragedy of one woman, but a karmic verdict for an entire family, where alcohol, violence and blood have intertwined into a cycle of reincarnation with no way out. Ms. Le was born into a family with two brothers. His older brother, Buu, has a loose personality and drinks all day. Mr. Buu's best friend is Mr. Cong, the two of them treat wine like flesh and blood. Every drinking party has fresh meat, and the person in charge of the slaughter kitchen is none other than Ms. Le.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-237-5f2868dfa413.webp)

The chicken's blood is cut off while still struggling. The fish was hit on the head and disemboweled while its mouth was still open. Frogs are skinned while their hearts are still beating, eels and loaches are dissected alive, and even snakes have their heads chopped off. Blood flows to the ground, stinking, day after day. Every knife strike is a grudge, but when she was alive, Ms. Le simply thought: "I'll make my brothers drink." No one expected that these small creatures would later become an army demanding their lives in the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-238-e5765a0d30f8.webp)

Because of Mr. Cong's appreciation, Mr. Buu made a match for Ms. Le. At first she refused because she knew that Mr. Cong was an alcoholic, but then believing in his promise that "after getting married, I would stop drinking", she accepted. That is the first step straight into heavy karma.
After the wedding, Mr. Cong drank more and got drunk. Even though he knew his wife had heart disease, he still punched and kicked without mercy. Ms. Le worked tirelessly to sell bananas and vegetables to feed the family.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-239-a67421651428.webp)

Not only that, Mr. Cong also appropriated 3 meters of his neighbor's land, causing deep resentment. Every inch of land captured is a curse engraved on the soul. Ms. Le knows wrong and knows suffering, but she just endures it and does not stop her karma, because the karmic bondage has not ended.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-240-1e2042054898.webp)

After 20 years, in a fateful drinking session: a 4-kilo duck, a 10-liter can of wine. Mr. Cong and Mr. Buu drank to the point of coma. Alcohol penetrates deeply and is toxic.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-241-05475af0254f.webp)

Mr. Buu died after 4 days of struggle, Mr. Cong died after 8 days of vomiting blood, convulsions, and his body gradually becoming cold as ice.
Ms. Le continued to live another 15 years, living alone, doing business to earn money to treat her heart disease.
But one day, while buying bananas in the garden, she collapsed, her heart stopped beating, her soul left her body in loneliness.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-242-70a96ad87f17.webp)

As soon as she left her cold body on earth, Ms. Le's soul was tightly bound by a fierce-looking demon, dragged down into the underworld with a groaning sound of chains tearing apart space. In front of the gloomy judgment hall, where the blue fire burned without smoke and the cold wind blew back from the ground, she was shocked to see Mr. Cong - her husband - and Mr. Buu - her biological brother - being tortured, their bodies smeared and distorted in terror.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-243-10f875d58338.webp)

Prison door number 9 opened like a giant mouth, reeking of boiling wine and burning blood. This is hell for those who have heavy alcohol karma and consider violence a habit.
Mr. Cong and Mr. Buu were each forced to hug a block of red-hot stone, the heat penetrating straight into their skin, causing their bodies to burn and crack like dry soil. Above their heads are giant jars of wine, the wine inside is boiling, the foam is bulging as if breathing. The ghost roared and forced him to drink it all down. As soon as the wine touched his lips, his mouth burned and blistered, and wherever he went, his skin peeled off, pieces falling down to mix with the boiling liquid.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-244-9c242b5b3c7e.webp)

When they collapsed in pain, the devil used a pitchfork to pierce their bodies, lifted them up and dipped them straight into a pan of boiling wine, the horrible sizzling sound mixed with the screams was no longer audible.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-245-c965a35a7c03.webp)

That is retribution for considering alcohol more than human life, treating wife and children as punching bags to relieve drunkenness. As for Mr. Cong, he was also taken to hell of usurpation, where more sophisticated sentences awaited: his tongue was cut off to pay for the karma of lying, his teeth were pulled out, his mouth was gouged out to pay for the karma of taking over, and then his whole body was thrown into a sea of ​​boiling oil for three hundred years.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-246-2c07340160f3.webp)

At the end of his term, his soul was banished to be a dog for many lifetimes, looking after other people's houses, and paying exactly three meters of stolen land with his lowly status. Ms. Le thought she was just a person suffering in life, but she did not expect that the hell of killing is the main sentence for her. The animals that had been killed appeared: headless chickens flapping their bloody wings, skinless frogs jumping wildly, snakes bleeding with cow's blood, fish with intestines exposed and smashing into nothingness, all rushed to bite and tear. Her fingernails and toenails were pulled out one by one, grew back, and then were pulled out again; His head was chopped off but his consciousness remained, his guts were ripped out and dangled in front of his face. For the crime of skinning a frog, she was hung upside down, her skin was peeled off piece by piece, the pain spread straight into her consciousness, without a moment of extinction.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-21-image-247-9dccb50a9e70.webp)

Three years in hell passed in countless deaths and rebirths. Only thanks to a small amount of blessing left, she was instructed by the Mountain Immortal That Son, met our group for advice and followed her to the temple to practice, bringing with her a bloody message to mortals: "Don't drink too much, don't beat your wife and children, don't be greedy for land, and don't take the life of even the smallest animal lightly." Ms. Le's story ends as a chilling testament to the law of cause and effect: karma does not spare anyone, blood that has been spilled must be paid for with pain, alcohol drunk must be paid for by burning, land taken must be paid for by reincarnation.

tieu_de: Story 22: Merits and Transgressions Strictly Weighed
tom_tat: Under the flickering light of the oil lamp at the empty temple door, the story of Chu Nghi revealed by my group appeared like a long sentence engraved with blood and ice, fire and tears....
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 22: MERITS AND TRANSGRESSIONS STRICTLY WEIGHED**}

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-248-9eb69bc8ce9a.webp)

Under the flickering light of the oil lamp at the empty temple door, the story of Chu Nghi revealed by my group appeared like a long sentence engraved in blood and ice, fire and tears. It is not only a reincarnation journey of a soul, but also a mirror reflecting the harsh law of cause and effect, where a small good thought can give rise to great blessings, while a lethargic evil thought is enough to drag a person's whole life into the abyss of hell. With a horrifying voice, as clear as the sound of a hammer knocking on Diem Dai's judgment, that story makes listeners shudder, whether they believe it or not, because it puts people before the cold question: "What seeds are we sowing for the next life?"
The Sentence of Samsara Samsara is not a peaceful cycle of successive lives with fragrant flowers and sweet fruits. It is a wheel that crushes souls with karma, turning slowly but never stopping. Chu Nghi - a soul who has gone through three lifetimes - is a clear testament to that cruel justice.

From a bowl of rice offered to Buddha in a state of hunger and thirst, to overwhelming wealth and ultimate depravity, and finally to the floors of hell opening up with red fire, white snow and sharp knives, Chu Nghi's journey is a cold warning about the price of every action, every human thought that has ever arisen. First life: A bowl of rice and blessed seeds

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-249-938739f9648d.webp)

In her first life, she was born in ancient Persia, as an orphan, living a poor life as a beggar. Hunger clung to her like a shadow, gnawing at every breath. While walking to the temple, she saw people wearing silk brocade clothes respectfully making offerings to Buddha. Amidst the scent of incense and the sound of chanting, a clear thought suddenly arose in her heart: being offered offerings.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-250-4d70901ec2c4.webp)

Not to seek wealth, but just out of pure admiration. She asked for a bowl of rice from the rich man. The cruel sarcasm of the daughter of that family was like a knife cutting into her self-esteem, but she still knelt down and offered a bowl of rice to Buddha with trembling hands. At that very moment, when the bowl of rice was placed on the altar, good karma was sown. The blessing from that sincere heart was so great that, even though her next life was short and full of loss, it was still enough to lift her soul through the door of reincarnation with light. 
Second life: Wealth and the debt of a contemptuous word

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-251-cf1f353acb8f.webp)

Thanks to the blessings of her previous life, she was reincarnated as the daughter of a great mandarin, living in luxury and power.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-252-1cbe3aca7b56.webp)

She still maintains her good heart, likes to go to temples, make offerings to the Three Jewels, not forgetting the seeds sown in poverty. But in this life, a quiet character appears: the loyal dog. It followed her like a shadow, protecting her from all dangers, even blocking robber knives with its body.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-253-b52b9ab2e891.webp)

When the dog was dying, his soul told him in a dream: in his previous life, he was the rich girl who despised and prevented her from making offerings to Buddha. 
One disparaging word, one small evil thought, pulled that soul down to become an animal, living to pay off debts and protect benefactors. The dog's death is not only pain, but a bloody lesson: preventing good deeds is also a serious sin. She dedicated her merits and freed that soul, but the wheel of samsara continued to spin. 
Third life: Fall and the gates of hell

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-254-3115636df691.webp)

The great blessing is not over yet, in this life she was born with the name Chu Nghi, born in the third life into a family richer than before, "holding a golden spoon" since birth. But right at that peak of happiness, she slipped into partying, drinking, and gambling.
Money is poured into alcohol, into meaningless red and black soups. Her argument with her mother was like hammer blows hitting her mother's heart, and then a heart attack took her mother's life. The father, in anger and despair, kicked her out of the house.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-255-3bdcc0674467.webp)

When money ran out, friends turned their backs, and lovers left, Chu Nghi returned to the temple, took refuge in Buddha, recited sutras, and did meritorious deeds for many years.
When she breathed her last at the age of 75, her soul was still sent to the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-256-2ad65ada7d18.webp)

When the bell of the underworld rang dryly, the door to Hell slowly opened in front of Chu Nghi. In front of the cold Diem Dai, the dark sky seemed to be drained of light. No wind, no time, just the burning smell of smoldering karma in the air. At the foot of the temple, the river of blood rolled up in waves of red foam, reflecting the trembling silhouette of a soul that had no way to retreat.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-257-b464454c300a.webp)

The Lord of Hell cast a gaze like a sharp knife, declaring three great sins. As soon as he finished speaking, a prison door opened, emitting a horrifying hissing sound like bones being crushed. Chu Nghi was dragged away without time to cry or beg. 
First level: The sea of ​​fire of impiety

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-258-7f533f7e40a9.webp)

She was thrown straight into a red space. The sea of ​​fire stretched endlessly, the ground was giant copper cauldrons boiling. The heat not only burns the body's skin but also penetrates straight into consciousness, burning all remaining beautiful memories. The devil used an iron hook to throw her into the cauldron, where molten metal wrapped around her body like fiery red asphalt. The body's skin blistered, melted into pieces, revealing white bones and then cracked due to heat. As soon as her body disintegrated, an iron spear fell from above, piercing straight through her head, pinning her to the bottom of the cauldron. 
But death did not come. In just the blink of an eye, the body is regenerated to continue being burned. Every time we are reborn, we hear the forgotten voices of our parents call out in our memories, like a never-ending condemnation. 
Second floor: Ice Snow Mountain of wastefulness

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-259-180fc9af0c85.webp)

From the sea of ​​fire, Chu Nghi was pulled into a completely opposite world. The Ice and Snow Mountain Hell opened in the sound of howling wind like tens of thousands of screaming souls. This place is so cold that space seems to freeze, consciousness freezes layer by layer. Snow does not fall lightly, but falls like giant white rocks. The ghost forced her jaw open, heavy chunks of snow falling straight into her mouth, forcing her throat to tear. The cold penetrated deeply, freezing the spiritual body's internal organs, causing a sharp pain to spread to every cell.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-260-94dd06b729b4.webp)

When her body had not yet adjusted to the cold, she was dragged in front of disgusting food trays: crawling with maggots and a strong smell of rot. The devil forced her to eat it all, handfuls of maggots slithering through her lips and into her throat, to pay back for the squandered meals, for every grain of rice thrown away while still alive. Each time she vomited, she was forced to swallow again, until her consciousness was only a numb mass of ice. 
Third level: Hell of gambling

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-22-image-261-c189a19b9b14.webp)

The third door opened with the sound of metal clashing. This is the door to Dao Thot prison - a place where there is no fire or ice, only torture machines operating non-stop. Chu Nghi's body was tied to a stone table. The large knife fell, cutting off limbs with the dry crack of broken bones. Before he could fully feel the pain, the soul was thrown into the giant stone mortar. The mortar rotates slowly, crushing each part of the body, each rotation is a time when the consciousness is torn apart. The spiritual body's blood mixed with the stone, then the body was regenerated to continue the crushing cycle. There is no end, no rest, only an infinite repetition of loss and pain – just like the red and black cycle of gambling while alive. Judgment From above, Lord Diem spoke, his voice neither angry nor pitiful: "Cultivation has merit, but serious sins cannot be absolved. Repentance can only help reduce it, it cannot erase it." That sentence fell into the underworld like a permanent mark, ending all hope of escape.

A warning from the darkness Chu Nghi's story ends with the sound of a prison door slamming shut, echoing like a coffin lid turning down on the fate of a soul. But its echoes do not stay in the underworld, but spread to the earthly world, hitting straight into the hearts of the living. The law of cause and effect does not need anyone to believe in it to exist, it operates silently like darkness waiting for the light to go out. A sincere bowl of rice can open the way to rebirth, but a life of filial piety, wastefulness and depravity is enough to drag people down to the bottomless abyss. A human body is difficult to obtain, the Buddha Dharma is difficult to find. If you know it, please don't wait until the fire of hell licks the soul's skin to learn how to repent. Because at that time, all prayers would just disappear in the sound of the prison door closing.
