tieu_de: Story 23: Sorcery and Binding Departed Spirits
tom_tat: The story begins with a chilling warning, like a knock on the souls of those who are secretly living in the darkness of desire: adulterers, "sugar babies"...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 23: SORCERY AND BINDING DEPARTED SPIRITS**}

The story begins with a chilling wake-up call, like a knock on the souls of those who are secretly living in the darkness of desire: adulterers, "little people", "little people" who are deceiving themselves that happiness built on the tears of others will not be punished. This is not a fabricated story to scare, but a direct account from a spirit we directly connected with, under the guidance of the Mountain Immortal. The main character of that story is Anh Thi - a girl who strayed from human morality and paid the price with her soul.
When she was alive, Anh Thi was a young, beautiful girl, pursued by many people.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-23-image-262-c60c2c41ae63.webp)

Amidst those buzzing words, she chose to love Dat - a gentle, honest, caring man, but poor, with no bright future. Anh Thi used to be proud of her loyalty and believed that love was great enough to overcome material things.
But then, fate brought Bao into her life. The man is forty-nine years old, experienced, has money, social status and has a wife, Mrs. Chi. Bao's marriage cooled, and her complaints gradually became the rope that tied Anh Thi. She pitied, then sympathized, then fell without realizing it. Knowing full well that Bao was married and knowing that she was ruining the happiness of others, Anh Thi still chose to turn her back on Dat to enter into a sinful extramarital relationship.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-23-image-263-7106f6032965.webp)

When Mrs. Chi discovered her husband was having an affair, the betrayed wife's initial jealousy flared up violently. She found Anh Thi and asked to stop. But Anh Thi did not back down, even telling the story to Bao, causing Bao to turn and scold his wife. Cornered into a corner, for the sake of her children and family, Ms. Chi chose patience - a cold and calculating patience.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-23-image-264-686afc4ae68d.webp)

She approached Anh Thi, treating her as her younger sister, creating fake trust. Near Tet, she invited Anh Thi to a beauty salon, secretly took her hair and nails and brought them to Thailand to cast a spell. From there, the tragedy began.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-23-image-265-9260269109c3.webp)

Every afternoon, Anh Thi has a severe headache, like there are hundreds of nails driven straight into her skull. Her body was skinny, her internal organs felt like someone was strangling her from the inside. Even though Bao took her everywhere for treatment and money was poured out like water, her illness still did not improve.
A spiritual master said: the charm is too high-quality, has penetrated deep into the internal organs, and cannot be saved. When drinking magical water, Anh Thi vomited hair, metal, even razor blades - things that do not belong to the human body. Half a year later, she died in pain, carrying with her an unspeakable resentment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-23-image-266-57c1edbeb29e.webp)

The moment Anh Thi breathed her last breath, before her soul could understand what was happening, two ghosts appeared. Their skin is ash gray, their eyes are sunken deep like black holes, and their chains drag on the stone floor, making a scary sound. Without any explanation, they tied her soul tightly, pulling it straight down to the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-23-image-267-f357017c3d44.webp)

Diem Dai appears cold like an eternal execution ground. In front of Diem Chua, Anh Thi was about to open her mouth to explain, but the Mirror of Karma had already lit up. In the mirror, every moment of betrayal appears brutally clear:
 – The times you lied to your conscience
 – Sneaky nights behind other people's backs
 – The silent cry of a betrayed wife
 – The hurt eyes of the abandoned man 
Each image is like a knife cutting straight into consciousness. Can't deny it. Can't turn back. The God of Hell spoke, his voice as deep as thunder echoing from the bottom of the abyss: "Adultery, destroying other people's families, using lust as a reason for living. Open the prison door!"

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-23-image-268-e1b6275b99a9.webp)

The door to hell opened with the sound of metal grinding against each other, slowly, heavily, as if tearing apart space. The exhaled heat made Anh Thi's soul tremble even before being thrown in. The iron bed lies in the middle of a sea of ​​fire, glowing red like embers. The devil threw Anh Thi straight up there. As soon as the soul's body touched iron, the invisible flesh immediately sizzled, white smoke rose, and a strong burning smell spread throughout hell.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-23-image-269-c81a1dbc23b7.webp)

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-23-image-270-e11dba73fc3e.webp)

The pain is not like earthly pain - it penetrates straight into consciousness, burning every memory and every emotion. Anh Thi screamed, but her screams were swallowed by the roar of the fire. Before she could faint, the devil pulled her up and dragged her to a red-hot bronze column. "Hug!" – the devil roared. The copper column was so hot that the soul as soon as it touched it smoked, it felt like the entire ego was melted. The desire that once made her confused now turned into fire that burned her very soul. The fiery whip descended. Each whip not only hits the body, but tears apart memories and suffocates hope. Every time she collapsed, she was stood up again and forced to continue.

In hell, there is no fainting to escape pain. Only be alert to endure enough. Anh Thi now understands: when she was alive, she didn't believe in hell, because she hadn't been called by name. Because Anh Thi died from harm and her life had not yet ended, Lord Diem told her to return to earth to live out her destiny. But the sentence was as cold as a nail: "At the end of your life, the punishment continues. There is no exemption." The dark door closed. But hell does not let go.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-23-image-271-db05edec82b0.webp)

Anh Thi appeared in front of Bao. Not to scare, but to ask for help. But every time she appears, she brings with her the cold air of hell, terrifying the living. When Mrs. Chi heard the news, she hired a monk to guard the grave.
Deep stakes. Red thread tightened. Fierce soldiers surrounded. Every time Anh Thi tried to tell the truth, evil soldiers rushed in to beat her, tear her body apart, and drag her back to the grave. The pain that had tormented me during my life came back exactly the same, at the right time, at the right time, without missing a beat.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-23-image-272-775d7bfd48f2.webp)

Hell is not just in the underworld. It still exists in the world, in the form of unfinished karma. After a year and a half of escaping from the siege, Anh Thi met my group and asked the Mountain Immortal for guidance. With the revelation, her soul truly awakened. Before going back to the temple to practice, Anh Thi left a message, her voice trembling but decisive: "There are no winners in adultery. Tieu tam is never a victim. Retribution does not come immediately, but when it comes... there is no way back." 
Anh Thi's story ended like a funeral bell ringing in the dark night. Adultery is not only a moral mistake, but an evil karma with a clear verdict in the underworld. Hell doesn't need you to believe in order to exist. It just waits until the blessings run out - karma blooms - desires run out of cover, then open the door. If you still have time to turn around, turn around. Because when the prison door is closed, all regrets... become too late.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of TRAN YEM HON, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 24: The Curse of a Malicious Vow
tom_tat: When people are alive, they often think that words are just wind. A drunken oath, a lie to hide a sin, thinking it would be erased the next day. But in that...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 24: THE CURSE OF A MALICIOUS VOW**}

When people are alive, they often think that words are just wind. A drunken oath, a lie to hide a sin, thinking it would be erased the next day. But in the spiritual world, every word uttered is recorded, every evil thought leaves its mark. The story of the deceased named Thuc is a chilling testament to the uncompromising law of cause and effect. This is not a legend, not a moral scare, but the story of a soul who has experienced many levels of hell, suffering punishments far beyond the imagination of the living. A bloody lesson about adultery, lying and bad oaths.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-273-263f75aa256c.webp)

When he was still a mortal, Thuc was a man who had everything that easily makes people fall: good looks, education, good speech, and knowing how to appeal to women's emotions. He views conquering women as a pastime. Thuc's crime of adultery did not stop at promiscuous sex, but escalated to the point of destroying other people's families. He dated many married women, using sweet words and experience to deceive weak-minded people. Among them, the most serious crime is having a secret relationship with his best friend's wife - Mr. Dien.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-274-c2fc2655a7f9.webp)

While drinking and going in and out of his friend's house like a relative, Thuc secretly sowed desire, destroying the trust between the couple without Dien even knowing. When Mr. Dien became suspicious and asked directly, Thuc not only lied, but also swore before heaven and earth: "If I like your wife, I will be a dog." Not once. Not twice. But I swore to myself eight times, in eight different drinking parties.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-275-d6b5fdcc2d1a.webp)

In Law of the Netherworld, an oath is a contract. Once sworn, the gods took note. If committed, there is no need to consider other crimes, the oath itself becomes a sentence. After the eighth oath, Thuc contracted a strange disease and died that night, without having time to understand what was happening.
As soon as Thuc's soul left his body, the devil tied him up and dragged him straight to the underworld. Before the God of Hell, before he could even open his mouth to defend himself, the sentence was announced: "Sworn to be a dog, committed eight times - punished eight lives as an animal." No interrogation.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-276-f49d0c2813c4.webp)

No further consideration. Vong Thuc fainted right at the palace. When he woke up, Thuc had turned into a dog, reincarnated right into Mr. Dien's house - the friend he betrayed.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-277-002fe638dbc1.webp)

In the first seven lives, this dog: listened very well to Dien Bei's scolding and did not resist. But Dien was never allowed to touch him. Whenever he got close, he barked fiercely and bit. Always hide behind his wife - the exact position Thuc once stood in when he was alive. In his eighth dog life, Thuc was reincarnated into another house, loved and cared for.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-278-577e31dbf8ea.webp)

But karma is not over yet. One time the owner was away, the dog instinctively went out to play, allowing thieves to enter the house. When he returned, the owner was angry and beat the dog to death. That death ends eight animal lives, and is also the time when the real hell sentence begins.
After being forced to drink royal soul water, Thuc's earthly memories were torn apart and then reassembled in pain, his soul from animal form was forced to return to human form. Before he could complete it, he was dragged by the devil on the underworld stone floor, dragged straight into the hell of adultery, where no excuses were considered, no amnesty, only three prison doors opened one after another like teeth waiting to bite.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-279-42f244c902b0.webp)

The first door is the Bronze Pillar Prison. A bright red bronze column stood straight up in the middle of nowhere, so high that you couldn't see the top even if you looked up, the surface was as smooth as grease, the heat exhaled made the air vibrate as if it was about to explode. Thuc was kicked hard in the back by the devil and forced to climb. As soon as the skin of his hand touched the pole, it sizzled, the spiritual body's skin peeled off like fat in a hot pan, a strong burning smell mixed with a throat-wrenching scream. After climbing less than a few feet, his body slid down and hit the stone floor hard. At that moment, the devil's knife stabbed into his ribs, took out pieces of flesh, pulled him up, and threw him back into the bronze column. There is no rest, no end, just climbing - slipping - stabbing - pulling, just like the desire when alive: climbing forever without ever reaching the top, only to have body and soul burned little by little.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-280-4c3fc95e0a16.webp)

When his body was burned to the point of losing its shape, Thuc was thrown into the Double Saw - Meat Chopping Prison, where a cold stone table looked like a corpse waiting. The ghost held his head and legs, the metal saw blade grinding down on the middle of his body with a terrifying screeching sound. The pain did not come at once but spread slowly, allowing consciousness to realize that it was being split in half. The body's blood gushed out but did not flow, just boiled like hot plastic. Before it could disappear, the two halves of the body were chopped into small pieces, each knife strike made Thuc see himself being torn into pieces, but was still conscious enough to remember.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-281-7da10496d9e1.webp)

When there is no longer a form, the soul cowers and is thrown into the third prison door: Crushing Prison. Four tall ghosts jumped up and stomped repeatedly, each step was a time when bones were broken, flesh was crushed, consciousness was crushed into a mass of pain that no longer had any shape. But that's not all. Because he used sweet words to deceive and seduce, Thuc continued to be dragged to Vong Ngu Hell.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-282-83f20ead1b72.webp)

The tongue was stretched out of the mouth, spread straight on the stone floor. The iron buffalo bowed its head and pulled the plow, its iron hooves crushed every grain of its tongue, every groove was a lie once uttered. When the tongue was crushed, the devil hooked it up and cut it off piece by piece, but absolutely did not let it die, so that the pain would last indefinitely. Consciousness only remembers that there was no time down there, only screams mixed with the sound of metal colliding and the sound of flesh being torn, repeating over and over again like a sentence with no expiration date.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-283-8873c1b3c7e8.webp)

Until July 2025, hell suddenly became chaotic, souls scattered, and demons stopped. Thuc saw a sun-shaped turntable. He didn't understand why. He only knew that if he didn't jump up, he would be dragged back to prison. That jump brought him back to earth in a state of panic and ferocity, thinking anyone who came close was a demon. When he met my group, Thuc fought back frantically, until the words of revelation gradually cut through the layer of fear and hatred, helping that soul understand for the first time that he was not being hunted, but was being saved.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-24-image-284-de55a62ae2a3.webp)

Thuc's story ends like a knife stuck in the very person who once despised desire and words: adultery not only destroys other people's families but also digs a grave for oneself; Lying is not just lying but turning the mouth into a weapon; and the oath, once uttered, will never vanish into nothingness. Believe it or not is the listener's right, but cause and effect does not need anyone to believe to operate. If you are still alive and make a mistake, repent immediately, because once the prison door is opened, there is no apology big enough to close it.

tieu_de: Story 25: Wasting Food and the Hungry Ghost Retribution
tom_tat: In the doctrine of cause and effect, there are sins that seem small at first glance, even overlooked in daily life, but when they go to the underworld, they become a sentence no less severe than killing someone...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 25: WASTING FOOD AND THE HUNGRY GHOST RETRIBUTION**}

In the doctrine of cause and effect, there are sins that seem small at first glance, even overlooked in daily life, but when they go to the underworld, they become a sentence no less severe than murder. Wasting food – an act that happens every day on earth – is one such sin. The story of the ghost named Tan, approached by my group during the "Mission to save the dead" journey, is a chilling testament to that truth. This is not a threat, nor a lie to scare the weak, but a bloody account, a burning smell and the screams of a soul that has gone all the way from wealth to hell, just because of disregard for rice and human life.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-25-image-285-ba35c3943739.webp)

More than a hundred years ago, Tan was born into the family of a famous and wealthy lord. Spacious houses, vast fields, servants coming in and out like water. From a young age, Tan was absolutely pampered. Whatever you want, whatever you want, everything will be met. It is that blind indulgence that has planted the seeds of an arrogant mentality, treating people like trash and food as entertainment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-25-image-286-d5d0b0f30c6d.webp)

Tan's meals are always delicious. But he just picked a few pieces for show, then waved his hand to clear them.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-25-image-287-6b1dade99620.webp)

Raw food was dumped straight on the ground, mixed with coal ash and trash. If the dish doesn't suit his taste, he is ready to kick over the tray, the cup breaks, and the hot soup splashes on the servant.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-25-image-288-dd68d19fb8eb.webp)

Hungry servants secretly gathered leftovers to survive. If discovered, they would be beaten to broken bones or even lose their lives.
Not stopping at waste, Tan also considers human life lighter than a bowl of rice. Servants who made mistakes were tied up and thrown into wells, hung in warehouses, or beaten to death and thrown away like animals.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-25-image-289-24833544f2ac.webp)

His parents knew, but out of love for their children and fear of losing their reputation, they turned a blind eye. It was that cover-up that pushed the merits of the entire family down to the abyss. According to his original destiny, Tan should have lived to be ninety years old, enjoying all the wealth and having a full family of children and grandchildren. But evil karma accumulates day by day like an unpaid blood debt. Blessings have not been fully enjoyed yet. Unpaid karma has already ripened. At the age of thirty-one, Tan suddenly died in the night. Before he could understand what had happened, his soul was pulled straight into the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-25-image-290-b2332deff5d8.webp)

In front of the King's Palace, Tan was still arrogant, thinking that he died unjustly. But as soon as the Reflection Mirror shines, every tray of rice thrown away, every bowl of soup thrown away, every servant who died in frustration appears clearly. The cries of those starving due to wasted food, mixed with the groans of the tortured, echoed straight into his soul. 
Lord of Hell said: "You despise food - the crystallization of sweat and life. You use the surplus to feed your cruelty. Punishment: Pestle Hell - hell gate number 12.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-25-image-291-7a3ea1393cdb.webp)

Tan was dragged into Hell's Pestle by the devil. It was a giant stone mortar, rotating slowly but constantly, its surface covered with dried blood and crushed flesh. He was wedged between two rocks. As the mill rotates, the soul's body is crushed little by little.
Not a quick death, but a feeling of six senses and pain: the eyes burst first, the ears exploded later, the skull cracked like broken ceramic. Every time the body dissolved into bloody mud, the ghost scooped it up and threw it into the mortar again. There is no fainting, no liberation. Pain becomes a permanent state.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-25-image-292-e39bd9246b9b.webp)

Before he could recover, Tan was dragged to the next prison. The devil ordered him to open his mouth and stuff it with rotten shit and white maggots the size of a hand, still wiggling. The fishy smell rushed straight to the brain, causing the soul to convulse. He vomited in despair, but every time he vomited, the ghost forced him to eat it all over again, double or triple it. "You used to throw away clean food. Now you eat the dirtiest things in hell." The cold voice rang out, without emotion.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-25-image-293-fa8ff84bd7dd.webp)

Finally, there is the boiling copper prison. A pan of molten copper, boiling. Tan's head was held and forced to drink bucket by bucket. The molten metal poured through the mouth, burned the throat, and flowed down to the body's internal organs. With each sip, memories of spilled rice trays appear, brutally clear. These punishments do not happen once, but repeatedly until the real karma is paid in full. But even though he has finished paying, Tan still has 59 years left to live.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-25-image-294-3910750b8de3.webp)

Tan was pushed back to earth, but not as a human. He became a hungry ghost. Seeing food but not being able to eat it. Every time he brought the offering to his mouth, lightning struck straight into his body, tearing through his hunger with pain. Crazy hungry, but not dead. It was in that scene that my group - following the Mountain Immortal's instructions - came. After asking for permission from the Superior, Tan was given an opportunity: to return to the temple to practice and only smell incense for ten years. The smell of incense became his only meal, a reminder of the grains of rice he once despised.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-25-image-295-0a24a57652ca.webp)

Currently, Tan is at the temple, with dark clouds and lightning still floating above his head - a sign of unfinished karma. Before following back to the temple, Vuong Tan knelt down, his trembling voice sent a message to mortals: "Please don't waste a grain of rice. Every bowl of food is sweat, it's life. Throw away a piece, down there you have to pay with wordless pain." 
Tan's story is a chilling wake-up call for those who still consider wasting food a small matter. Karma is not measured by money, but by mind and behavior. If you waste today, you may not see anything tomorrow. But when blessings run out, karma blooms, hell will open its doors, and then, there will be no more meals to regret.

tieu_de: Story 26: The Grinding Stone Hell
tom_tat: In the spiritual universe, cause and effect and reincarnation are not abstract theories, but vital laws, operating quietly and without mercy. Small acts of kindness...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 26: THE GRINDING STONE HELL**}

In the spiritual universe, cause and effect and reincarnation are not abstract theories, but vital laws, operating quietly and without mercy. Seemingly small actions on earth - such as killing, wasting animals' lives - are recorded and waited for the day to be paid. The story of the deceased woman Tieu On, also known as Mrs. Hai On, is the most vivid proof of that.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-296-215489ddb2b7.webp)

Born into a family that sold chicken porridge and drinks, from the age of twenty, she took over the family business, directly slaughtering hundreds of poultry. Those seemingly normal actions sowed the seeds of heavy karma, causing her soul to undergo horrifying punishments in hell, experiencing many times of life and death and extreme pain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-297-5316291f53a9.webp)

Tieu On was born into a family with a tradition in the food business, where slaughtering poultry was considered a daily thing. From the age of 20, she directly performed slaughtering work: chickens, ducks, fish... all species were not spared. It seems that she herself does not think about karma at all, thinking that it is just a job to make a living. Once, when preparing to kill a pair of beautiful roosters from the farm, Tieu On was frightened when he heard their voices. The sound of the chicken rang out, clear but scary: "We are your great-grandfathers and great-grandmothers. In our previous lives we killed people, in this life we ​​have to pay our debt, you will be like us if we continue." This event made her stunned, frightened and emotional. Even though the chicken's grandparents agreed to be slaughtered, they still told her to bury her properly and warned her that if she continued to kill, she would suffer the same consequences.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-298-5410397ee937.webp)

Around the age of 35, after witnessing many lives lost at his hands, Tieu On decided to close the shop and give up killing. She goes to the temple, does good deeds, and dedicates merit to animals that have been killed. However, the amount of killing karma that has accumulated is too great; Most of the bird spirits did not accept the dedication, still resented her and demanded her life.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-299-e9918844feea.webp)

Just a few months later, Tieu On suddenly died in his sleep, at the age of 35.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-300-958a382fbccc.webp)

As soon as the soul left the body, they descended to the underworld. Without time to react, she was led to the Palace of Hell, where all excuses or explanations were meaningless.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-301-058cf54961f5.webp)

In the Karmic Reflection Mirror, every act of killing, every cry of an animal appears clearly, so horrifying that she shivers. Before her personal judgment, she was taken on a tour of other hells, to see the terrible consequences of evil karma: An old friend roasting pigs, beating dogs: iron animals rushed to tear flesh, a friend was grilled on a skewer over a red fire.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-302-40a3f38591eb.webp)

Hell of adultery: the offender must hug a hot bronze pole, an iron bird will peck its head to pieces, and screams will echo throughout the space.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-303-3fdf45a1ee0a.webp)

These scenes made Tieu An terrified, understanding that karma does not spare anyone, whether it is her friends or herself.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-304-bbbc83151a28.webp)

In the end, the King of Hell judged: "You have killed too many people, now you must suffer the penalty of 150 years in the Stone Demon Hell." This is the most terrifying door to hell for a murderer: Tieu On was thrown into a floor full of iron chickens. They rushed in to peck, bite, and rip out every fiber of flesh and skin, tearing blood.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-305-f44a8e349f8e.webp)

The pain spread to her consciousness, making her soul scream. When the body had almost only white bones left, the demons sent the bones into a giant grinder and crushed them into powder.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-306-c3d397b8b853.webp)

The sound of broken bones and endless screams created endless terror. This punishment lasts 150 years, each second passing like thousands of years of pain, dying over and over again continuously. Without a moment of rest, the soul can only experience suffering for every life it has ever killed.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-26-image-307-6b811c546b2d.webp)

When his term expires, Tieu On is given a choice: reincarnated as an animal or return to earth to suffer and wait for someone to save him. With a wish to repent, she chose to return to earth. Only 8 days later, thanks to good fate, she was instructed by the Mountain Immortal and met my group to receive instructions. Thanks to that, her soul had the opportunity to become good, be led to the temple, practice, do good deeds, and avoid being reborn in a terrible hell. Before leaving for the temple, Tieu On advised: "Those who believe in cause and effect and reincarnation should give up evil deeds and do good deeds. Especially, those who kill people should switch to a better job." It is no coincidence that the precept of not killing was given top priority by the Buddha. A harmed life, even if it is an animal, is also recorded in the karma book. You have to pay, you can't avoid it." Tieu On's story emphasizes that the karma of killing does not spare anyone, whether they repent late or have done good deeds later. The animals killed are not forgotten, and hell – Thach Ma or other doors – is always ready to wait for souls who have not paid their debts.

In particular, the details about the iron chicken pecked and the bones crushed by the mortar made the listener not only shudder but also realize that the karma of killing is not just a theory, but a vital, terrifying experience to the end. Vuong's story ends as a wake-up call for those who still despise life, especially those who work in the killing profession. Wasting, killing, or disregarding life all bring consequences that cannot find deliverance. Hell is not a legend, but a reality, where the soul feels extreme pain, dies and comes back to life, and witnesses its own karma. Tieu On's soul, fortunately thanks to the good fate that was revealed, returned to the temple to practice, but traces of old karma still exist, like dark clouds and lightning above his head, reminding him that: cause and effect wait for no one, both happiness and karma have limits. Whoever still has the chance, should repent, avoid evil deeds, and do many good deeds.

Because when hell opens, every muscle, every bone and every harmed life will become an inevitable punishment, no apology is enough to reverse it.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of HELL MASTER, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 27: Defaming Monastics and Holy Sages
tom_tat: In the silent flow of cause and effect, there are stories that seem far away but are vivid proof of the consequences of words and actions. Vong Nguyet Nhu - is a proof...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 27: DEFAMING MONASTICS AND HOLY SAGES**}

In the silent flow of cause and effect, there are stories that seem far away but are vivid proof of the consequences of words and actions. Vong Nguyet Nhu – is a chilling testament to the defamation and insult of a monk, as well as the inevitable consequences that she must endure.  
The story of Nguyet Nhu's life and underworld journey is not only a warning to those who disregard cause and effect, but also a reminder that every evil act, no matter how small or big, is recorded and will bear fruit at the right time.

Nguyet Nhu said that in her previous life she was a 21 year old boy, healthy, handsome and full of confidence, but also full of arrogance. Vong does not believe in cause and effect, knows nothing about Buddhism, and always lives according to his own desires.

One day, with a group of friends going to bathe in the river, he saw a monk using a bowl to scoop drinking water - an extremely precious object to the monk, a symbol of virtue and spiritual life. Instead of respecting him, this young man mocked, laughed, and badmouthed the monk in front of everyone.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-27-image-308-c3d7119daa71.webp)

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-27-image-309-2475f7a39874.webp)

Not stopping there, he proceeded to steal the alms bowl and throw it into the river, making the monk extremely miserable and disappointed.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-27-image-310-c1f7fae9c579.webp)

This action, seemingly small, is the seed of evil that one will have to suffer in future lives. Seven years later, when he was married and had two children, he survived by cutting firewood and selling it at the market. One day, seeing a giant old tree, he decided to cut it down to sell it to make money. During the cutting process, the tree fell on him, killing him on the spot.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-27-image-311-feffdbb5c8de.webp)

The soul leaves the body and is led by demons to the underworld. Here, the King of Hell judged the crime of defaming monks, an extremely serious crime in the underworld law.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-27-image-312-3227738be768.webp)

Although I do not remember all the details of the prison doors, through the story, we understand that the hell of slanderers is an unimaginably horrifying place. In the dark space, countless souls screamed, the sound of iron chains clashing, blazing fire and the smell of burning spread everywhere. Each soul must endure physical and mental pain, without a moment of rest.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-27-image-313-9e49dea139cd.webp)

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-27-image-314-058d9c9a020c.webp)

The crime of defaming a monk resulted in him being locked in red-hot copper pillars and having his head pecked by an iron bird.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-27-image-315-2cde75607556.webp)

Lie on the stone table and let the devil chop every muscle while your consciousness is still awake.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-27-image-316-c391357f5689.webp)

After completing the punishment, the deceased Nguyet Nhu in that life as a male was reincarnated as a male monkey. This life is both a punishment and an opportunity to reform: living by instinct, avoiding hunters, climbing to find food and feeling the hardships of animal life. Once, when saving an old woman who had slipped into a stream, the male monkey sacrificed himself, hit a rock and died on the spot, allowing the old woman to be saved. This sacrifice is the only bright spot, creating good causes for the next life.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-27-image-317-6cea95e8d1db.webp)

In the next life, thanks to the good karma of saving people, she was reincarnated as a rich and beautiful daughter named Nguyet Nhu. However, life is still unstable: he lost his father at the age of 4, his mother at the age of 18, lives alone and has to maintain the habit of eating bananas and drinking coconut water - a form of self-restraint and limiting desires. Despite his wealth, successive events – including a miscarriage at age 50 and depression – showed that bad karma from previous lives had not yet been exhausted, emphasizing that retribution does not exclude anyone, even after accumulating merit later.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-27-image-318-e974a83977c3.webp)

Nguyet Nhu's story ended when the gate opened in July 2025, and she was enlightened by my group and brought back to the temple. Through the story, we realize important lessons about the law of cause and effect: Defaming a monk is a serious crime: A seemingly small action, such as mocking, disparaging or robbing a monk of his precious belongings, will accumulate into bad karma, leading to horrifying punishment in the underworld. The scene of hell with fire, bronze pillars, pecking iron birds and meat-chopping stone tables demonstrates the horror that this sin brings. The animal life is a lesson: Becoming a monkey, experiencing hardship, fear and danger, learning the value of sacrifice, giving up selfishness and sin. Netherworld not only punishes, but also guides the soul to enlightenment and accumulates good causes. Good karma does not completely erase bad karma: Even though saving the old woman's life and receiving good blessings, a person's life is still influenced by old karma.

This proves that the law of cause and effect operates slowly but does not fail, and people need to persevere in repairing, not just relying on one good action to erase bad karma. Although Nguyet Nhu was born into wealth, the sufferings of loss, miscarriage, and depression demonstrate that material wealth cannot prevent karma. Merit and bad karma operate independently of power and money. Defaming a monk is not only an insult to morality, but also opens the door to hell with horrifying punishments and endless pain. Nguyet Nhu's story emphasizes that practicing, doing good deeds, avoiding killing and respecting practitioners is the only way to neutralize bad karma and increase wisdom and concentration. This is a wake-up call for all those who disregard morality, defame practitioners, or disregard cause and effect. Hell is not just a legend, but a living demonstration of the inevitable consequences of wrong words and actions.

The horrifying punishments – red-hot copper pillars, pecking iron birds, meat-chopping stone tables – are scenes that make people reconsider their behavior. Cause and effect does not wait for human belief, it operates quietly but surely. Every word, every action is recorded and will lead to corresponding retribution. We may not believe it, but retribution still exists. Therefore, learning from the story of Nguyet Nhu, each person should live kindly, avoid insults and slander, and practice to increase wisdom and concentration, because when the door to hell opens, all regrets will be too late.

tieu_de: Story 28: Reborn as a Woodworm
tom_tat: In the world, people often believe that only killing people is a serious sin, while killing small creatures such as worms, ants, and weevils is insignificant. But the underworld does not differentiate between greatness...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 28: REBORN AS A WOODWORM**}

In the world, people often believe that only killing people is a serious sin, while killing small creatures such as worms, ants, and weevils is insignificant. But the negative does not distinguish between big and small, it only distinguishes whether it kills the mind or not. Hell does not ask how many people you killed, but how many lives you coldly took away with desire and indifference. 
The story of A Rach Da, a soul who lived more than seven hundred years ago, is a living sentence for those who despise life, even if it is just a worm in a rotten tree. This is not a fabricated story, but the broken story of a soul who paid for his karma by being a worm for seven hundred years, going through hell and reincarnation, before being enlightened to stop on the shore of liberation.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-28-image-319-35791ec85ce8.webp)

When he was alive, A Rach Da was a nineteen-year-old boy who lived with his grandmother and often went to the forest to collect firewood. It was in the rotting tree trunks that he learned about the "pesticide" - fat, white, soft beetles that live parasitically in wood.
At first it was just curiosity, but with just one taste, the desire to eat and drink awakened a smoldering murderous heart. From thirteen worms the first time, A Rach Da gradually ate uncontrollably. He eats instead of rice, eats day and night, eats unconsciously, eats in addiction.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-28-image-320-38b2afebb95b.webp)

For three years, from the age of nineteen to twenty-two, thousands of lives were crushed in his mouth - each worm chewed alive, intestines burst, body crushed, dying in fear without a sound. This is the subtle karma of killing – not due to hatred, not due to survival, but due to desire and pleasure.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-28-image-321-cc8cdf0d3946.webp)

A Rac Da's body gradually deformed: skinny, sunken eyes, and gloomy expression. When he looked at himself in the stream, he was also frightened by the appearance of a person about to die. A noble man appeared and pointed straight: "You have eaten too many lives.
The General has appeared. If you don't stop, you will die miserably." But warnings cannot overcome addiction. Nine days of deep fasting only fueled desire.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-28-image-322-074912aee8a5.webp)

And it was during the return to the forest, as soon as he put the first worm in his mouth, that karma immediately bore fruit.
In a trance, A Rach Da saw a giant worm, its body as long as a python, its intestines wrapped full of worm carcasses, and its eyes glowing red with resentment. It pronounced sentence: "You ate my children and grandchildren without leaving a single one alive. Today, I will eat you back."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-28-image-323-028201e91398.webp)

Each piece of A Rach Da's intestines was pulled out, each piece of flesh was torn apart. He screamed in the middle of the forest, but no one saved him - because when the killing karma is ripe, no blessing can interfere. The worm bit right into the head, and life ended in resentment.
As soon as A Rak Da's soul left his body, the devil dragged him straight down to the underworld. Before Yantai, there were no lengthy interrogations. Killing karma is as clear as blood on a karma mirror: every worm eaten alive, every moment of desire appears.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-28-image-324-e6886e4cd55a.webp)

Lord Yama said: "You have no merit. But the killing karma is too great. Each worm is one life. Do not reduce it." The devil ordered A Rach Da's soul to be disemboweled.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-28-image-325-8471345e83f2.webp)

From inside the body, thousands of worms crawled out, were gathered, and weighed. Each child is a year of paying off karma. The verdict was read: Seven hundred years reincarnated as a beetle.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-28-image-326-bb92337d79f7.webp)

The moment the order ended, his soul shrank, deformed, his limbs melted, his consciousness was forced into the small, slippery body of a beetle. Being a beetle is not just one life, but hundreds of consecutive lives, each life dying and being reborn. A Rach Da eats paper, books, and rotten wood - the same tree trunks that once nourished the worms he killed.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-28-image-327-f83b9668f2d1.webp)

Consciousness is still there, but cannot speak, cannot resist. He heard the sound of modern traffic, but did not understand it, only knew it was the sound of the world that had abandoned him. There was a life where someone accidentally stepped on him to death. There was a life when he was pulled off a pillar, his body broke but he didn't die immediately, he crawled in pain. There was a life where he witnessed demons taking away children, but could not call for help, because he was also a sinful soul. The climax is the life of being struck by lightning, the house pillars collapse, the fire burns, and the body is crushed by insects. Pain does not go away, it only repeats, because death is not the end – death is just a cycle of punishment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-28-image-328-39c64a3f65cb.webp)

After hundreds of years, thanks to some remorse and weakened karma, the sentence was shortened.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-28-image-329-96b144b0b957.webp)

A Rach Da escaped the life of a worm but was not reincarnated as a human. He had to wander the world for twenty-five years as a ghost, hungry, thirsty, afraid, and hiding from demons. It wasn't until he was instructed by the Fairy God, met my group, and was enlightened that he understood: Even if you kill a living being, no matter how small, your karma will still become a mountain. 
The story of Vong A Rach Da is not just a horror story, but a clear karmic verdict for those who despise life. Hell doesn't need human blood to open its doors - just an unrepentant killing spirit. Seven hundred years of being a worm is the price for three years of eating worms with desire. That is the cold justice of cause and effect: if one takes one's life, one must pay one's life, even if it means paying in the lowest form. People may not believe it, they may laugh. But hell doesn't need trust to exist. It just waits until karma blooms and blessings dry up, to open the door to welcome the souls who have written their own sentences. If you still have time to stop - stop. If you have to kill - explain, apologize, dedicate. Because sometimes, forgiving a small creature is to spare yourself a life of damnation.

tieu_de: Story 29: Karmic Fetters of Delusional Attachment
tom_tat: In the human world, there are love relationships that seem to be just a passing relationship, but are actually cruel chains that bind many reincarnations. There are tears falling...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 29: KARMIC FETTERS OF DELUSIONAL ATTACHMENT**}

In the human world, there are love relationships that seem to be just a passing relationship, but are actually cruel chains that bind many reincarnations. There are tears falling not because the present is too painful, but because the old karma has come to collect debt. Hell is not only a place of punishment after death, but also a mirror reflecting people's sins while alive. The story of the female spirit Thuy Lieu - a soul who cried for a year and a half on earth - is a clear demonstration of the law of cause and effect, especially the retribution of adultery, violence and betrayal of marriage vows.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-330-375e150d6666.webp)

It is not just a horror story, but a cold judgment for those who disregard marital morality. Following the Mountain Immortal's instructions, my group set out on a mission to save the dead. That night, the space was unusually gloomy, the wind blew with a cold air like the musty smell of the underworld. When we arrived, we saw a slender figure sitting huddled on a peach mango tree, long hair hanging down, shoulders shaking from crying. That is the ghost girl Thuy Lieu. Her cry was not a fierce scream, but a long, choking sob, as if every breath brought tears of blood.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-331-b80cac40e262.webp)

Thuy Lieu said that the man she loved - the one who had sworn to each other - had gotten married, leaving her behind in the cold world. Because she was in so much pain, she wandered everywhere, finally staying on this peach mango tree, crying for a year and a half, refusing to leave. But that pain does not start in this life.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-332-1e1f6ca303da.webp)

Sinful past life – Man named Tien

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-333-295b0b112116.webp)

Through the process of enlightenment, Thuy Lieu gradually remembered her past life. At that time, she was not a woman, but a man named Tien. Tien is famous for being flirtatious, promiscuous and extremely brutal. Even though he has a wife, Na, he still blatantly cheats with many other women, viewing fidelity as a joke. Every time he returned home, Tien did not bring repentance but only vented his anger on his wife's body. Ms. Na's teeth were broken, her throat was crushed, blood filled her mouth, and she fainted many times on the floor. Even while pregnant, she still could not escape the brutal beatings. Tien became more and more aggressive, beating his wife like he would beat an animal.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-334-2b8eaab3c17e.webp)

Those who intervened were all chased away by Tien. Even Mr. Du - Tien's younger brother, when trying to protect his sister-in-law, was beaten until he was bruised. The house that was once a home gradually turned into a living hell for Ms. Na. Unable to bear it any longer, one night of despair, when her child was only three months old, Ms. Na hugged her child and jumped into the river to commit suicide. The cold water swallowed two lives. Both mother and child were lost, their bodies were not found, leaving only a haunting burden on the whole village.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-335-a71ab1c48869.webp)

Only then did Tien begin to regret. The villagers despised him, cursed him, and considered him an indirect murderer. Not daring to raise his head to look at anyone, Tien left the village and went to the temple to repent. He became a vegetarian, chanted sutras, and did meritorious deeds until he was 63 years old, when he died. But late repentance cannot erase the heavy karma that has been sown.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-336-5c136776474a.webp)

After death, Tien's soul was escorted by demons to the underworld. The door to hell opened, the smell of blood and burning flesh rushed straight into the soul. Tien was stripped naked and tied tightly to a red-hot bronze pole. When the body touched the column, the flesh sizzled, fat flowed drop by drop, seeping into the hot stone floor. Tien's scream rang out pitifully, but was only echoed by the creepy laughter of the devil. Before he could faint, iron birds swooped down from the air, their beaks as sharp as blades, nibbling at pieces of flesh, gouging out eyes, and poking straight into the brain. Every time he died, the devil sprinkled him with water to revive him, his flesh fused together to continue the torture.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-337-e8fd76db1a93.webp)

Not stopping there, Tien was dragged to another prison door.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-338-357a7825f3b1.webp)

Here, his hands and feet were cut off, his body was torn apart, and he was forced to crawl on the hot sand. Every time he moved, his skin peeled off and blood flowed.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-339-5b1d7feb4c84.webp)

These punishments are repeated over and over again, for who knows how long, until the karma gradually runs out.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-340-cac09e73349a.webp)

Retribution for role change - Tien was pushed into reincarnation, reincarnated as a woman named Thuy Lieu. And Ms. Na, the wife who had been abused, was reincarnated as a man named Mr. Tu. They meet again, but no one remembers their past lives.
Thuy Lieu loved Tu madly, and Tu scolded her, chased her away, and even wanted to fight her every time he saw her. Every insult from Mr. Tu is a return for what Tien once did to Ms. Na. Wrongful retribution, not one bit wrong.
When she heard the news that Mr. Tu was getting married, Thuy Lieu collapsed. She bought medicine to take and died at the age of 23. Down to the underworld, after bathing in the Oan Stream and watching the Mirror of Reflection, she clearly understood why she was so infatuated with someone who hated her: it was her own oath of betrayal in her previous life. But understanding is not the same as letting go. After her death, Thuy Lieu still refused to escape, wandering around crying on earth, staying in a peach mango tree for a year and a half, waiting in vain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-29-image-341-4da1bb397e0b.webp)

Only when our group persistently explained that attachment is the most terrifying prison, did Thuy Lieu return to the temple to practice. The story of the deceased woman Thuy Lieu is a cold judgment of cause and effect for those who underestimate fidelity and disregard their partner's pain. Adultery not only destroys a family, but also sow the seeds of hell for many lives to come. Violence not only hurts the body, but also binds the soul in a cruel cycle of reincarnation. Hell is not far away. It starts from the actions that people consider "private matters". Believe it or not is everyone's right. But cause and effect - never forgive anyone.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of OAN Nghiep Tinh SI, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 30: Treachery and Bitter Ingratitude
tom_tat: In human morality, kindness is the root, filial piety is the root. A person who lives but forgets grace, enjoys all the blessings and then turns his back on the person who once saved him, no matter how glorious he was while alive, when...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 30: TREACHERY AND BITTER INGRATITUDE**}

In human morality, kindness is the root, filial piety is the root. A person who lives but forgets grace, enjoys all the blessings and then turns his back on the person who saved him, no matter how glorious he was while alive, when he dies, it will be difficult to avoid the hell that awaits him. Karma does not require an executioner, because karma itself will drag the soul to the deepest place of hell. The story of the ungrateful and ungrateful woman, revealed by my group under the guidance of the Immortal, is not only a human tragedy, but also a chilling sentence for the unfilial, the one who turns back and bites back the hand that raised him.
It is a story where each level of hell carries the smell of blood - fire - resentment, making the listener's spine chill. When she was alive, the deceased was born into a poor family, her parents worked in the fields all year round but were still hungry. When she was ten years old, her parents fell seriously ill. All assets were sold for medical treatment, but in the end both still passed away, leaving the child orphaned, wandering, starving. The girl had to pick up scraps and beg for food to get through the day.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-342-43eda891bd8e.webp)

Once trudging in front of the gate of a rich family, his skinny body and sunken eyes from hunger caught Mr. Dac's eye. Mr. Dac and his wife, Mrs. Huynh, are rich but infertile, and feel compassion. After asking about her circumstances, they adopted her, gave her education, and cared for her as if they were their own. From the bottom of the mud, the girl was pulled into the light - that was a life-saving grace.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-343-0eb6c38a4ef0.webp)

Thanks to being raised well, the deceased girl successfully studied. When he grew up, Mr. Dac directly taught him how to do business and paved the way for business. Thanks to the blessings of her ancestors and the kindness of her adoptive parents, her business prospered and her money piled up like a mountain.
But at that moment, people's hearts changed. She began to despise her grandparents, considering them a burden. When Mrs. Huynh fell seriously ill, she did not care to take care of her. When her grandmother passed away, she only went to the funeral to cry, her eyes were cold, not a single tear.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-344-702632b768e2.webp)

Immediately after that, Mr. Dac's business failed and he was in debt. In dire straits, he went to his adopted son whom he had saved, hoping to temporarily borrow some money to tide him over.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-345-83c6f8ed8744.webp)

But what he received in return was not a favor, but a curse. The female spirit not only refused, but also scolded Mr. Dac severely, humiliated, insulted, and cursed him to die quickly.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-346-d0af7e042855.webp)

When he lingered to beg, she used a stick and chair to beat him, chasing his old and weak foster father out of the house like a ragged dog. Mr. Dac returned with resentment, vomited blood and died. His soul had not yet closed its eyes, carrying heavy resentment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-347-bc16c8a89853.webp)

Just one month later, the fate of the deceased woman completely reversed. No matter what you do, you will lose money, your money will disappear, your house will be foreclosed. From being rich, she fell to the bottom of society, having to beg for food, being chased away, beaten, and scavenging to make a living. In the end, she died in hunger, thirst and humiliation, when she was only 33 years old.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-348-b5f57cf57766.webp)

When death had just closed its eyes on earth, the female spirit was still stubborn, screaming, resisting, refusing to follow the devil's orders.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-349-4da21f7f17e3.webp)

It was that stubbornness that caused the two ghosts to have no mercy: their hair was pulled back, their bodies were dragged on the cold stone road leading to the underworld. As soon as the door to hell opened, a strong stream of fishy air mixed with the smell of burning flesh rushed straight into the soul, not just the stench of a corpse, but the smell of pain that had been burned for thousands of years.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-350-1b2f82838d0f.webp)

At prison door number 5, the devil did not say a word, the heavy iron hammer fell directly on his head, the force of the impact caused the skull to break, and the tongue to burst out in a dry crackling sound. The tongue - the tool of the curse when alive - was stretched and locked with iron nails, each vibration tearing apart every fiber of pain. Before the body had time to die, it was torn into pieces, but the moment the consciousness disintegrated, the skin and flesh were left intact to continue to endure. The scary thing is not to die, but not to die, to let the pain last until the soul screams and breaks.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-351-da4f9fc0e24d.webp)

Entering prison door number 10, a place reserved for ungrateful and ungrateful people, the bones and tendons are stripped clean, the body as soft as mud is thrown onto the stone floor, let the crazy buffalo trample, the hooves crush every joint, then giant rocks fall from above, crushing the body into a shapeless pile of flesh and blood.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-352-87a8b1eb22a6.webp)

But before she could disappear, the female spirit was dragged to prison door number 12 and thrown straight into the mortar.
The stone pestle pounded repeatedly, the sound of broken bones mixed with the sound of crushed flesh, intestines and intestines splattered out, and as soon as the breath lingered, a flock of iron crows were waiting to peck and tear, eating every piece of hot internal organs.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-353-f84e47c91274.webp)

Death is so repetitive that there is no longer any concept of time. The climax of the horror is prison door number 16, where the devil uses an iron fork to pierce straight from the anus to the top of the head, hangs the body on fire, roasts it from the inside out, and then throws it into a sea of ​​red flames, where only the smell of burning flesh and the never-ending sound of resentment remain. After enduring those levels of punishment, the female spirit was still not liberated but was banished to seven lifetimes as a dog.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-30-image-354-b16ff0a108f7.webp)

In one life, he was hungry and thirsty, stole chickens and was beaten to death, in another life he froze to death in the cold weather, in another life he was raised just to be eaten, and in his most recent life he was electrocuted and convulsed until he stopped breathing. Returning to the underworld, drinking water to restore her soul but not having enough karma to become a human, the female spirit continued to be locked in a steaming cage, her flesh and skin shrank in the heat and was immediately blown in by the cold wind. The bone-shattering pain lasted seemingly endlessly, until July 2025, when the Mon Gate opened, she was allowed to go to earth to wait for her destined person. 
Everything the ghost girl experiences is not meant to scare, but is a cold judgment of cause and effect: a piece of food to relieve hunger, a caring hand if betrayed, will turn into a dagger to stab the soul of the ungrateful. Hell does not need anyone to believe in order to exist, because the book of life and death still records every action, and cause and effect - until now - has never failed anyone.

tieu_de: Story 31: Remorse Come Too Late
tom_tat: There are deaths that end a person's life. But there are also deaths that are just the door opening to a longer, colder chain of pain, where the soul is suspended between two banks...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 31: REMORSE COME TOO LATE**}

There are deaths that end a person's life. But there are also deaths that are just the door opening to a longer, colder chain of pain, where the soul is suspended between the two banks of yin and yang, belonging to nowhere. In the series of stories "Mission to save the dead", the female spirit called Ms. Luu is such a case. My group deliberately kept their identity a secret to avoid disturbing the living relatives, but the story of Ms. Liu - the new name I gave her, if listened to the end, is a clear verdict of cause and effect, where every emotion, every wrong relationship while alive becomes a shackle that binds the soul after death.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-355-7267f6ca9449.webp)

When she was alive, Ms. Luu was a woman who suffered many disadvantages. She was born in a poor countryside, where life was closely tied to the fields and weather. At the age of twelve, she lost both her parents. That shock was like a knife cutting off her childhood, leaving a helpless child who could only rely on her grandmother. She loved her grandchild with a rough but steadfast love, scrimping on every penny and every meal to raise her sister. It was that early loss that made Ms. Luu's heart always yearn to be protected and loved.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-356-a9f6afc0d698.webp)

Eight years after being orphaned, her grandmother saved money to buy Ms. Luu an old motorbike to use as a motorbike taxi driver. Amidst the crowd, she stands out with her charming appearance and sweet voice.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-357-99ebcf91f97c.webp)

The chants and Vong Co melodies she sang in the middle of a sunny afternoon or a rainy afternoon softened customers' hearts, gave them more money, and introduced more connections. That voice is both a blessing and a karma.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-358-87b2a290561e.webp)

From the bus trips, she got to know Mr. Van, a 47-year-old man, doing business, with a smooth tongue and plenty of money.
The generous tips and vague promises gradually turned her into his shadowy lover. That relationship has no title, no future, but is bound by distorted emotions and invisible dependence.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-359-f7b5787a06ed.webp)

Thanks to her singing voice, Ms. Luu was introduced to singing at weddings and tea rooms. The times she held 8 million in her hand, then 15 million after a few songs made her believe that her life was taking a different path. Driving a motorbike taxi during the day and standing under dim lights at night, she lives between two worlds: making a living and dreaming.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-360-95cf100e7bc8.webp)

At the tea room, she met Mr. Cuong, a man who had his own tea room, often gave her money and showed appreciation for her talent.
The offer "come sing for me, no need to drive a motorbike taxi anymore" was like a lifesaver for a woman who was tired of the sun and rain. She agreed, not expecting that decision to touch Mr. Van's sick jealousy.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-361-2ab7893aa8c2.webp)

Mr. Van, although he has no intention of getting married, views Ms. Luu as a possession. The curses, control, and threats became more and more dense.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-362-8c1f68885ede.webp)

The climax was the date in the deserted forest - a place that used to be a private place for the two of them.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-363-238f9d3998ea.webp)

The four stabs of the knife not only tore her body apart but also buried her entire life at the age of 36. Ms. Luu did not die immediately.
In her coma, she still felt the cold ground covering her face, her breathing was suffocated, and her panic rose to the extreme. Death by being buried alive is one of the deaths that instills the heaviest resentment, because the soul leaves the body in fear, resentment and extreme pain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-364-061659283f17.webp)

When the body was dug up, Ms. Liu saw her grandmother collapse next to her body. That cry pierced her soul, but she couldn't touch it, couldn't say goodbye. The injustice kept her in the forest. She should have lived until 85 years old, so the underworld allowed her soul to roam the earth for the remaining years.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-365-ef97a53f54a0.webp)

But that “permission” is another punishment. Unable to find her way home, unable to enjoy the offerings, her soul was hungry, thirsty, and cold. Resentment made her want to find Mr. Van to take revenge, but the law of cause and effect was tied.
In the hunger for her soul, she still sings on the mango tree - the image is both pitiful and scary: a breathless voice, resounding in the middle of a deserted night.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-31-image-366-947b5c800ffc.webp)

After 3 years and 20 days of wandering, thanks to "the Mountain Immortal's tip", my group found Ms. Luu's remains. During the opening session, her soul expressed her wish to return to her grandmother. But cause and effect is not allowed. The living and the dead are two different worlds, holding on only increases karma. In the end, Vong agreed to return to the temple to practice. Before leaving, she sent a terrifying warning: "In this world, there are countless wandering ghosts, lonely souls, and weak-minded people who can easily be possessed and killed." Those are not threats, but the words of a soul that has experienced enough hunger, thirst, and loss. 
Ms. Luu's story ended with the sound of the temple bell, but its echo did not easily dissipate. Hell in this story is not only located in the underworld, but starts from wrong choices while alive. Believe it or not is everyone's right. But cause and effect does not need anyone to believe in order to exist. If you consider this an entertaining story, read it with alertness. If you see this as a warning, please remember: "Misguided love, blind possession, and violence all leave consequences far beyond a person's life. And when the door to hell is opened, tears of regret - even if they fall into rivers - cannot turn back time."
