tieu_de: Story 32: The Impartial Law of the Netherworld
tom_tat: People in everyday life are afraid of ghosts, demons, and hell. But those who have walked through the stories of yin and yang understand: the scariest thing has never been the devil, but people. Because q...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 32: THE IMPARTIAL LAW OF THE NETHERWORLD**}

People in everyday life are afraid of ghosts, demons, and hell. But those who have walked through the stories of yin and yang understand: the scariest thing has never been the devil, but people. Because demons only execute according to the law, but humans can cause hell while still breathing, living, and in human form. 
The story in the series "Mission to save the dead" about a female spirit named Da is cold proof of that. It is not the story of someone who was born evil, but the journey of a person who was pushed to the limit, then crossed the boundary of life and death with his own hands, sowed karma with blood, and finally had to pay the price with horrifying levels of punishment in the underworld. 
Da was born in a poor countryside, where darkness not only came when the sun set, but reigned right in her small house. Dad Da is a heavy drinker, every day passes in drunkenness and violence. Mother Da, a hard-working woman, sometimes went to sell goods at the market, bringing home every single coin in the hope of keeping the family a little warm. But alcohol turns a man into a villain. Every hangover is a beating. The sound of cursing, the sound of whips, and the sound of broken furniture rang out like the death knell of happiness.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-367-b99c363055cd.webp)

Da grew up in fear, learned to stay silent to survive, learned to bow his head to avoid attacks, and learned to swallow his tears. At the age of 27, Da went to work at a wood company and had a stable income. But that salary was not for her future, but became a source of support for her father's alcohol. Every time her mother advised her husband to stop, she was beaten more brutally, as a price to pay for loving her child.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-368-d83bb5d8429d.webp)

One time, the father's drunkenness exceeded all limits. He beat Da's mother to a broken jaw, forcing her to stay in the hospital for two months. But as soon as he was discharged from the hospital, before he had time to heal, he continued to drink and continue to beat him as if nothing had ever happened. Da used to think about death. But then she was afraid, not afraid of death, but afraid that if she died, who would protect her mother? Until one day, while at work, Da received bad news: her mother had passed away. Villagers recounted that at that time, her father was drunk, holding a knife, and beat her mother without missing a beat. No one dared to intervene, because he was no longer human.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-369-526e4293b979.webp)

In panic and despair, Da Region's mother ran and threw herself into the river. Four days later, the body was found. When Da stood before her mother's body, she did not cry out loud. The pain has gone beyond the ability to express. A part of her died with her mother from that moment. After the funeral, Da still had to go to work. Not only did her father not regret it, he also beat her even more, cursing that she was the reason her mother died. The next two years were two years where Da lived like a walking corpse. Until the fateful day. That afternoon, Da came home and saw his father lying unconscious from alcohol. In her mind there was no longer fear, nor pity, but a cold, chilling emptiness.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-370-885851ca4fe4.webp)

The memories of being beaten, the sound of my mother crying, the image of my mother's body floating in the river... all combined into a single thought: to end it all. Da tied his father's hands and feet, dragged him to the riverbank, dropped him into the water and tied a rope so his body wouldn't float away. Three hours later, she returned.
That man was frozen dead. Dad buried his father's body right in the garden. Crime takes place in cold sobriety.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-371-27c6c520d82e.webp)

No tears. Don't panic. There was only eerie silence. 
Three years later, on the way home from work at dusk, Da encountered a hauntingly familiar scene: a drunk man stalking a pregnant girl by the riverbank. The cry for help rang out in the dark night. No one came. In that moment, the image of her father beating her mother, the sound of the whip, the smell of alcohol, the sound of crying... all came rushing back. Da grabbed a rock and repeatedly hit the other man's head until he collapsed, dead on the spot.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-372-2d1a25f20695.webp)

The pregnant girl was saved. But another life was lost. The two quietly buried the body in the forest. Da returned home and continued living as if nothing had ever happened. Three months later, Da died suddenly in his sleep. No time to think. No time to repent. When she opened her eyes, in front of her were four words as red as blood: HELL A TIS.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-373-e61bb29902f3.webp)

The smell of sulfur, the smell of blood, and the smell of burning flesh rushed straight into my consciousness. Crying, screaming, and breaking bones echoed in all directions. The God of Hell said: – The great sin of filial impiety: killing one's father. – Murder: two lives. Verdict: Avici hell. But merit and sin are measured. Da saved two innocent lives. Therefore, she was reduced to prison door number 6.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-374-e70afec3ab58.webp)

Under prison door number 6, the horror no longer lies in the shape of the devil, but in the way cause and effect reflects sin in a cruel and terrifyingly accurate way. Da's hands and feet were tied tightly, his body no longer had the right to resist, then he was lifted up by the devil and dipped straight into the black sea of ​​boiling oil. The oil was not only hot, but also thick like tar, clinging tightly to the body, boiling gurgling, making horrible popping sounds like meat being dropped into a pan of fire. Each layer of the soul's skin is corroded, peeled off, and disintegrated, revealing the scorched bones inside.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-375-fc607aaf479a.webp)

Da screamed until he was hoarse, but his screams just disappeared into the sea of ​​oil, no one saved him, no one hurt him. At that moment, another horror even scarier than physical pain came: she realized that this punishment was exactly the same as the way she had pushed her father into the water in the past. Hell does not create new pain, but only copies the crime, magnifying it hundreds, thousands of times.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-376-d517a12a643f.webp)

Before he could calm down from the pain of boiling oil, Da was dragged into the steamer again.
The iron door closed, white hot steam poured in, enveloping the body. The meat did not burn, but gradually cooked, gradually disintegrating, pieces falling to the floor of the cage, soft like meat mud. When the pain reached its limit, the cage door suddenly opened, and cold winds from the underworld rushed straight into the steaming body, causing the feeling of heat and cold to intertwine, tearing apart every fiber of consciousness.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-377-dbe87038c835.webp)

That is the pain that does not allow complete death, because every time the body disintegrates, the devil causes it to regenerate intact, to continue being executed. Hell does not kill quickly, because its purpose is not death, but endless payment. At the next prison gates, Da was chased away like an animal. Every time the soul panicked and fled, rocks and stones thundered down from above, crushing the body into blood and mud, broken bones mixed with resentment. Surrounded by countless other souls, some have lost arms, some have no longer half their bodies, all crying and begging in despair. That sound did not sound like a human voice, but like the sound of an animal being butchered, prolonged, groaning, without end.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-378-4c21997ff4cb.webp)

I don't dare to tell them all, because even the memory of those punishments is enough to make my soul tremble. Hell here not only torments the body, but also crushes the will, breaking all hope of escape. When the series of punishments ended, Da thought he had been liberated, but that was just another level of karma. She was banished to earth as a hungry and thirsty ghost for twenty years. Extremely hungry, but unable to eat; I'm so thirsty, but I can't drink. I have to wander in the dark, hide and hide, always in fear of being captured as an underworld soldier, living an existence that is not human, not really a ghost. Only when the fairy gave a hint, my group came, burned incense, gave instructions and took Da to the pagoda to practice, did the path of repentance truly open up - fragile, but the only remaining way out.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-32-image-379-88bdebfa15a5.webp)

The story of the ghost girl Da shows a cold truth: hell does not begin underground, but begins in the human heart. Every action, every resentment, every time letting go before the moral boundary is recorded, not a single detail is missed. Parents - children are the deepest relationship, whether it is to repay kindness or revenge, killing the parent is still an indelible sin. Resentment can make people blind, but it should never be allowed to become a reason for killing karma. Believe it or not is each person's right, but cause and effect is never delayed, and if there is anything more terrifying than hell, it is when people turn themselves into demons, even while still living in the human world.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of AM LAW WITHOUT LOVE, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 33: Light at the End of the Dark Path
tom_tat: In the quiet space of the opening ceremony, when the incense smoke was still floating and had not yet dissipated, the ghost girl bowed her head and trembled, her voice seemed to echo from the depths of darkness. No one knows the real name, wise...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 33: LIGHT AT THE END OF THE DARK PATH**}

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-33-image-380-31cc9e85b607.webp)

In the quiet space of the opening ceremony, when the incense smoke was still floating and had not yet dissipated, the ghost girl bowed her head and trembled, her voice seemed to echo from the depths of darkness. No one knows her real name, no one knows her hometown, they only know that she died more than one hundred and thirty years ago. My group called the deceased Thao - a name to call, not to appease. Because the story she tells does not carry mercy, but is a vivid verdict of cause and effect, where hell appears not as a vague legend, but as a soul-crushing machine, operating with cruel precision. This is not a story for mere entertainment. This is a warning. Because hell does not just wait after death, but is built day by day from the choices people make while alive.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-33-image-381-86b0e0640d24.webp)

When she was alive, Thao was a beautiful woman. That beauty once brought happiness, but it also became a double-edged sword when she used it in exchange for money, support and pleasure. The first marriage broke up not only because of poverty, but because of lack of satisfaction and selfishness. Instead of choosing to be patient or leave sober, Ms. Thao embarked on the path of evil, flirting with one person after another, regardless of whether they were married or not. When she came to live with Mr. Thien, she brought her own daughter, but that mother's heart was closed to his son.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-33-image-382-4cd85b34ff53.webp)

Bias, malice and violence gradually accumulate into karma.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-33-image-383-19d2166542cb.webp)

The climax was the day the child was starving and secretly ate the rice that was not meant for him.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-33-image-384-aba1c306b2af.webp)

Thao's anger flared up like poisonous fire. With just one action in a moment, she threw a chair straight at her stepson's head, a child's life was extinguished, and the chain of cause and effect from then on became knotted and could not be untied.
She covered up the crime with lies, saying that the child tripped and died, and the innocent child's funeral took place, with the smile of a beast hidden behind the guise of a gentle woman.
She continued to indulge in gambling and prostitution, only to die in a mysterious accident - as if an invisible hand was waiting.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-33-image-385-74b1118f9574.webp)

There is no light to welcome the soul. There are only ghosts, books of sins and cold doors opening on each floor. Ms. Thao was led to the underworld, where every sin was named, without missing a single thing. At the first prison gate, she was punished for her false words and slander.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-33-image-386-1166b0a1e600.webp)

The tongue - the tool of creating karma - is stretched and forced to expose itself to the cold stone floor. Heavy objects grind past, crushing every fiber of the body. When the blade crumbles, it is restored, to continue suffering the punishment of melting. Hell does not allow sinners to die, because death is liberation, but here there is only repetition of pain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-33-image-387-9eea9bc687b8.webp)

She was pushed into a burning volcano - called Hell Fire Mountain. Hot rocks fell from above like rain, smashing the soul's body. The devil tore his limbs, stretching each part of his body on the turntable, where the tendons were tightened and blood flowed out.
Her screams mixed with countless other souls - those who once considered human lives as trash. From above, countless blades fell continuously, piercing the body, leaving hundreds of wounds that did not heal. This is the place to punish those who use their bodies as a tool to destroy other people's families, turn love into transactions, and turn desires into karma. The blood did not have time to dry and was blown cold by the underworld wind, causing the pain to be both burning and numbing to the very consciousness.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-33-image-388-bf48f757b9bf.webp)

In the end, she was banished to work pulling plows on rock-hard ground to pay for her gambling karma. Human status no longer exists, only animal status remains to pay debt. Every slow step is a whip. Every fall is a merciless beating. That is the price of bottomless greed. 
After the series of punishments, a rare opportunity opened up. Ms. Thao was pushed back to earth as a wandering spirit. No home, no relatives, no offerings. Hungry but unable to eat. Want to cry but have no more tears. Until the Mountain Immortal pointed out, my group came. Not by magic, but by revelation. Not to erase sins, but to show the only remaining path of repentance.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-33-image-389-39db72f3eebd.webp)

Ms. Thao knelt down, not asking for forgiveness, just asking to return to the temple to practice - like a soul exhausted after hundreds of years of repaying karma. Thao's story is not intended to intimidate, nor is it intended to defend or condemn any individual. It is a mirror of the law of cause and effect, where every action – no matter how well hidden – is recorded. Hell is not born from evil. Hell is born from greed, anger, and ignorance in the human heart. When people allow themselves to cross moral boundaries, disregard life, and destroy morality, at that moment, they have stepped one foot into hell - even though they are still living on earth. 
Believe it or not is each person's choice. But cause and effect does not need anyone to believe in order to exist. And if there is anything more terrifying than the stories of hell, it is this: people create their own hells, right from the time they are alive. I pray that whoever reads this will know how to stop at the right time. Pray that whoever makes a mistake will still have time to turn back. And pray for souls like Thao, after hundreds of years of pain, to finally find the way to light.

tieu_de: Story 34: The Severe Retribution of Filial Transgression
tom_tat: There are sins that, if you use words to describe them, would not end in three days and three nights. There are evil karmas that, if you use tears to wash away, will not be clean for a hundred lifetimes. And there are souls, when they fall...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 34: THE SEVERE RETRIBUTION OF FILIAL TRANSGRESSION**}

There are sins that, if you use words to describe them, would not end in three days and three nights. There are evil karmas that, if you use tears to wash away, will not be clean for a hundred lifetimes. And there are souls, when they fall into hell, every second of their existence is a punishment. In the next journey of the Mission to save the dead, my group was guided by the Mountain Immortal to find a dead man named Tang. This person does not remember his full name, age, or hometown. The only thing still imprinted in my consciousness is: two hundred years of being in hell.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-390-9580fc196ff5.webp)

The day the group arrived at the place where Tang's ghost was staying, a truck suddenly blew its horn shrilly, the sound tearing through the air.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-391-7858ec8d2453.webp)

Vong panicked and immediately disappeared.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-392-1c3d3ea6dd20.webp)

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-393-90604403a3c7.webp)

Only by using the correct method taught by the Immortals will the group be able to call back that trembling soul.
It took a lot of time for Tang to follow him back to the temple, and in a fear that had not yet dissipated, he recounted his life - a life that he himself admitted: even three days of recounting his sins would not end.

Vong Tang lived in ancient feudal times. When we are still human, we cannot create even a little bit of merit. Theft, killing, gambling, cheating, slander - all crimes are committed. But the heaviest, deepest, most unique sin is the great sin of filial impiety. Vong cursed his father and mother with unacceptable harsh words.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-394-a30ec86628ff.webp)

Parents buy food and throw it away. If you don't like it, throw away the rice cooker and leave your parents hungry and thirsty. After cursing, you leave, treating your work as trash. When you go to someone else's house and see something you can take, you're trying to steal it. If you have money, use it to gamble, then continue to sow more bad karma and spread bad things everywhere.
The pinnacle of depravity is when he turns his lust towards his close friend's wife. Don't rob with strength, rob with scheming. Fabricating, separating, sowing suspicion every day, little by little, until the other family falls apart. When the time was right, he bought poison, put it in wine, and invited his best friend to drink. Two cups of wine, one person's life collapsed right at the table. The body was quickly buried next to a creek near the mountain. The murderer leisurely moved into the victim's house and lived with his wife as if nothing had ever happened. And for the rest of his life, he continued to steal, gamble, be unfilial, and constantly create karma. At the age of 33, in a dream, he dreamed that two people came to arrest him. And died right in the dream.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-395-fda1bfc1c598.webp)

The soul is sent to the underworld. In front is Lord of Hell, next to him is the Judge. Just one sentence: "His crime alone, even three days will not be over." Vong Tang was banished to the 18th level of hell - the deepest and most terrible level.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-396-dfd9ed947dc1.webp)

But the punishment did not begin immediately. First, he had to reincarnate for 90 lives as a woman, to be raped, to experience the pain he had caused by destroying the happiness of other people's families. Ninety lifetimes pass, each lifetime is a new round of karma, a new chain of pain, injustices pile up endlessly. When those 90 lives are completed, the soul is returned to its original form - not to be liberated, but to begin true hell.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-397-f23f173bb219.webp)

The red-hot iron bed was the first punishment. The devil set fire to the bed until it was red.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-398-839674c17362.webp)

Vong was forced to lie down. The skin stuck to the metal, sizzling. Every time the pain is too much to turn over, each piece of "skin" is torn off, leaving a feeling of both burning and emptiness that extends to consciousness.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-399-5787cd7ca71f.webp)

Next, the ghost was forced to hug a heated copper pole. Both hands held tightly, the body gradually slid down. Each time he missed, his skin was stripped off along the bronze column, falling in a scream that was no longer human.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-400-591449fec6d4.webp)

Going to another prison door, he was forced to jump into a deep pit full of sharp iron. The iron spikes pierced the body, pinning it to the bottom of the pit. Blood spurts out, but you don't die, you don't faint, you have to stay awake to feel every moment of pain. In another prison, fiery rocks were thrown back and forth among the souls. There are no more friends or enemies, no more humanity. Everyone just knows how to throw so they don't get thrown. Head broken, body crushed, but still alive.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-401-46dd07f3826b.webp)

Because of the crime of calling his parents dogs, he was thrown into an iron dog prison. Iron dogs rushed forward, biting and tearing apart every part. The devil chopped up the rest and threw it to the dogs to eat. The soul convulses, still not allowed to die. Because of wasting food, he had to eat giant bowls of maggots, something more disgusting than death. And that's just a small part of the two hundred years of punishment: pulling tongues to plow buffaloes, raining blades through the body, stones throwing people to pieces... Punishments that just thinking about makes the soul tremble.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-34-image-402-92507f8801ae.webp)

After exactly two hundred years, the official ordered the book to be opened. Punishment ends. Vong was pushed to earth, in the position of waiting for the right person. Just three days later, he met my group. Before returning to the temple, Tang Tang trembled and said one last thing: "In hell, there are two types of sins: adultery and verbal karma."
Vong Tang's story is not to scare, nor is it to paint fear. It is the naked verdict of cause and effect. Every curse, every unfilial act, every deception, every bit of lust - is a brick to build one's own hell. People often don't believe because they haven't seen it yet. But once you see it, there's no turning back. Believe it or not is everyone's right. Watching to contemplate, or watching for entertainment, is also each person's choice. We just hope that, while we are still alive, we know how to keep our body - keep our speech - keep our mind - keep our mind. Because hell… never failed to make an appointment with anyone. I hope whoever reads this can stop before it's too late.

tieu_de: Story 35: The Poisonous Oath Fulfilled
tom_tat: People often think that words are just the wind, oaths are just a way to get things done. But in the world of cause and effect, each oath is a contract, each cruel sentence is a stab in the skin...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 35: THE POISONOUS OATH FULFILLED**}

People often think that words are just the wind, oaths are just a way to get things done. But in the world of cause and effect, each oath is a contract, each cruel sentence is a knife cut into the book of karma. There are people who do not receive retribution while they are still alive, but when they close their eyes and give up, hell will replace heaven. The next journey in the series "Mission to save the dead" is the story of a dead man named Nam, who carries the crime of ingratitude and betrayal before heaven and earth. This story does not need too much blood to live, because betrayal and lies are enough to push a soul straight down the darkest path of cause and effect.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-403-149399c4b924.webp)

Nam lost his parents when he was very young. In the middle of a lonely life, he lived thanks to the love of his neighbors. Among them, there is a woman without a husband and children, poor but with a simple wish in her heart: to have someone to continue her family when she gets old. Seeing that Nam worked hard and studied well, the woman adopted him. From then on, she worked hard to do all kinds of jobs: laborer, street vendor, hired worker... just to have money to feed her children. If there's anything delicious, she gives it all away. If anything is difficult, she bears it all. All her life she lived for the word "child".

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-404-263207574386.webp)

Thanks to that love, Nam passed the university entrance exam and went to Saigon to study. In the countryside, the adoptive mother continues to struggle, saving every penny to send to her children. In her eyes, Nam is not only her son, but the ultimate meaning of life.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-405-5add52611b4d.webp)

But from here, the seeds of betrayal began to arise. While studying at university, Nam met a girl. The girl's family is rich, fastidious, and values ​​the subject of marriage.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-406-474ef22f6929.webp)

Knowing his low status, Nam chose to erase his past, including the person who raised him.
When his girlfriend's family asked about him, Nam calmly lied that he was an orphan, had no father or mother, and was self-sufficient. That lie made the adults admire, move, and agree to let the two go back and forth.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-407-4e09995ea7c0.webp)

Tragedy happened on a seemingly normal day. Girlfriend came to the dorm to play. At that moment, Nam's adoptive mother went to Saigon to send things to her son. She quietly asked: "My dear, is there anyone here named Nam? I came to visit my son." At that moment, Nam panicked.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-408-3ddddaa2a4c2.webp)

In front of his lover and friends, he denied the person who gave birth to him a second time. Not stopping there, Nam let out a cruel oath: "Uncle, I lost my parents when I was young. If I had a mother now, I would be hit by a car on the street."
The oath rang out as coldly as a slash. The adoptive mother was dumbfounded. She didn't argue, didn't cry, just quietly turned away, carrying her broken heart with her.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-409-d72890179936.webp)

That night, Nam continued to swear again in front of his girlfriend's parents, affirming that he "didn't have a mother". And from here, the chain of cause and effect was tied into an irreversible knot. One month after being married, Nam returned to his hometown to find his adoptive mother. But she moved away. When returning to Saigon, the truck drove straight into Nam, crushing his body on the road. Flesh and blood splashed. The scene was exactly like the exclusive vow from years ago.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-410-0ce3149de3eb.webp)

Nam's soul left his body, watching people pick up the pieces of his body. I want to scream, but no one listens.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-411-8139ce9f3514.webp)

Want to cry, tears just fall in vain. A cold wind swept his soul away, and when he opened his eyes, Nam was standing in the middle of the underworld. There, there was no sound of mourning.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-412-a58608f515e5.webp)

Only the book of karma is opened, clearly recording every word, every oath, every ungrateful moment. Nam was not immediately banished to hell. The verdict for him was: 20 years as a hungry ghost on earth, to experience loneliness, hunger, and torment of conscience.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-413-3be70df9486c.webp)

During those 20 years, Nam wandered everywhere. Hungry but can't eat. Thirsty but can't drink. Watching others reunite, I am just a shadow trembling in the night. The most tormenting thing is not hunger and thirst, but the memory of the adoptive mother - her shocked eyes when she was rejected, her hunched back when she left. When the 20-year term ended, the Mountain Immortal instructed Ms. Hoa's group to come and explain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-35-image-414-0856d6a12946.webp)

But Nam's case is not like other deaths. Lord Diem allowed him to return to the temple to practice, but his sins were not erased. To practice is to attain enlightenment. As for karma, you still have to pay. Because hell is not just under the underworld. Hell truly begins from the moment people betray their kindness. 
Vong Nam's story is a chilling warning: If gratitude is not returned, heaven and earth will demand it. The oath is said, the cause and effect will keep. Many people think that going to the temple is the end of their sins. Not. The temple is just a place to enlighten the mind, but no one can erase the karma that has been sown. Biological parents or adoptive parents, the people who saved your life and raised you - are all great benefactors. Betraying them, denying them, swearing alone to protect immediate interests... is signing your own judgment. 
Believe it or not is everyone's right. But cause and effect have never missed anyone. And if there is anything more terrifying than hell, it is when people are still alive and have cut off their own conscience. I pray that whoever reads this will be able to keep the right words, the right heart, before it's too late.

COMMENTS:
After reading THOOC's story, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 36: Reckless Street Racing and Ghostly Haunting
tom_tat: There are people who die not because of poverty, not because of war, nor because of cruel fate, but because of their own hubris. In the human world, racing...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 36: RECKLESS STREET RACING AND GHOSTLY HAUNTING**}

There are people who die not because of poverty, not because of war, nor because of cruel fate, but because of their own hubris. In the human world, racing is often considered a pastime of impetuous youth. But in the afterlife, it is a serious crime, because every time you turn the gas is a disregard for life, not only your own but also that of countless other innocent people. The next journey of the Mission to Save the Dead is the story of a female spirit named Thuy Dung, who used her youth, wealth and life in exchange for a few minutes of thrills. And the price to pay for that extravagance does not end in death, but only begins in hell.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-36-image-415-62be94ce3129.webp)

Thuy Dung is the youngest daughter in a wealthy family in the countryside. My parents own more than 50 sugar cane farms, providing raw materials for the factory. They are financially abundant and do not lack anything. As the youngest child, Dung was pampered to the fullest. Get whatever you want, whatever you like. That abundance should be a great blessing, but when it falls into the hands of a child who is not taught about cause and effect, it becomes a disaster.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-36-image-416-63faec62eec1.webp)

Dung only studied until the end of 11th grade and then dropped out of school because she was mischievous and refused discipline. Instead of correcting, parents continue to respond: buy their child a motorbike. From then on, Dung started participating in races. Initially, it was racing in the village and commune. Then the thrills become boring. Dung invited his friends to go on a long trip, bringing with him the habit of running at high speed, treating mountain passes like a racetrack, and treating life like a joke.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-36-image-417-033ddcc012e3.webp)

On a dangerous mountain pass, Dung drove at high speed. The wind whistled in my ears, the hands of the clock jumped wildly. In that moment, Dung no longer heard any words of warning, only the intoxication of speed. Then whatever happens happens.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-36-image-418-cce19276d44c.webp)

With just one shift of the steering wheel, the car plummeted into the abyss. Dung's body hit the cliff, bones were broken, flesh was crushed, and blood splattered. Death came instantly, without a last word. When their parents received the news, they were dumbfounded. A specialized crane team had to be hired to lift her daughter's body.
The cold body was iced and taken back to the hometown for burial. But Thuy Dung's soul still followed, quietly watching her own funeral, hearing her parents' gut-wrenching cries without being able to say a word of apology. The boredom had not yet subsided when a car horn sounded on the street. Old habits resurface. Dung rushed out, looking for the familiar feeling of racing. And at that moment, an invisible hand emerged from the ground, yanking Dung's soul straight to the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-36-image-419-23f69a91f2cd.webp)

In front of Diem Chua Palace, Thuy Dung trembled and knelt down. The God of Hell said: "In your previous life, you did many good deeds, so in this life you are rich and beautiful. But when you have enough conditions to do good, you destroy yourself, disregard the laws of the world, and despise life." Dung cried and begged for forgiveness, citing his youth and incompetence.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-36-image-420-371fff1a1103.webp)

But cause and effect does not consider age, only behavior. Merit is merit, sin is sin. And Dung was escorted into a prison reserved for racers.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-36-image-421-f69f2a9220e9.webp)

The door to hell that has to be walked on the knees is one of the places that best exposes the cold cruelty of hell, where punishment not only punishes the body but also crushes the will of the soul. There were no ordinary whips or shackles, but only one command: run on your knees. Thuy Dung was forced by the devil to kneel on the jagged stone floor, sharp as a knife blade. Each time he moved, his knees scraped against the rocks, his flesh was torn apart, blood flowed out and mixed with the black dust, revealing trembling white bones. 
When she was alive, no matter how fast she drove and considered speed to be her pride, now, every second and every minute, she is forced to "run" with the most painful part of her body at the corresponding speed. The screams and cries echoed throughout the prison, but hell had no mercy. Every time she screamed, giant rocks fell from above like a rain of punishment, smashing the female spirit's body, causing pain upon pain. Not completely dead to be freed, nor fainted to forget, the soul is only suspended in a state of infinite pain, where time becomes the cruelest torturer.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-36-image-422-0ad530a016ad.webp)

But the hell didn't stop there. When she was still young, Thuy Dung was forced to return to the earth to suffer an even more terrible punishment: repeating her own death.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-36-image-423-cbeb640700a0.webp)

Time after time, she was pushed to the top of the pass, turned on the accelerator in desperation and then plummeted into the abyss. Every fall is a time when the body is broken, the bones are stuck in the rock, the flesh is torn apart, the blood flows like a stream, and the soul is torn apart by the most primal fear: fear of pain, fear of disappearing but not being able to die. That recurrence turns death into an endless loop, where painful memories do not fade but become increasingly deepened.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-36-image-424-91f9c323a4e7.webp)

Only when she finished her sentence was Thuy Dung led to the Nghiep Mirror - the place that reflected her entire past life: the blind indulgence, the crazy races, and the silent cries of her parents at the funeral. The mirror does not condemn, but it is that naked truth that is the final knife, causing the soul to belatedly awaken. Thuy Dung's story is therefore not just a sentence for racing, but a chilling warning about the hell of human choice. 
Speed ​​doesn't kill people by itself, but karma does. As long as your blessings last, your life will last; if your blessings run out, your life will not be preserved. It is each person's right to believe it or not, but cause and effect still operates quietly, waiting for the day when those who despise life must pay the price, sometimes with punishments even more terrifying than death.

tieu_de: Story 37: Karmic Authorization for Life Retribution
tom_tat: When she was alive, Mrs. Tinh was a rare female official who was appointed to manage a large town, a place with a large concentration of poor people, and often suffered from natural disasters and epidemics. In her hand is the relief fund...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 37: KARMIC AUTHORIZATION FOR LIFE RETRIBUTION**}

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-37-image-425-a4ae958fcc96.webp)

When she was alive, Mrs. Tinh was a rare female official who was appointed to manage a large town, a place with a large concentration of poor people, and often suffered from natural disasters and epidemics. In her hand is a relief fund - money used to relieve hunger and save the lives of hundreds, even thousands of people. That is a power not everyone has. But from that power, greed arises.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-37-image-426-6505d1e95aab.webp)

Each time the royal court granted 100 dong for famine relief, she only gave out 30, at most 50. The rest, she silently pocketed. On the books, everything is "according to procedure". But in real life, hungry people collapse on the streets, children die of thirst in their mothers' arms, and elderly people die because they cannot afford a bowl of thin porridge.
Their cries did not disappear into the air, but instead settled down, forming into the air of injustice, flowing straight to the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-37-image-427-4bf7d058960b.webp)

After being discovered and dismissed, Ms. Tinh returned to her hometown with a huge fortune gained from the blood and tears of poor people. In her early years, she lived in luxury and comfort. But conscience is not a stone. As the number of people dying from starvation increased, nightmares began to come. In her sleep, she heard moaning, knocking on the door in the night, and saw thin hands dragging her feet into a deep hole. Starting to panic, she gave money to charity, distributing rice, building bridges, building schools, and helping poor people until she was 68 years old. People mourned her, thinking that she was a "good official at the end of her life" who died while doing good deeds. But cause and effect does not look at the end, but looks at the entire flow of karma. The people who starved to death because of her - they did not receive a single grain of rice from that charity money.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-37-image-428-17c48be94e25.webp)

Hundreds of unjust souls gathered in the underworld, simultaneously suing the King of Hell. Crime: Misappropriation of public funds - indirect mass murder.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-37-image-429-f391b5f5d627.webp)

The King of Hell said a cold sentence: "Permission to claim your life." Mrs. Tinh died in her sleep – gently on the outside, horribly on the inside.
As soon as the soul left the body, it was pulled down into the underworld, without having time to understand what happened.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-37-image-430-98c026c93094.webp)

She was tied tightly to a red iron bed, with demonic fire burning from below. The heated metal stuck to the body, the skin sizzling and gave off a burning smell. Every time she struggled, her skin was peeled back, revealing her trembling bones. This is the punishment for those who eat other people's blood. Every embezzled coin is another time the iron bed gets hotter. Not dead. No fainting. There is only regeneration to continue being burned.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-37-image-431-df42a912aa57.webp)

Escaping from the iron bed, she was thrown into a deep hole. From above, giant blocks of stone continuously fell, crushing bodies. Each stone carries the image of a starving life. Broken bones. Distorted head. Broken internal organs. But as soon as the body disintegrates, the body reshapes to be crushed by rocks again. This is collective karma – when one person causes harm to too many people.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-37-image-432-98aeee6ba30b.webp)

At the last prison door, her head was placed between two giant stone slabs. The devil slowly pressed back. Not fast. Not strong. But slowly, so that every thought, every greedy plan while alive is crushed little by little. The sound of skull bones cracking. Consciousness remains. The pain lasts so long that the soul begs to be dissolved, but it is not allowed.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-37-image-433-5baf1a7cfb25.webp)

Thanks to her late good deeds during her lifetime and the dedication of her descendants, her sentence was reduced.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-37-image-434-1543948fdd4b.webp)

But he still had to endure three prison doors for more than 300 years on earth. If there is no dedication, no remaining blessings, she will still be stuck in the underworld. When she was released to earth, she was shocked by the strange world: high-rise buildings, cars roaring like iron demons.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-37-image-435-b61ff81e1216.webp)

After wandering for a few days, the Mountain Immortal gave us instructions, our group came to explain and took us to the temple to practice. 
Tinh's story is not simply horror, but a karmic verdict for those in power. Doing good deeds late can reduce the crime, but it cannot erase the blood that has been shed. Public funds are exchanged for human lives. Eat a penny, bear a portion of karma. Eat the food of hundreds of people, bear the karma of hundreds of lives. Believe it or not is each person's choice. But hell doesn't need faith to exist. Pray for those who are holding on to collective money, other people's right to livelihood, to stop before the door to hell opens - where there is no bribery, no judgment, and no way back.

tieu_de: Story 38: Carving Flesh to Feed the Mother-in-Law
tom_tat: (Readers can learn about the opera Thoai Khanh - Chau Tuan. By chance we met the famous character Thoai Khanh in this opera in real life - but in the next life...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 38: CARVING FLESH TO FEED THE MOTHER-IN-LAW**}

(Readers can learn about the opera Thoai Khanh - Chau Tuan. By chance we met the famous character Thoai Khanh in this opera in real life - but in the next life with the name Luu Phan)
In the midst of an impermanent world, where people are born - grow old - get sick - die in an endless cycle, there are stories not just to listen to, but to make people shudder, ponder and reflect on themselves. During my group's journey of the Salvation Mission, there were encounters that left both the narrator and the listener cold. And the story of the ghost girl Luu Phan - a soul carrying the memories of a life of virginity, a life of wealth, and a cruel death - is one such story. This is not only a personal tragedy, but also a harsh sentence of reincarnation - karma - and the underworld, where merit and sin are weighed without error.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-38-image-436-6bcf269a41df.webp)

Luu Phan's previous life was a poor woman named Khanh, who lived in a time of herding buffalo and cutting grass, working hard and being gentle. Although life is not rich, it has enough food, clothing, and love. When she reached puberty, she was matched with a poor but strong-willed man - Mr. Tuan, a scholar who studied history day and night. From the day she got married, her life took a turn full of sacrifice. In order for her husband to have money to study for exams, she sold her labor, doing all sorts of jobs, from light to heavy, from early morning to late at night.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-38-image-437-cc706073659f.webp)

Her youth passed in mud, sweat and the faint hope that one day her husband would pass and the family's life would change. The day Mr. Tuan passed the exam, it seemed like a day of bursting happiness, but it was also the day tragedy began. His handsome appearance and outstanding academic talent made him catch the princess's eye. He couldn't resist the king's order. He was forced to become a son-in-law, lived in the royal palace like a prisoner, did not have sex for three years, and kept all his vows to his poor country wife.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-38-image-438-b2c99c4b7879.webp)

Back home, she and her mother-in-law were tired of waiting. When they learned that her husband was exiled to the border for refusing the princess, the two sold all their assets, bought an old buffalo, and began a desperate journey to find her husband. Hunger, thirst, illness, tears and blood mixed together. When her mother-in-law was so hungry that she was exhausted, she peeled off her own meat and grilled it for her mother to eat. Not a single cry of pain. There is only blood flowing, a tired body, and a filial love that makes even ghosts and gods bow their heads. Finally, the family reunites. But her happiness was not yet complete, she fell seriously ill and passed away.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-38-image-439-ade9e0e5f6b6.webp)

When her soul left her body, she walked through the Demon Gate. Ahead was a cold darkness, thick fog, and wailing sounds rang out from all four directions. But when the God of Hell examined the book of life and death, there was not a single line of sin bearing her name.
Be loyal to your husband. Be filial to your mother. Sacrifice your body for others.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-38-image-440-d2129f582412.webp)

Those three great merits made Lord Diem admire. He said: "This person does not deserve to suffer. He must be given a rich life." She was destined to be reincarnated, although in her heart she was still looking forward to waiting for her husband to join her in reincarnation.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-38-image-441-bf473cace54d.webp)

She was reincarnated as a woman named Luu Phan, born into a wealthy family with endless fields and so much money that she couldn't spend her whole life. As an only child, she was pampered and lived in luxury. But that very wealth opens the door to evil.
After his parents died early, Luu Phan lived alone with a huge fortune. Relatives began to show their true faces. Sweet words, fake concern, then a bowl of chicken soup containing poison.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-38-image-442-6e7940cbd3c7.webp)

Death comes silently and cruelly. The body was quickly buried in the deep forest. No incense, no graves, no one knows.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-38-image-443-9cbfa7c9fe43.webp)

Luu Phan's soul could not descend to the underworld, so it wandered, wandered, starving for its soul for many years because its positive life still remained. Souls that cannot attain liberation often have to face heavy negative energy, where demons patrol, where the screams never stop. In hell, there are floors of torture only for the wicked, but there are also dark areas for unjust souls. Those places are so cold that the soul trembles, the wind blows like a knife cutting the soul's skin. There is a place where hell awaits judgment, where the soul has to kneel on sharp rocks, every step is a pain, every breath is a reminder of its cruel death.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-38-image-444-393e24f85608.webp)

It was in that state that Luu Phan was instructed by the Mountain Immortal, my group came to enlighten me, and led the dead to the temple to take refuge in the Buddha's door, ending their life of melancholy wandering. Luu Phan's story is not just a tragic tale, but a profound warning about cause and effect - reincarnation - karma. Being a good person does not necessarily avoid suffering, but doing evil certainly cannot attain liberation retribution.
The underworld is unbiased. The law of cause and effect is not overlooked. Samsara rotates endlessly. If people do not practice and do not keep a good mind, they will forever be stuck in an endless cycle of loan repayment. Believe it or not is each person's right, but whether or not to ponder determines our own future path. And as Duc shared: Listen to understand - understand to avoid - avoid so as not to pay the price of your soul.

tieu_de: Story 39: Hypocrisy Behind a Spiritual Façade
tom_tat: In the human world, there are people who wear "spiritual" clothes to make a living. There are people who practice their profession with their heart, keeping morality and ethics. But there are also people who take advantage of your invisible fear...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 39: HYPOCRISY BEHIND A SPIRITUAL FAÇADE**}

In the human world, there are people who wear "spiritual" clothes to make a living. There are people who practice their profession with their heart, keeping morality and ethics. But there are also people who take advantage of people's invisible fears to profit and bring disaster to others without knowing that every lie is recorded in the karma book, and every dishonest coin turns into a blade in hell. 
In my group's Journey to the Eternal Mission, there is a story that not only makes the listener's spine chill with the cruelty of the underworld, but also penetrates the severity of the law of cause and effect. The main character is the ghost girl To Lien - when she was alive, she was a feng shui master and a "famous" fortune teller. When she died, she became a guilty soul and had to go through terrifying and haunting prison doors. Believe and meditate. If you don't believe it, watch it for entertainment. But this story, if listened to with one's mind, will be a warning not for the faint-hearted.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-39-image-445-32f6235b0174.webp)

To Lien was born into a family with a tradition of feng shui and fortune telling for many generations. From great-grandparents to parents, the profession is passed down with care and heart. But in To Lien's life, everything took a different path. To Lien has no real psychic powers. What she has is a flexible tongue, a quick mind and the ability to manipulate other people's fears. When customers came to complain about failing businesses, troubled families, and lingering illnesses, To Lien immediately struck a chord with their insecurities. She drew out "fate", "yin energy", "ancestral karma", and then offered solutions using spells and feng shui items.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-39-image-446-82d75405b08f.webp)

Cheap items are priced many times higher. Rich people get a high price, poor people get less - just the way people look at the picture. Spells without spirituality, items without energy, all are just a cover for a scam wrapped in spiritual clothing. Not stopping there, To Lien also seduced gullible people to serve and give him money in the name of "keeping fortune" and "keeping happiness". Thanks to the family heirloom brand, more and more customers come. Money, gold and gems are piled high. To Lien's life was luxurious, prosperous, traveling everywhere, while behind were 705 people who were deceived into losing their money, losing their trust, and losing their peace of mind.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-39-image-447-34dc916d53e2.webp)

When To Lien was over seventy years old, still wearing expensive jewelry, she boarded a train. The light of gold and silver is also the thing that invites disaster. A group of people were watching from afar. When the ship docked, they followed and did not leave. When they reached a deserted road, they attacked. All jewelry was stripped away. But the evil has not stopped. Even though To Lien was old, she was still humiliated and raped in extreme fear and despair. Then, to erase the traces, they used rocks to smash the face until it was unrecognizable, then dragged the body into the deep forest and quickly buried it.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-39-image-448-976c2cddb877.webp)

Death came in pain, humiliation and resentment, just like the way she once sowed insecurity in others. The soul left the body but still had a tragic appearance: torn clothes, a dirty body, and a face disfigured by violence. The ghost escorted To Lien to the underworld. Screams and cries echoed from the depths of hell. In front of Diem Chua Palace, To Lien knelt down and continuously complained, saying that he had died tragically and unjustly. But when the karma mirror is looked down, everything appears clearly: every lie, every profiteering coin, every miserable face of the 705 people who were deceived. At this time, To Lien became silent. The God of Hell said: "Your death is the retribution of the karma you have sown. Heaven will repay, earth will demand, no mistake."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-39-image-449-376c69987ed8.webp)

When the door to hell opened, the space before To Lien's eyes was no longer an unknown darkness but a world that operated on pain. The first prison door appeared with a giant stone turtle shell, cold and heavy, the surface covered with cracks like the souls that had been crushed inside.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-39-image-450-152f97a57593.webp)

When he was alive, To Lien used the turtle shell to cast hexagrams, tell destiny, and bend other people's beliefs for money. Now, she was dragged by the devil, forcing her whole body into the slowly rotating turtle shell, with each rotation causing her bones to be squeezed to the point of suffocation. 
Every time his head emerged to take a fragile breath, the devil's iron rod immediately descended, hitting him directly on his skull, with a dry impact echoing in the middle of the dungeon. The head was broken, the consciousness was shattered, but before it could sink into nothingness, the body was regenerated, the pain repeated without end. The horror reached its climax when 705 people who had been deceived by To Lien appeared one after another, each person stepped forward and coldly took a hit.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-39-image-451-577bc7c652f5.webp)

Each blow was not only physically painful but also extremely humiliating, because it was the past victims who directly punished her. After 705 strokes, 705 deaths and resurrections, the prison door closed behind him. But that's not the end.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-39-image-452-a3ad668dc766.webp)

At the second prison door, all the fraudulent money and gold that To Lien had appropriated was converted into fiery red stones, so hot that the surrounding air vibrated with heat. The devil forced her to hold each stone with her mouth, the fire licked her body, making a horrible sizzling sound, and the smell of burning flesh spread throughout the dungeon. Her mouth was torn open, her tongue burned black, but she was not allowed to faint, much less die. As soon as the stone fell from her mouth, she was forced to kneel with her bare knees, dragging her body from the hot prison door to the cold prison door. The sudden change in temperature causes the body to crack, freeze, then burn again, causing pain upon pain. That punishment was repeated over and over again, day and night, until every penny of money was "paid off" with blood and fire.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-39-image-453-b57483409bd2.webp)

After an immeasurable length of time, when his karma had been fully paid, To Lien was pardoned to prepare to enter the cycle of reincarnation. Because that time coincided with the seventh lunar month, she was allowed to come to earth as a ghost, wandering between the boundary between yin and yang. Thanks to the Mountain Immortal's guidance, our group came, explained and brought the deceased To Lien back to the temple. For the first time after many years of being immersed in ambition and pain, she accepted to let go, did not rush to reincarnate, stayed at the temple to repent, cultivate her mind, and wash away the remaining karma before returning to the underworld according to the correct process.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-39-image-454-46a6fcd816a5.webp)

The story of the female spirit To Lien is a living verdict of the law of cause and effect. Spirituality is not a joke, nor is it a tool to threaten or manipulate other people's fears for personal gain. Deceiving people with faith, sooner or later you will have to pay with a hundred thousand times more pain. Hell doesn't need anyone to guide it. Cause and effect do not need anyone to remind. Every lie today can be a prison door that is silently opening tomorrow. If you believe then meditate, don't believe in watching entertainment, but for those who are practicing spirituality, remember: "If you do it with your heart, you will be blessed, if you do it with greed, there is no turning back." Finally, I wish everyone to always maintain a bright mind, good heart and practice diligently.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of THE SPIRITUAL SHELL, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 40: The Vengeful Eel Spirit
tom_tat: In the human world, people often only see immediate benefits and forget the invisible but extremely strict law of cause and effect. There are karmas that, when sown, are not immediately reported...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 40: THE VENGEFUL EEL SPIRIT**}

In the human world, people often only see immediate benefits and forget the invisible but extremely strict law of cause and effect. There are karmas that, when sown, will not be reported immediately in the present life, but when they close their eyes and give up, each living debt will appear, leading the soul into horrible levels of hell with no way out. The story of the eel turning into a spirit of vengeance that we follow together is a horrifying testament to the long-lasting karma of killing, to the pain that humans cause and then seem to forget.

With the Mountain Immortal's instructions, my group came and enlightened Lien and took her to the pagoda to practice. During the process of recovery, Ms. Lien recounted her entire life, from the years she earned a living by killing eels to her tragic death and journey to repay her karma in hell. The story is not only a fear, but also a warning to those who are accidentally or intentionally creating killing karma without knowing it.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-40-image-455-4ad63a81dca4.webp)

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-40-image-456-ef84b715429c.webp)

When she was alive, Mrs. Lien died at the age of 43. She was a gentle, diligent woman who followed her husband to do business. Before getting married, she never worked in a profession related to killing. But since she came to her husband's house, Mrs. Lien has been stuck with the profession of selling eel porridge and supplying eel meat to pubs and restaurants for 18 years. Mrs. Lien's husband is a very skilled eel catcher. Every day he goes to the field, he catches many. The eels are big, strong, and live a long time.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-40-image-457-3fb99f52b68d.webp)

From a small eel porridge shop, the family gradually expanded into a drinking shop, the economy was well-off, and customers came and went in droves. Every day, dozens or hundreds of eels are slaughtered. Eel blood poured down not just in one day, but for nearly two decades. It is worth mentioning that Mrs. Lien does not just kill eels for regular cooking. She is also famous for eel blood pudding, a dish that requires poking the eel alive, keeping the eel from dying immediately, to get fresh blood. Each time, the eels thrashed and struggled in pain, their eyes wide open filled with resentment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-40-image-458-51056446b4a2.webp)

But for profit, for food, Ms. Lien still does it, day after day, considering it normal. The tragedy happened on a seemingly "winning lottery" day. Ms. Lien's husband caught a nest of eels up to 30 pounds, all eels were large, strong, and unusual. Joy overshadowed reason, the couple decided to keep all of these eels for processing. When Mrs. Lien reached into the bucket to catch eels, the eels were not afraid, but simultaneously rushed to bite her hand.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-40-image-459-638e9bbfcbe0.webp)

The terrifying thing was that they bit but did not let go, one by one, then five or six, seven or eight at the same time. Even though patrons and people around rushed to help, the eel's body was as slippery as grease, and no one could remove it.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-40-image-460-f5d00138199e.webp)

Mrs. Lien's blood flowed red throughout the eel box, a strong fishy smell wafted throughout the restaurant. In the midst of the chaos, a stranger appeared and with just a glance said: "This woman's karma is very heavy. Caught a nest of eels, today is the day to repay the debt."
After this stranger recited the spell, the eel released it, but it was too late.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-40-image-461-47987dd4c3ac.webp)

Ms. Lien had a seizure, foamed at the mouth and died on the spot. Two years later, her husband also had a stroke and passed away, leaving the restaurant deserted and cold, his karma not yet fully paid off. Ms. Lien's soul left her body and was immediately escorted by demons to the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-40-image-462-7ecf44f00b00.webp)

Here, all the eels she had ever killed were weighed. Each pound of eel is equivalent to 1 year of punishment in positive time. The number that appeared made even the devil cold. 
First Hell Gate – Living Eel Hell

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-40-image-463-602a628bd4c4.webp)

Ms. Lien was pushed into a space full of eels. From the ground, from the cliffs, from the damp air, eels crawl out like streams. They penetrate every hole in the soul's body: mouth, ears, nose, eyes, anus, and then creep into the internal organs. The feeling of being torn from the inside made Mrs. Lien scream, but the sound was swallowed up in the horrible slithering sound. 
Second prison door – Hook the head and cut the body

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-40-image-464-f37069d313cf.webp)

The devil sent a nail to Mrs. Lien's head, hanging her up like she used to hang an eel. The cold knife slashed along the soul's body, each layer was split just like the way she used to cook eel meat. Each stab is a resurgent memory of killing, a hundred times more painful. 
The third prison door – Draining all the blood
Hundreds of eels clung to Mrs. Lien, sucking every drop of her soul's blood, until only her dry body remained. Die - live - recreate, then be sucked again. The punishment lasts no days or months, only endless suffering.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-40-image-465-cebeb5ab48e1.webp)

After a long period of punishment, Ms. Lien completed her hellish karma but was still unable to escape and had to go to earth to become a hungry and thirsty ghost. After 6 months and 20 days, thanks to the blessings of many generations, she was instructed by the Mountain Immortal so that my group could come to enlighten her and take her to the temple to practice. Mrs. Lien realized that it was the years of ignorance, treating the lives of other species as commodities, that pushed her into the abyss of suffering. 
The story of the eel becoming a star and the ghost girl Lien is a chilling warning about the karma of killing. Killing living beings for food and profit seems like a small thing, but when accumulated over the years, karma becomes a fierce wave that sweeps the soul into hell with no way back. If you believe then think about it, if you don't believe then consider it as an entertaining story. But for those who believe in cause and effect, remember: "The knife that cuts today will return to you tomorrow." Finally, I hope everyone learns a lesson for themselves, lives more virtuously, reduces killing karma, keeps a bright mind, and always diligently practices.
