tieu_de: Story 41: Dismembered into Thirteen Pieces
tom_tat: In the impermanent cycle of human life, people often mistakenly believe that death is the end, that their wrongdoings while alive, as long as they are cleverly hidden, no one will notice...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 41: DISMEMBERED INTO THIRTEEN PIECES**}

In the impermanent cycle of human life, people often mistakenly believe that death is the end, that their wrongdoings while alive, as long as they are cleverly hidden, no one will know. But few people understand that, three meters above the head there is a god, below the feet is the book of life and death, all good and evil actions are recorded without a single mistake. Especially adultery and adultery - karma that both destroys family happiness, brings suffering to others, and digs a hole to bury oneself. And now, together, we follow the Journey of the Redemption Mission, listen to the scary story of a female spirit named Lan, who died at the age of 33, to clearly see the fierce retribution of adultery in the dark hell. Those who are having an affair, please practice hugging the hot copper pole to get used to it, so that if you have to commit a crime in the future, you will be less surprised...

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-41-image-466-7eff32e94a98.webp)

When she was alive, Lan was a normal woman, beautiful, and had a family. She fell in love with a man but was forbidden by her parents, because she had a hunch that this man was promiscuous and untrustworthy. However, because of the call of her heart, Lan disregarded her parents' advice and disobeyed her parents to marry that man. The first years of marriage passed in fake rosy terms. The husband shows love, pampering, and no lack of material things. But the needle that had been in the bag for a long time finally came out, and the husband's philandering nature gradually revealed itself.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-41-image-467-aab2a106b0eb.webp)

He cheated again and again, leaving Lan in pain and humiliation. Because she loved her so much, because she still had two children, Lan continuously forgave, deceiving herself that if she was patient, the family would be peaceful. But the more she endured, the more she was trampled on. The husband still suffers from the same disability, neglects his family, and falls in love with another woman. At some point, an unwholesome thought arises. Lan thought: "If he eats spring rolls, she eats spring rolls." And from there, she slid down the path of adultery.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-41-image-468-c1f80cafad2c.webp)

After divorce, the door of freedom opens, but it is not freedom of liberation, but freedom of depravity. Lan dated a series of men, from single to married. Whoever calls comes, whoever invites follows, sex and sexuality have no boundaries. According to the book of life and death in the underworld, Lan had relationships with 13 men, 9 were married, 4 were single. Not only did she destroy the happiness of 9 families, Lan also spread social diseases, causing many men to fall into despair, resentment, and deadlock.
Betrayed wives are filled with anger and sow deep resentment. And then, walking at night sometimes meets ghosts. During a secret affair with a married man, Lan was discovered by his wife. Not just once, but many times.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-41-image-469-33f2fcc3f22d.webp)

The betrayed woman's jealousy was suppressed to the extreme, turning into evil thoughts of revenge. She prepared high concentration acid, and in a cruel moment, sprayed Lan from head to toe. Heart-wrenching screams, burning skin, and a strong smell of death. Lan fainted in pain, and died on the way to the hospital. The body was deformed, burned black, and the human figure was no longer recognizable.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-41-image-470-9cbf9885276c.webp)

As soon as her last breath ended, a ghost appeared, dragging Lan's soul straight down into the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-41-image-471-92dce3e777ba.webp)

At Diem Dai Palace, the karma book is opened. Every act of adultery, every secret orgy, is clearly visible. Lan knelt down, cried and complained, but Diem Chu coldly said: "Adultery - adultery, no one can escape the Harsh Reflection Mirror. Even a single unwholesome thought is recorded, let alone the action." Behind Lan is a long line of male and female sinners, most of whom are guilty of adultery. The gates of hell are wide open, because this karma is too much in this world.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-41-image-472-6652004000b2.webp)

Lan was dragged into the first prison door by the devil. Here, she was roasted alive, turned around like a roast pig on earth. The skin cracked, the flesh fell, and the burning smell spread throughout the prison.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-41-image-473-9e7c03f27786.webp)

Lan is still alive, still feeling extreme pain. The ghost used an iron pitchfork to blind his eyes and said: "So that you will no longer look at men and start thinking about it." 
When the body was "ripe", the ghost ordered Lan to be cut into 13 pieces. 
Each segment corresponds to a man she has harmed.  9 songs for 9 broken families, 4 songs for 4 sick, desperate people. Die – then live again. Live – then continue to suffer punishment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-41-image-474-42227ef09246.webp)

Before stopping, Lan was pushed to the next prison door. Here, the devil ordered her to rub her body on a sharp iron table, like washing clothes on wood grain. Rub until there is only a white skeleton left. The punishment repeated endlessly, dying and then coming back to life, the pain was beyond description.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-41-image-475-b00b922275a4.webp)

In prison with Lan was another woman - one who left her husband and children with her lover, then was murdered by her lover.
Both have been guilty for more than twenty years, with no release date known. Lan choked up and confessed: "When I was alive, I didn't believe in cause and effect. I thought death was the end. Now I know... it's too late to regret."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-41-image-476-06754d49221b.webp)

After a long period of suffering, Lan was sent to earth to become a hungry ghost. Fortunately, thanks to the Mountain Immortal's guidance, my group followed the instructions and came to enlighten us, brought the dead to the temple to practice, and relied on Buddha's door to partly repent of their karma. Lan's story is a wake-up call for those who are disregarding morality and cause and effect. Adultery is never a small matter, it destroys the family, sow resentment, and in the end the karma returns to the perpetrator.
Death is not the end.  Cause and effect does not leave out anyone who is faithful is a blessing - adultery is a disaster. If you believe, reflect to correct yourself. If you don't believe it, consider it a scary story for entertainment. But I hope that after hearing this, everyone will know how to avoid being afraid, and know how to keep their morals as human beings, live well - live rightly - live faithfully, so that they don't have to meet each other at the hot bronze pillar.

tieu_de: Story 42: The Malicious Cat Spirit
tom_tat: In the human world, people often think that only humans know hatred and hold resentment. However, few people understand that all things have spirits, from trees, rivers and mountains to...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 42: THE MALICIOUS CAT SPIRIT**}

In the human world, people often think that only humans know hatred and hold resentment. However, few people understand that all things have spirits, from trees, rivers and mountains to animals around us. When the spiritual energy gathers long enough, that creature is no longer an inanimate object, but has entered another level of existence - a spirit animal, even a star. And once spiritual, the resentment karma born is as deep as that of humans. Today's journey in the Salvation Mission is a scary story, told by the deceased himself to my group, then compiled and sent to Duc.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-42-image-477-8f5d13fd8ac5.webp)

No additions or subtractions, no fabrications. If you believe, think about it to correct yourself. If you don't believe, then consider it as a spiritual story for entertainment. But hopefully, after hearing this, no one will dare to take killing lightly. The main character of the story is a dead man who died at the age of 37, died in strange circumstances, related to a black cat turned into a ghost and an inescapable life debt. 
When he was alive, this man had a wife and three children. Although his life was not abundant, his life was peaceful. He does all kinds of jobs, as long as he has money to take care of his family, not afraid of suffering, not afraid of hardship. He is not an evil person, nor is he a deceitful person. However, just a moment of anger and ignorance pushed him into a cruel spiral of cause and effect. When he turned 37 years old, in the neighborhood there was a man who died of an incurable disease. The funeral was held according to custom, with the body placed under a mosquito net. On the third day, when many guests came to pay their respects, a terrible incident happened. A black cat came out of nowhere and jumped straight into the mosquito net and jumped over the dead man's body.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-42-image-478-927ddcc51315.webp)

At that moment, the corpse that had been lying for three days jumped up, its body convulsed, its mouth opened as if it wanted to scream. The scene caused chaos at the funeral, people ran away, others were so scared that they collapsed. According to folklore, cats jumping over corpses is a big taboo, carrying extremely heavy evil spirits. In the midst of the chaos, the man - who later died - out of fear and panic, jumped into the mosquito net and grabbed the black cat's tail. In excitement, he threw the cat several times until it died on the spot. The cat's death was extremely tragic. The body convulsed, teeth bared, eyes widened, and blood flowed. 
According to legend, before the cat stopped breathing, the cat's eyes still stared at him, not leaving for even a moment, that look seemed to be engraved straight into his soul. The funeral then continued, the mosquito net was tied tighter, no animal dared to come near. Everyone thought it was over. But in reality, resentment has only just begun.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-42-image-479-d6bdc4154e8d.webp)

Two days later, at night, he accidentally saw three white cats standing in the yard, staring at him in the dark. I don't care. In the morning, I discovered that my child had taken those three cats and raised them. Since the three white cats appeared, his family has continuously encountered misfortunes: - His parents suddenly fell ill - The children are constantly sick - The family is in turmoil and quarrels endlessly - He himself lost his job and was unemployed for a long time. 
Disaster follows disaster, as if an invisible hand is suffocating the whole family's fortunes. One day, while going to the market, he met a strange man. This person looked at him for a long time and then said: "You once killed a black cat that jumped over a human body, right? That cat was not an ordinary cat, but a mature cat. The three white cats you are raising are related to it." The stranger gave him a talisman, telling him to burn it and mix it with water for the cats to drink and then let them go somewhere else, otherwise the family would face great disaster. He half believed and half doubted. On the way back, it rained and the talisman got wet.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-42-image-480-44b49c359e91.webp)

Instead of drying it and doing as instructed, he forgot the talisman in the basin of water and let everything pass. That is the last chance to resolve resentment. Three days later, while sleeping, he fell into a semi-conscious state. Suddenly I saw a figure entering the house. He tried to open his eyes and saw a human body, but the face was that of a black cat, exactly like the cat he had killed. Its hands tightened around his neck, the strength was cold and cruel. He couldn't scream, couldn't struggle. And dying right in the dream, the soul leaves the body. The three white cats then disappeared without a trace.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-42-image-481-ebfe52a94d75.webp)

After death, he was not led by ghosts or Black White Impermanence. Instead, he met the divine mandarin who governed the area. This person said: "Your fate has not yet ended, your yang life is still alive. Because of the karma of killing spiritual objects, you must wander the earth until your yang lifespan is complete." 
During that time, thanks to the Mountain Immortal's guidance, my group came to enlighten me and took me back to the temple to study. But studying does not mean the end of sin. When enough time has passed, the soul must return to the underworld to continue examining karma and reincarnation. The story of mistakenly killing a cat to become a ghost is a profound warning. It's not just humans who have resentment. Mascots are unjustly killed, especially those with high spirituality and extremely strong resentment. Network debt, in the end still has to be paid with the network. Through this story, each person should: - Limit killing, if you can stop, the better - Do not arbitrarily kill dogs, cats, and wild animals - Do not bring strange objects, roadside stones, old trees home - Respect the life of all things Cause and effect is not wrong one inch. Whatever you sow – reap. Can't hide from people - can't hide from heaven.

If you believe, think about it and fix it. If you don't believe it, it seems like a scary story. Finally, I wish everyone to live a good life - less killing - more happiness, so that the path of life will be peaceful, and not meet each other in the dark underworld.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of CAT TINH, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 43: Making Amends for Unread Liturgies
tom_tat: In the impermanent world, there are people who wear good robes, chant Buddhist scriptures, and do meritorious deeds at the temple doors, making people admire and trust them. So...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 43: MAKING AMENDS FOR UNREAD LITURGIES**}

In the impermanent world, there are people who wear good robes, chant Buddhist scriptures, and do meritorious deeds at the temple doors, making people admire and trust them. However, good and evil do not lie in form, but in the true mind and behavior. Karma does not consider where you stand or what name you have, but only looks at what you have done with your greed, your lies, and your own desires.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-482-5d738faeca88.webp)

And now, together we continue the Journey of the Redemption Mission. Today's main character is a female spirit named Trieu, who has been wandering on earth for 6 months and 25 days. Thanks to the Mountain Immortal's guidance, my group had the opportunity to come to explain and bring the deceased back to the temple. During the revelation, the ghost girl Trieu recounted her entire life, death and the terrible punishments in hell that she had suffered. If you believe, reflect to correct yourself. If you don't believe it, watch it as a spiritual story for entertainment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-483-5310ee677276.webp)

When she was alive, Ms. Trieu lost both her parents at a young age, grew up lacking family, and had to fend for herself in the cold life. By middle age, she was still unmarried and lived alone.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-484-ba35a0186311.webp)

It was during those lonely days that she went to the temple as spiritual support. At first, Ms. Trieu did her work very sincerely: sweeping the temple grounds, cleaning Buddha statues, clearing grass, and pulling up trees. Gradually, she was exposed to the scriptures, read quickly, remembered long, and recited fluently.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-485-f9dbc522ab97.webp)

Because she is agile, resourceful, and polite, she is trusted and loved by the monks, often allowing her to accompany her when reciting prayers for families. In the early days, everything was pure and not seeking profit. But then, money began to speak. After many years of following the monks to pray, Ms. Trieu's reputation spread far and wide. She was assigned to manage the ceremony money, receive families sending ashes and incense to the temple, and then report back to the monks. And from here, greed arose. The homeowner offered 2–3 million, she reported only 500 thousand. The homeowner offered 1 million, she said it was only 200 thousand. The difference in money, she silently pocketed. More seriously, for families who send ashes or spirits to the temple, she offers 20–30 million, depending on wealth. But when she reported it to the monk, she only said that the family offered 2-3 million, and that the large amount of money was taken for full profit.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-486-f2d5dd1341b5.webp)

In many cases, she received money and did not perform a ceremony, did not chant sutras, and did not pray for the deceased, allowing the living and the deceased to be deceived. In 12 years, the amount of money she embezzled amounted to more than 3 billion VND. During the process of working as a "chantist", Ms. Trieu met many people. Among them is a sworn sister, called Ms. Liu An. Ms. Luu An's husband is Mr. Chien, a stylish and well-spoken man. Between Ms. Trieu and Mr. Chien, an ambiguous relationship gradually arose. One side has money and loves guys. One side has health and loves money. Mr. Chien swore to the sea, both flirting and defaming his wife, Ms. Luu An, making Ms. Trieu immersed in the illusion of love.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-487-0ff6a0dc5960.webp)

She poured money into Mr. Chien: buying land, shopping, providing everything. Each gift was exchanged for sweet words, making her confused and unable to escape. Money from deceiving Buddha's affairs is then used for sexual immorality and adultery, karma upon karma. One day, a family in Canada invited Ms. Trieu to chant prayers for her mother who had just passed away, promising to pay 25 million VND, covering all expenses. So excited, she invited three more friends to go with her. After the ceremony, the homeowner also rewarded money, everyone was happy. On the way home, Ms. Trieu called to meet Mr. Chien with great joy. But cause and effect don't wait until tomorrow. The car suddenly rushed down the mountain pass. Four people in the car and the driver died on the spot. Flesh and blood were torn apart, there was no human form left.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-488-38f24e27feb1.webp)

After her death, Ms. Trieu's soul was still busy looking for money and gold to bring with her. Suddenly a fierce wind blew, she fainted, and when she woke up she was in the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-489-b314a9eae43e.webp)

At the Palace of Hell, she complained, claiming that she had done many good deeds. But when examined in the Mirror, all acts of embezzlement, deception, fornication, and adultery appear clearly. The God of Hell said: "In this world, merit is equal to merit - sin is sin."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-490-ab76b4e3f7c2.webp)

First of all, Ms. Trieu's soul was escorted to the prison of reciting the scriptures, where the light only flickered like fireflies in the eternal darkness. She was placed on an iron spiked table, each sharp point pierced her skin, causing each breath to bring sharp pain to her bones. In front of him was a scripture dense with words, forcing him to strain his eyes to read each word, even though blood trickled down from his eye sockets and mixed with cold sweat. As long as the eyelids droop for a moment, the devil's iron hammer immediately hits the head, smashing the consciousness, forcing the soul to wake up in the cold laughter of the underworld. In that place, there is no concept of day or night, only endless fatigue and regret that gnaws at the soul every second of every moment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-491-ffe1deb0c0c6.webp)

Not stopping there, she was dragged straight to the boiling copper prison, where the temperature was so hot that the air seemed to burn. The devil used an iron skewer straight through her body, hung her up like a sacrifice, then squeezed her mouth tightly, pouring streams of red boiling copper water into her throat. The molten metal poured down into the stomach, causing the abdomen to swell like a tight drum, the flesh stretching to the point of exploding in desperate moans. But before death can come, the body is reincarnated, to continue to drink, continue to explode, repeating over and over again in a painful cycle of reincarnation with no way out.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-492-d492b004180e.webp)

For the crime of fornication and adultery, the punishment became even more barbaric. She was stripped naked, forced to hug a red-hot copper column, her flesh sizzling, the burning smell spread throughout the gloomy space. Every time his body slid down in pain, the ghost would beat him and force him to climb back up and hug him from the beginning.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-493-f3a4a1446558.webp)

After that, she was placed on a red iron table, her body dismembered, letting iron birds peck out her eyes, iron dogs tear her stomach, and iron snakes wrap around her neck, taking turns pecking away pieces of her soul's flesh in an echoing scream, echoing into the void of the cold darkness.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-494-ba5db21b8a70.webp)

After a long period of suffering all those fierce punishments, Ms. Trieu's soul was banished back to earth in a state of wandering, hungry, thirsty, and helpless. Fortunately, thanks to some of her remaining merit from living a meritorious life at the temple, she was guided by the Mountain Immortal, met my group and was taken to the temple to study, relying on the light of Buddhism to repent and repay her karma.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-43-image-495-cc6302fee0ff.webp)

The story is a profound lesson of cause and effect for those who work related to spirituality - belief - money: when receiving money, you must do it responsibly, do not use the name of Buddha to cover up your greed, because adultery - deception - greed, no matter how discreet, will one day have to pay the price. Cause and effect does not leave anyone behind; If you believe, then correct yourself. If you don't believe, then watch and be afraid, to live uprightly, to do your duty, to practice diligently, to stay away from the boiling hells, iron dogs, and iron birds of the dark underworld.

noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 44: THE TERRIBLE VERDICT ON ADULTERY**}

In the journey of the Redemption Mission, there are stories that when heard seem to be just threats, but the deeper you dig, the more chills run down your spine. These are not just idle words, but fragments of bloody memories, tears and resentment of the spirits who once fell into the cause and effect of adultery - adultery. Today's story continues to be such a wake-up call. Believe it or not is each person's right, but once listened, no one can say that he or she does not shudder at what awaits in the underworld. 
The main character of the story is Ms. Trinh, a female spirit who has experienced extremely terrible retributions: being tortured with a drill in hell, then reincarnated as a pigeon or sparrow for many lifetimes to repay the karma of adultery and dividing other people's families. This is a story told directly by the deceased, compiled by my group and sent to Duc, with absolutely no embellishments or fabrications. Listen to contemplate, to be afraid, and to know and stop while there's still time.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-496-fbf722810b70.webp)

When she was alive, Ms. Trinh was a beautiful, talented woman, had a family and a gentle and hard-working husband. That husband does not know how to say sweet or romantic words, but silently takes care of everything in the house, takes care of the children, and takes care of every meal and every piece of clothing. However, that very honesty became the thing that made Ms. Trinh disgusted. She often criticizes her husband for being rustic, dry, and unworthy of her.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-497-8f550e4b525c.webp)

At work, Ms. Trinh met a stylish, gallant man with a clever tongue. The compliments seemed harmless at first, but gradually planted the seeds of taboo emotions in her heart. Ms. Trinh did not wait, did not keep her distance, but actively flirted, even though she was married. When she learned that the man was married, she still turned a blind eye, determined to interfere with the happiness of others. From then on, Trinh's family began to fall apart.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-498-4dcbd9ec9366.webp)

She was cold to her husband, neglected her children, and used work as an excuse to spend the night with her lover. A husband lost his wife, another family lost its father, it all started with greed and selfishness. After many years of having an affair in the dark, the two finally left their wives and husbands to be together. But happiness built on other people's tears will rot sooner or later.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-499-29f5c725d1ae.webp)

When living together, conflicts begin to arise. The other man was no longer interested and continued to have an affair with a younger girl.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-500-a9f8bad68a23.webp)

Betrayed, disoriented, tormented by jealousy and pain, Ms. Trinh chose to end her life at the age of 35.
But she did not know that death did not end suffering, but only opened a door a hundred times darker.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-501-497ff116f67f.webp)

As soon as her soul left her body, Trinh was ordered by the devil to use a cold iron chain to drag her down to the underworld, where the darkness was as thick as mud, the smell of blood and burning metal mixed together made her soul tremble. The crime was pronounced clearly, each word was like a slash to the soul, and she was immediately banished to prison holding a hot bronze column.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-502-7560709790aa.webp)

The copper pillar was as red as embers, the skin sizzling as soon as it touched it, the burning smell spread throughout the gloom. Every time I fell down in pain, the devil would whip me and force me to climb up and hug again.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-503-4504c5dfdcd5.webp)

The skin was torn, slimy, stuck to the bronze pillar, so painful that the soul just wanted to disappear.
Without stopping, from nowhere, the iron crow swooped down and pecked straight at the head, each knock breaking the skull and gouging the brain, but still did not kill him. Screams echoed throughout hell.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-504-16edc2b45de0.webp)

Afterwards, Ms. Trinh was taken to prison for dismemberment. The body was placed on a red-hot iron bed, then cut in two: half returned to the betrayed husband, half returned to the broken lover's family. Blood flowed into the hot metal, boiling.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-505-8488826571fb.webp)

Next is the drill prison. The ghost tied his hands and feet, used a sharp stick to blind his eyes, and then used a drill to drill straight into his body. The sound of metal swirling into flesh, blood splashing, the pain was so painful that just hearing about it was enough to raise the hair on the back of your neck. Furthermore, for the crime of using sweet words to lure others into leaving their wives and children, Ms. Trinh also had her tongue cut out and was punished for her words that sowed the karma of separation.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-506-c0ea7910538e.webp)

After paying off her hellish karma, Ms. Trinh still has not finished her debt. She was exiled to two lives as a pigeon and six lives as a sparrow.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-507-87606fe908ef.webp)

Short lives, hunger, cold, being hunted, slaughtered, and painful are no different from hell on earth. Every death is a time of extreme panic and fear. After her last life as a sparrow, she was able to drink water to restore her soul and return to her human form.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-44-image-508-0a55dfbb53e0.webp)

But because she died before her long life had expired, she had to wander around as a hungry ghost for decades, until the Mountain Immortal gave her instructions, and a group of us came to enlighten her and took her to the temple to study. 
Ms. Trinh's story is a living verdict of the law of cause and effect. Adultery is not only a betrayal of love, but also sow the seeds of ruin for many families, leading to the tears of children and the pain of innocent people. Retribution may come slowly, but it never fails. Adultery is a serious sin. Using words to divide other people's families is also a great evil. Death is not an escape, but sometimes the beginning of a chain of suffering lasting more than a hundred lifetimes. 
In the past, karma might come late, but today, karma comes very quickly. If you believe then correct yourself, if you don't believe then watch and be afraid. I hope that each of us lives uprightly, maintains human morality, cherishes family, so that we do not have to meet each other in the hot copper pillars, drills, and iron crows of the dark underworld. Finally, I wish everyone to always practice diligently and keep their minds pure, so that this life and the next will be peaceful.

tieu_de: Story 45: Dishonest Scales and Fraudulent Trade
tom_tat: In the human world, there are evil deeds that do not shed blood, do not take lives, but silently accumulate karma throughout a lifetime. When people look at us, they only see plenty of food, warm clothes, family...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 45: DISHONEST SCALES AND FRAUDULENT TRADE**}

In the human world, there are evil deeds that do not shed blood, do not take lives, but silently accumulate karma throughout a lifetime. When people look at them, they only see plenty of food and warm clothes, a warm family, and many children and grandchildren, but behind that is every gram of deceit, every ounce of deceit, every penny tainted with karma.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-45-image-509-cb8fbafd3e84.webp)

Scales - a seemingly small act in business - is an invisible knife that gradually cuts off a person's blessings and virtue, so that when the blessings run out and retribution comes, there is no way back. Today, in the journey of the Mission to Save the Dead, we listen to the story of a female spirit who lived nearly a century ago in modern times, who spent 40 years cheating and selling short, then had to face terrible punishments at prison door number 15 of the underworld. Believe it or not is everyone's right, but cause and effect never leaves anyone behind. The deceased girl was born into a poor family, with three siblings. At the age of 29, she got married in a foreign country and gave birth to five children. Times were difficult, her family had many mouths to feed, and she was forced to scrape by every job to survive. Initially, it was a small business, selling bamboo shoots and agricultural products, then gradually expanded to include rice, wine, dry goods, and purchasing goods from people in the area for resale. It is here that evil seeds begin to arise. She ordered a craftsman to custom-make a bronze scale that had been tampered with.

Customers buy a kilo, but actually receive only seven or eight ounces. A little deception today, a little shortcoming tomorrow, accumulates into forty years of endless suffering. The buyer was poor and lost a few ounces of rice; She sold it, making a few more dollars. But she did not know that every time the balance tilted, the blessings and virtues in the book of the underworld also tilted. On the surface, her life remained peaceful. The family is peaceful, the children and grandchildren are happy, and the old age is comfortable. People look at it and admire it. But they don't know that because the blessing is great, the fruit hasn't bloomed yet, but it doesn't mean it doesn't exist. When your blessings run out, even if you live to be eighty years old, you will not be able to escape the day of being called by name. When she turned eighty years old, during a sales session like any other day, she held a familiar bronze scale to weigh for customers. Suddenly, a violent cough came over me. Blood flowed from her mouth like a stream, unable to stop it. Her hand still held the scale tightly, blood flowed from her mouth, her body trembled, then in a panic, she slammed the scale against her chest as an unconscious reflex.

Finally, she collapsed, her head hit the ground, and died on the spot.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-45-image-510-3c6be233eb42.webp)

The strange thing that shook the whole village was that the scale was stuck to her hand, the blood mixed with the metal, there was no way to remove it. Relatives tried to pull and remove it, but to no avail. In the end, she was buried with the scale - an object that had followed her throughout forty years of deceitful business. At that time, her soul was still floating in her body, and she could clearly hear people whispering: "If you weigh a bird, you will have to carry it with you when you die." Those words were like the last knife cut into my mind. And just as the cries of her children and grandchildren reached their peak, her soul burst out of her body. 
Before she could regain her composure, two demons ordered her to use an iron chain to drag her straight to the underworld. No explanation, no chance to escape. At the judgment hall, the crime was read clearly: torture for forty years, appropriating the property of countless people, including the poor and needy. She knelt down and cried, citing her large family and difficult life. But Lord Diem just coldly said: "Difficulties are not a reason to sow evil. To weigh an ounce of evil is to cut off a portion of happiness."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-45-image-511-592c18183a95.webp)

With the amount of money appropriated so large, she was banished to prison door number 15 - a place that specializes in punishing those who do dishonest business. As soon as she entered prison door number 15, she understood that any regrets were too late. Before her eyes was a giant iron scale, heavy and cold. The devil forced her to lie down, then the scale slowly pressed down from above, crushing her body like a hydraulic machine. Bones are broken, flesh is crushed, pain is so much that the soul feels like it is being torn apart. But before she could completely die, she was revived to endure further pressure, repeated countless times. 
Not stopping there, she was forced to suck on red-hot iron coins. Each coin represents the illegal profits that have been appropriated. The red-hot metal burns the mouth and throat, but you still have to swallow the right amount. This punishment lasted seemingly indefinitely, because the amount of money she appropriated was so large. 
Finally, the punishment that haunted her the most: cutting off every fiber of flesh and placing it on a scale. The devil used a sharp knife to cut pieces of flesh from her body, placing them on a scale to "measure them fairly". Each cut made her scream in despair.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-45-image-512-da1610d7c413.webp)

Next to her, she saw an acquaintance - a person who mixed bad rice and sold it at a high price - whose intestines were slowly pulled out by an iron dog. The sound of metal chewing and moaning mixed together, making hell even more terrifying. She did not dare to continue talking. 
According to the words shared with my group: “There are no words on earth that can describe the horror down there.” After a long period of punishment, she was temporarily allowed to go to earth to wait for reincarnation. During 20 days of wandering, she stayed in a hammock left behind by a naked person, swinging in the deserted night. It was there that she met the group I had come to follow the Mountain Immortal's instructions. Having received instructions, she agreed to go back to the temple to study, hoping to redeem some of her remaining karma. 
The story of the ghost girl is a chilling warning to those who are doing dishonest business. Don't think that a little underweight and a little extra is harmless. An ounce of time today can be exchanged for a lifetime of suffering tomorrow. Great blessings come slowly, but are never lost. Evil deeds no one sees, but the underworld records it. Don't wait until you go to hell to regret it, because then there will be no turning back. Death is not the end. Death is sometimes just entering the fairest trial of one's life.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-45-image-513-0851886b8e41.webp)

We hope that each of us, especially those who are doing business, should weigh enough - sell right away - live right, so that we don't have to meet each other in the darkness of prison. Finally, I wish everyone to stay awake, live a good life, practice diligently, so that this life and the next will be peaceful.

COMMENTS:
After reading CAN DIEU's story, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 46: Snake Wine, Ornamental Fish, and Suffering
tom_tat: In the invisible flow of cause and effect, no action is meaningless, nor is there a "small" sin if it is repeated with indifference. There are people who don't...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 46: SNAKE WINE, ORNAMENTAL FISH, AND SUFFERING**}

In the invisible flow of cause and effect, no action is meaningless, nor is there a "small" sin if it is repeated with indifference. There are people who do not hold a knife to kill, do not cause great evil in the human world, but kill every day, taking the lives of all living things as their livelihood, without knowing that each miserable cry, each dying look is fully recorded in the book of life and death. 
Soaking snakes in wine, selling ornamental birds and ornamental fish - in the eyes of people is just a normal livelihood. But when greed overwhelms compassion, when life is treated as lightly as a commodity, the karma of killing will silently form into chains, waiting for the day to drag the soul down to the coldest levels of hell. And now, together we listen to the confession of a dead man named Phong, on the journey of the Mission to save the dead, to better understand what is the retribution of killing karma, and why hell is so terrible that no soul dares to remember.

Following the Mountain Immortal's instructions, my group found the place where Phong Phong was residing. But as soon as he saw the group of people burning incense approaching, he immediately ran away. The more he chased, the farther he ran, so panicked that his soul was scattered. In Mr. Phong's mind at that time, my group was like a buffalo with a horse's face coming to force him back to the underworld. Only when it was explained that they had come to give instructions and take the dead back to the temple to practice, did Mr. Phong gradually calm down.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-46-image-514-b6595db5c231.webp)

He asked again cautiously, as if afraid this was just a trap. When he heard the confirmation, he exclaimed in surprise: "Ah... turns out you are the predestined people that Lord Diem said." Before being allowed to wander the earthly world for a while, Mr. Phong once heard Lord Diem's ​​advice: "There will be someone who is predestined enough to take care of you." And now, that word has come true. For more than thirty years of wandering around hungry and thirsty, not being able to eat or drink like mortals, when enjoying the offerings, he continuously trembled and said: "It's so delicious... it's been more than thirty years since I've had a real meal."

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-46-image-515-e48dfd286cb2.webp)

When he was alive, Phong spent a long time trapping birds, catching birds, and selling birds. Beautiful birds are sold as pets, ugly birds are sold to releasers, if no one buys them, they are sold to slaughterers. To him, bird lives are only classified according to... price. After getting married and having a daughter, Phong decided to go into business. Because of his passion for pet animals, he opened a shop selling ornamental birds and fish, and also took advantage of his free time to catch snakes and soak them in wine.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-46-image-516-f0ae787a30b0.webp)

The snakes were cut open, their hearts ripped out, and soaked in jars of cold wine in exchange for a few dollars. The birds were sick and dying and couldn't survive. He crushed them to death with his hands, then tore them up and threw them to the dogs to eat. If a mouse is trapped, beat it, dip it in boiling water, and drown it to death. Killing became a habit for him, no more emotions, no more feelings. More than ten years passed like this, the karma of killing accumulated heavily without him even realizing it. 
At the age of 33, while trapping snakes, Phong saw a large honey bee nest on a tall tree. Greed arose, he determined to climb up to get it. But when he swung the knife, he accidentally cut into a poisonous bee nest. Swarms of bees flew out and continuously stung him. Phong died on the spot, in pain and panic.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-46-image-517-a16fa684478d.webp)

When his soul left his body, he was still wandering around the place where he died. Before he could understand what was happening, two demons appeared, tied him tightly and dragged him straight to the underworld. In the underworld, Phong was convicted of serious murder, did not believe in cause and effect, did not believe in spirituality, and even argued, saying that in order to make a living, he was forced to do so. But all excuses are meaningless. 
The devil dragged him into the gates of prison, where every action in life was "repaid" without missing a single detail. First punishment: iron fork piercing the body. The devil used a fork to stab from the abdomen to the back, from the back to the abdomen, over and over again. The body was full of holes, blood flowed like a stream, the pain was so much that the soul wanted to break. 
Next, he was taken away on a sharp blade. Every step he took, the flesh fell in pieces, blood dripped into streaks. That is the path he forced all creatures to walk on when he was alive. The most terrible is the punishment for soaking in snake wine. He was tied up, his stomach cut open, his heart ripped out, every move was exactly like what he did with the snake. The cold feeling of metal, the pain of his internal organs being pulled out made him scream in despair.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-46-image-518-4a79c95f38b7.webp)

At this point, Vong Phong trembled and said: "I don't dare tell anymore... just thinking about it makes me scared..." There are no words on earth enough to describe that hell. After suffering enough punishment, Phong was allowed to go to earth for a while, just as Lord Diem had said. Meeting my group, being enlightened and taken to the temple to study, that was the last chance he had. Phong choked up and shared: "If I knew killing was such a heavy karma, I would rather be poor than..." 
The story of a dead man named Phong is a chilling wake-up call for those who consider killing to be normal and a way to make a living. Birds, fish, snakes, mice – no matter how small – are still life. To kill an animal is to sow a seed of pain. Kill a lot, sow a lot, then the day of return is just a matter of time. Not believing in cause and effect does not mean that cause and effect do not exist. Death is not the end. Death is sometimes just the beginning of a journey of debt repayment that is a thousand times longer and more painful. Believe and meditate. If you don't believe it, consider it a story.

But I hope that, from deep within, each person will know how to stop, know how to nurture compassion, so that one day they will not have to tremble and tell their own story in the darkness of prison. Finally, I wish everyone to stay awake - live a good life - diligently practice, so that this life and many future lives will no longer have to face the horrifying levels of hell like Phong Phong once experienced.

tieu_de: Story 47: Seven Lifetimes of Begging
tom_tat: Among the countless sins that people unintentionally create every day, there is one thing that seems so small, so ordinary, that many people take it for granted, and that is wasting food. M...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 47: SEVEN LIFETIMES OF BEGGING**}

Among the countless sins that people unintentionally create every day, there is one thing that seems so small, so ordinary, that many people take it for granted, and that is wasting food. A half-eaten bowl of rice, a leftover tray, a leftover party thrown straight into the trash - all are overlooked, because people think: "It's nothing, it's just food." But few people know that, in the law of cause and effect of the underworld, wasting food is disregarding blessings, trampling on the sweat, tears, and even the lives of many other people. And its retribution does not stop at one human life. 
Today, in the Redemption Mission Journey, we listen to the scary story of the ghost girl Linh, to understand why just because of wasting food, she had to suffer seven lives as a beggar, and why the hell for this crime is so terrible that even the soul does not dare to reminisce.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-47-image-519-d0e88d3663c1.webp)

When she was alive, Linh was born into an extremely wealthy family. She has an older sister named Lan. The two sisters are both young ladies, pampered by their parents, living in luxury, never knowing what hunger or lack is.
During a difficult time in society, when people had to save every grain of rice, in Linh and Lan's house, every meal had a full tray of food.
When they couldn't eat it all, instead of giving it to workers or the poor, the two sisters calmly dumped it straight into the trash. Not only food, but also clothes and shoes, they get tired of using them and then they are thrown away, there is no concept of regret. Waste happens day after day, as a habit, as a right of the rich.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-47-image-520-48fb68e39066.webp)

Linh sometimes felt guilty and suggested: "Should we let someone else do the business to save on waste?" But Lan just smiled faintly: "You worry too much. Just throw away the food, nothing is missing." From those simple words, the karma of waste begins to end.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-47-image-521-cf8e8c41eb32.webp)

Some time later, Lan suddenly contracted a strange disease. His legs gradually atrophied, unable to walk. The body was motionless, the spirit collapsed, Lan fell into severe depression. She no longer eats or drinks, no longer wants to live. Just one year later, Lan passed away in pain and despair. Linh is in inconsolable pain. Missing her sister so much, she was introduced to a spiritual teacher who had the ability to summon the souls of the deceased.
During the ceremony, after many rituals, Lan's soul actually appeared.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-47-image-522-edd1dfc69503.webp)

But what appeared was no longer the beautiful young lady of yesteryear, but a skinny, panic-stricken ghost, crying bitterly. Lan said through sobs that she was being punished in hell. The only crime: wasting food. In the underworld, there are gods who meticulously record every meal, every tray, and every throw away.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-47-image-523-cc6f87fd900b.webp)

How much is wasted, how much is recorded. And the punishment is to eat all the wasted food again, but it's no longer clean food. It was rancid, dirty, foul-smelling food, boiling in large jars. The fishy smell, the rotten smell, the rotten smell mixed together, burning the throat, burning the soul.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-47-image-524-3f7936b54139.webp)

Lan cried: "I beg you to save me... I have to eat those things every day... I don't know when it will end..." Before she could say more, the time allowed to appear was over, Lan was dragged back to hell, continuing her punishment. Witnessing everything, Linh was both scared and regretful.
She followed the teacher's advice, sold some of her assets, brought the money to make merit, do good deeds, and dedicate it to herself and her sister. Three years later, Linh passed away.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-47-image-525-3ca05b6f25c7.webp)

Going down to the underworld, Linh was also judged guilty. The crime of wasting food is still there, but it is lighter than Lan's because Linh is not the person who directly throws it away, but has merit to dedicate while she is alive. However, the penalty cannot be avoided. The devil led Linh to a place full of giant jars, the stench went straight into her soul. Inside, countless ghosts bowed their heads to eat dirty food, some vomited while eating, some trembled from the burning heat, but no one was allowed to stop. Those things boiled, not earthly food, but spoiled blessings turned into punishment.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-47-image-526-d3d156e50ee3.webp)

Looking into the distance, Linh saw a familiar face - Ms. Lan. Before they could run to hug each other, the ghost pushed Linh's head straight into the jar and forced her to eat all of her portion. The two sisters ate the same things they once mercilessly threw away. Lan had already suffered the punishment, so she was soon eligible for reincarnation. And Linh still has to continue. When Linh finished her punishment and was allowed to reincarnate, she asked the God of Hell to tell her where her sister was. The answer made Linh's soul crumble: "Your sister is now a beggar child, following a beggar woman. She must endure seven lives of being a beggar, hungry, cold, torn, wandering the streets. After seven lives, she can return to being a normal person." Because she loved her sister so much, Linh refused to be reincarnated and wandered the earth. In the seventh lunar month, according to fate, she met her sister again in the form of a child beggar. And at that time, Linh met a group of predestined people - my group - to be enlightened and taken to the temple to practice.

The story of the ghost girl Linh is a cold but fair judgment of cause and effect. Wasting food is not only a bad habit, but also a violation of blessings and a rejection of the grace of heaven and earth. A lifetime of wasted wealth is exchanged for many lifetimes of poverty. A discarded meal, in exchange for countless days of swallowing dirty things in hell. Cause and effect need not be fast, but always accurate. Believe it or not is up to each person. But please remember: don't underestimate a grain of rice. Behind it is the sweat of the rice farmer, and your own blessings. Hopefully after this story, each of us will know how to eat mindfully, live mindfully, so as not to have to pay the price of hungry lives in the dark. Finally, I wish everyone to always practice diligently and save blessings, so that this life and the next life will not have to meet in the stinking jars of the underworld.

tieu_de: Story 48: The Compassionate Tears of a Stranger
tom_tat: In the spiritual world, there are souls who cannot escape, not because they are too evil, but because of injustice and unfinished karma. Those are the souls lost between two realms...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 48: THE COMPASSIONATE TEARS OF A STRANGER**}

In the spiritual world, there are souls who cannot attain liberation, not because they are too evil, but because of injustice and unfinished karma. These are lost souls between the two realms of yin and yang, wandering in the dark, hungry, thirsty, afraid, carrying pain that has never been expressed. 
The story shared by my group below is such a case: a gentle man died at the age of 33, was betrayed, poisoned, had his tongue cut out, and then wandered for 20 years on earth. Behind that earthly tragedy is the shadow of hell - where the law of cause and effect operates coldly, where every sin has a corresponding punishment, where no tears are enough to wash away the karma that has been sown.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-527-7284f0860273.webp)

We found the dead man in an extremely miserable condition. He appeared as a tattered shadow, his clothes tattered, his face haggard, his eyes always lowered to avoid mortals. Twenty years of wandering made that soul become timid and afraid, just seeing a living person would run away like a hunted animal. The most horrifying thing was that his tongue had been cut off, he couldn't speak, he could only make painful gurgling sounds.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-528-a3619c0a0091.webp)

It is not only physical injury, but also humiliation, a usurpation of the right to complain and tell the truth. The French teacher in the group, after witnessing that situation, could not hold back his tears. Using magic, he opened his mouth and reconnected his tongue. When the first voice spoke after two decades of silence, the whole space seemed heavy, because it was not a word of resentment, but the sob of a gentle soul tormented for too long.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-529-9b75263bf519.webp)

When he was alive, he was just a simple farmer, working in the fields all year round. Getting married, having children, his dream is simply a peaceful home. The wife was initially gentle, but later on she fell more and more into material desires, beauty, and entertainment.
He worked hard to make money, his skin was tanned, his hands and feet were calloused, and his wife became more and more beautiful and gorgeous. The gap between two people is not just appearance, but mentality. When money was not enough to nourish her greed, the wife began to despise her husband, then had an affair with a rich man near her home.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-530-cb1e257e05a2.webp)

He discovered the truth, but because he loved his children and his wife, he chose to be patient. He took his child to look for him, knelt down, and begged his wife to return.
But that very gentleness becomes an excuse for evil to prevail. In the eyes of the woman who has lost her humanity, he is no longer a husband, but an obstacle.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-531-045b5a97fb48.webp)

To legitimize the wrong relationship, the wife and her lover devised a cruel plan: to poison her own husband and children. At dinner that day, the husband was happy because he thought his wife had returned to her senses.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-532-c0243f224f05.webp)

The father and son ate in fragile happiness, not knowing that each bite of rice was laced with poison. Death comes silently and coldly. Not stopping there, after he died, his lover also cut out his tongue, as if wanting to forever bury the truth.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-533-e23da56a53cd.webp)

That action is not only a crime on earth, but also a serious crime in the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-534-d80fe08662bd.webp)

When the soul left the body, he did not see the devil sent to lead him away. Perhaps because his life had not yet ended, he was not tried immediately but was stuck between the two worlds. Not being able to see his child, not knowing where he is, he wanders everywhere, hungry, thirsty, cold, living as a ghost without a home.
But during the revelations, the dead man said that there was a time when he was dragged down to the underworld, seeing a red dim hell like a furnace, where demons lured those who committed adultery, murdered relatives, deceived, and betrayed.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-535-9132159733b0.webp)

There is a red-hot copper column where adulterers are stripped naked and hugged tightly, their skin sizzling. They slide down and are forced to climb up.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-536-e8da9a0f0ff0.webp)

There is a heated iron bed where the body is split in half, blood mixed with boiling metal.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-537-0da3ce9f9ed1.webp)

There are iron birds, iron dogs tearing flesh, and screams that never stop.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-538-62f1f592eb19.webp)

He was not the one to suffer that punishment, but just witnessing it was enough to make his soul tremble. Hell does not need torture for no reason, each punishment is appropriate to the karma sown. What made everyone choked up was when asked if he resented his wife, the man just shook his head. He did not curse, did not demand revenge. He only blames himself for not fulfilling his responsibilities as a husband and father. His only wish is to know where his child is.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-48-image-539-b49527ba4983.webp)

My group cried a lot. The two sets of clothes we burned and sent to the underworld were not just items, but a recognition that that soul was still remembered and loved. After that, he was taken to the temple to practice, preparing for his next journey to the underworld, to receive a fair trial and enter the cycle of reincarnation. 
The story of the lost man who wandered for 20 years is a quiet but fierce indictment of the law of cause and effect. It shows that evil not only kills the body, but also leaves painful aftershocks that last through many realms. Adultery not only destroys the family, but also causes heavy karma for many generations. Murdering a loved one is a serious crime, the retribution cannot be avoided. Death is not the end, but can be the door that opens a chain of suffering more than a hundred years long.
Good people may suffer losses in this world, but karma never falls asleep. The wicked may laugh today, but hell always takes note. I hope that through this story, each person will learn to cherish family, maintain morality, speak the truth, and live with conscience. If you believe then correct yourself, if you don't believe then watch and be afraid.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of STRANGER'S TEARS, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.

tieu_de: Story 49: Malicious Speech and Miserly Greed
tom_tat: In the midst of the hustle and bustle of human life, there are people who were born at the peak of wealth, never knowing what hunger or cold is, and never understanding what it means to exchange a piece of food with tears. N...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 49: MALICIOUS SPEECH AND MISERLY GREED**}

In the midst of the hustle and bustle of human life, there are people who were born at the peak of wealth, never knowing what hunger or cold is, and never understanding what it means to exchange a piece of food with tears. But also from that place of abundance, people's hearts easily give rise to arrogance, evil speech, and contempt for others without knowing that every word and every action is silently marked in the karma book of the underworld.
"Journey to the Mission of Salvation" was narrated by Duc - the person we trusted. Not just scary stories to listen to for fear, but vivid examples of cause and effect. In it, the story of the miserly and evil-mouthed woman is a painful proof: when the mouth sow karma and the mind gives birth to evil, hell will find itself without needing to be named.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-540-6f5ef867c7c9.webp)

The deceased girl was born into an extremely wealthy family when she was still alive, with abundant wealth and no shortage of servants. Since childhood, she was pampered like a young lady with jade leaves and golden branches, never having to bow to anyone. It was that overprotection that raised in her an arrogant ego, looking down on the poor, considering the suffering of others as something not worth worrying about. To the hired workers and beggars, she not only refused to help but also let out harsh words and scolded them badly.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-541-f9a548f990a8.webp)

In her eyes, the poor are "troublesome" and "trash" that dirty the doors of rich people. Her words were as sharp as a knife, cutting into people's hearts without feeling guilty. The peak of evil karma is during times of natural disasters and epidemics. When hunger spread, a beggar who was so exhausted stood at her gate begging longer than usual. Not only did she not feed him, she also threw boiling water straight out, causing the beggar to suffer burns and writhe in pain.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-542-1b9426c35d86.webp)

In desperation, that person let out a curse - not to harm, but to cry out in frustration of a person cornered. After getting married, the deceased woman still did not change. The treasures in the house were filled with warehouses, but her heart was locked tightly. I don't want to share even a grain of rice, I feel sorry for the poor for even a piece of food. When two monks came to beg for alms to repair the temple, instead of rejoicing and sowing love, she instead had a mind of slander. She thought the monk was lazy and avoided work, then grabbed a broom and chased him straight out of the house. Her words were heavy, full of contempt, like using an ordinary person's mouth to trample on the Three Jewels. From here, evil karma has enough conditions to ripen.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-543-6d6343ca7d1f.webp)

While eating banh it, on the third cake, she suddenly had a lump in her throat. Breathing stopped, face turned purple, limbs twitched. Even though family members were present, everyone was helpless. She died in panic, not having time to understand what was happening. The soul left the body, still in shock, when a cold wind blew. The space before my eyes was dark, heaven and earth turned upside down. When she regained consciousness, she was standing in front of the gate of hell - where there is no gold or silver, no family background, only karma and results.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-544-2f574a4e295e.webp)

In front of Diem Dai Palace, the female spirit was read of three major crimes: wasting food - bad speech - slandering practitioners. At first, she argued that she didn't kill anyone or steal.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-545-3f233d00b9b1.webp)

But when led to the karma mirror, each scene appeared as clearly as if it were yesterday: food was thrown away, poor people were scolded, monks were chased away. With no way to deny, she was taken to the prisons.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-546-d03bf2307124.webp)

Prison for people who waste food: All the food she threw away when she was alive was weighed into a mass of karma. In hell, the devil forced her to eat hot sand equivalent to that weight. The sand was as red as coal. As soon as it was put into the mouth, it burned the tongue, tore the throat, and blood flowed out and mixed with the hot sand. If he couldn't swallow, he was beaten. If he spit it out, he was forced to eat it again. Each grain of sand is a reminder of the hungry person she chased away.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-547-68ecc9e27679.webp)

Prison for people with bad mouths: After the first punishment, she was dragged to prison to have her tongue removed. The devil used an iron hook to pierce his tongue and tie it to an iron horse. The horse ran around the stone pillar, pulling her tongue gradually, one by one, one by one. The pain tore through the soul, but before he could die, he was reincarnated to continue suffering. That was retribution for the harsh words that came out of that same mouth.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-548-ccc417af44a3.webp)

Prison for those who defame practitioners: This is the final and most terrible punishment. She was transformed into a demon with a big head and small neck, and was then scalped while still conscious. Once the skin is peeled off, it is reshaped and then peeled again. That cycle repeats countless times, until the karma is exhausted.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-549-89cdbb3c3f22.webp)

When she finished her punishment, she was not immediately reincarnated but was sent to earth to be a hungry ghost.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-550-192d9955cbec.webp)

Wandering around, cold, looking at food but not being able to swallow, looking at living people but no one knows. Fortunately, in a certain life, she had a small affinity with Buddhism. Thanks to that, with the Mountain Immortal's instructions, our group came to enlighten her, took her to the temple to study, and relied on the light of the Three Jewels to repent and change her career.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-49-image-551-f24c5d0080d4.webp)

The story of the stingy and foul-mouthed ghost girl is not just a scary slice of hell, but a warning to the living. 👉 Being rich or poor is fate, but evil speech is karma.  Wasting food is disregarding the sweat and tears of others. Defaming practitioners is cutting off one's own blessings. Cause and effect does not need anyone to believe in to exist. It still operates silently, accurately and fairly. 
If you believe then correct yourself, if you don't believe then listen to be afraid, to know and be careful of every word and every smallest action. May we all know how to keep our mouths - keep our minds - keep our virtues, live knowing how to give, so that when we close our eyes and give up, we don't have to meet again in the hot sand, hooking our tongues, peeling our scalps in the dark underworld.
