tieu_de: Story 50: Trafficking Purity and Exploiting Innocence
tom_tat: In the human world, there are sins that not only hurt an individual, but also destroy an entire generation, trampling on the bodies, dignity and fate of innocent people. N...
noi_dung:
{align:center|**STORY 50: TRAFFICKING PURITY AND EXPLOITING INNOCENCE**}

In the human world, there are sins that not only hurt an individual, but also destroy an entire generation, trampling on the bodies, dignity and fate of innocent people. Those crimes while alive can be covered up with money, power and appearances, but when their last breath is taken, they all have to walk through the door to hell, where there are no lawyers, no sentences, only cold cause and effect and appropriate punishment. 
The story of the female spirit Ha - a prostitute who trafficked in virginity in "Journey to the Redemption Mission", is one of the most horrifying judgments of the law of cause and effect. This is not just a story to listen to for fear, but a wake-up call for those who are living by crime on the bodies of others.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-552-afa9f7bd3968.webp)

Ha was born into a poor family, whose childhood was associated with deprivation and guilt.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-553-cf6a5fa9fab6.webp)

That situation instilled in her a strong desire: to escape poverty at all costs.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-554-2b5a320c8234.webp)

When she was very young, Ha got married early, choosing a wealthy man in the hope of changing her life. But the happiness was short-lived. After giving birth to a child, the husband fell seriously ill and passed away, leaving mother and child and little property. No job, no education, money running out one by one.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-555-0b1f73571033.webp)

Faced with the pressure of having to earn a living, instead of choosing an honest path even though it was difficult, Ha took a dark turn: becoming a mother. Taking advantage of her ex-husband's relationships with people with a lot of money and power, Ha began brokering the sale of virginity.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-556-11e8bb18ba51.webp)

Her target audience is young girls from poor families who desire to change their lives and are easily blinded by money.
Some people volunteer because of ambition, but many people are deceived, forced, and pushed into hell on earth. 
Ha not only sold other people's bodies, but also sold their future, honor, even their sanity. There are girls who go crazy after being tricked, some seek death. But all of these things, Ha considers as "the price that society must pay".

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-557-7be6c14b5425.webp)

The peak of depravity is when a tycoon offers two billion dong to buy virginity according to his "desire". Unable to find a suitable person, Ha thought of her own 16-year-old biological daughter. Forced, threatened, manipulated with words of life and death, in the end the girl, out of love for her mother, accepted to sacrifice herself. Two billion dong was exchanged for a ruined daughter's life, and was also the knife that ended the mother's last blessing.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-558-04fba544a203.webp)

On the outside, Ha is still a rich, successful woman who often goes to temples and speaks benevolent words. But inside, the mind has turned into a demon.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-559-83c3f70703cb.webp)

During a visit to the hospital to hunt for "prey", Ha was discovered and chased by the victim's family in a panic. Running out of the hospital gate, Ha was hit by a car and died on the spot.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-560-b0b7e6df891a.webp)

Death comes suddenly, without time to repent, without time to prepare. As soon as the soul left the body, before it could calm down, two ghosts holding iron chains appeared, tied the hands and feet and dragged them straight to the underworld.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-561-16865159afd1.webp)

Before the mirror of karma, all crimes appear clearly: every crying face, every trembling body, every desperate plea. No excuse is valid anymore. Stripped naked in the bottomless abyss of darkness, Ha's hands and feet were chained with ice-cold chains. With each dragging step, her skin rubbed against the stone floor, soaked in dry blood and thick resentment, creating a suffocating stench.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-562-89363f290b0e.webp)

The prison of dismemberment opened like an iron shark's jaws: the devil did not stop cutting but grinded the saw slowly, line by line, so that the pain lasted indefinitely; The sound of tearing flesh mixed with the sound of bones grinding metal, screams rose up and were swallowed by the prison walls.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-563-5714d60accdf.webp)

Pulled into the cross-shaped prison, a cold sharp iron rod was skewered straight from the bottom up, every inch the iron moved forward was a shock that tore through the mind; The torture wheel rotated, blood sprayed in orbit, the pain was multiplied beyond measure.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-564-f2947f53a5b5.webp)

When he went to prison, his leg tendons were hooked out and tied to an iron horse with glowing red eyes; The horse ran around the stone pillar, the tendons were gradually tightened, stretched to the limit and then torn, but as soon as it was torn, it was healed again to continue being pulled. 
The prison of pulling teeth - sewing mouths descends with the sound of metal hitting bone: each tooth pops out of the gums, the mouth is sewn with rusty iron thread, each needle is a tear, silencing every evil word ever sown. Finally, there is the iron dog prison, where a herd of steel beasts with sharp fangs rush in and tear endlessly, aiming straight at the places that once caused karma; Each bite is a time when the body is broken and then transformed, to suffer again from the beginning. In the midst of that sea of ​​torture, Ha also saw those who had been accomplices—distorted figures screaming in proportion to their punishment—all merging into a chorus of despair, where cause and effect operated coldly, leaving no one behind. 
After the hell punishment ended, Ha was not reincarnated as a human but was banished to be a hungry and thirsty ghost, wandering on earth, eating wind and drinking dew, cold to the soul. After that, there were ten lives as animals, suffering from hunger and cold, and being slaughtered, no different from what I had done to others.

![](https://media.quangtu.vn/content/smdv-1ab0570c44ac47b5bb43f328aed7464b/chapter-50-image-565-15f768c325dd.webp)

Fortunately, thanks to the Mountain Immortal's guidance, my group came to enlighten me, brought the deceased back to the temple to practice, and sowed the last bit of good fate with the the Buddha Dharma before continuing the cycle of reincarnation. 
The story of the female spirit Ha is a vivid verdict of the law of cause and effect: Trading in the bodies of others is a great evil. Deception, coercion, and ruining people's lives will cost you hundreds of thousands of times more. Money earned from sin never brings peace. Hell is not scary because of the punishment, but scary because everything is true to what we have done. Believe it or not is each person's choice, but cause and effect does not miss anyone. Pray for those who are still deep in the path of sin to stop before it is too late.

SOME THOUGHTS FROM 50 AMAZING MISSION STORIES
(Quang Tu)
Reading through the 50 stories in "Mission to Save the Dead", from the perspective of a practicing lay person, what remains is not fear, but a very deep silence in the heart. Because the more I read, the more clearly I see a truth that people often avoid: no death is accidental, and no suffering is gratuitous. Everything is the result of Cause and Effect that have been sown before, just waiting for enough conditions to bloom. The spirits in the story do not naturally suffer from hunger, thirst, or being imprisoned in the layers of hell. They were people who lived like us, had families, had thoughts, and had choices. But the difference is that when they were alive, they indulged and overlooked good and evil karma, and then when they died, all that was left was the force of karma that pulled them into the corresponding realm. Looking back at each story, we can clearly see the operating rules of cause and effect.

Some people, because of theft or greed, harm others. When they die, they suffer terrible punishments and are so hungry and thirsty that they do not dare to eat when they are fed. Some people, in order to kill and destroy living beings for a living, end up being tortured by those same lives, tearing their bodies apart, peeling off their skin, paying back every bit of pain that was caused. Some people are filial, curse their parents, and when they go to hell, they are tortured at the deepest levels, the pain is beyond words. Those things are not unreasonable punishments, but a reflection of their own actions and thoughts when they were alive. The cause may be small, but the return can last for many years, even many lifetimes. Therefore, while alive, the most important thing for a person is not to do sublime things such as being rich, famous, etc., but to maintain the basic moral foundation of the person: 
1.

Keep the Five Precepts: Do not kill to avoid sowing resentment against living beings; Do not steal so as not to create unjust karma; do not commit adultery (do not commit adultery, do not destroy the happiness of others, do not masturbate) to keep your body and mind pure; Do not lie or speak evil words so as not to create verbal karma; and do not use stimulants to maintain mindfulness. It sounds simple, but looking back at the stories, most spirits commit these things. Because of not being able to keep the Five Precepts, we open the door for evil karma to enter, so that when the results come, we cannot avoid them. It sounds simple, but looking back at the 50 stories, most of the spirits committed these things:
The person who slaughters pigs → kills animals → is turned back like a pig
People who steal → lose their lives and fall into hell
People who commit adultery → die miserably and carry heavy karma
People with bad mouths → had their tongues hooked and tortured
People who drink heavily every day → cause harm to themselves and others
The Buddha taught in the Avalokiteshvara Sutra: "Each precept that a Buddhist follows will be guarded and protected by five good gods.

Therefore, a person who fully keeps the Five Precepts (5 precepts) will have 25 good gods always following and supporting him, eliminating evil and disasters." Therefore, keeping the Five Precepts means building an "invisible shield" to protect oneself. But just "not doing evil" is not enough. Practitioners need to go one step further, which is to practice. 
2. Tu Thập Thiện. That means not only avoiding bad things, but also proactively doing good things with body, speech, and mind. When the body does not kill, there is compassion and love for living beings; When your mouth does not speak evil, you know how to speak good words; When the mind is free from anger and ignorance and knows how to be mindful - then blessings and virtue will naturally increase. When you have enough blessings, good spirits will protect you, and bad invisible forces can hardly harm you. People who live in the light of kindness are not easily swayed, not easily disturbed by demons, and also not susceptible to unexpected accidents. On the contrary, a person whose mind is full of greed, anger, and ignorance is like spontaneously emitting a corresponding frequency, attracting similar realms, making life always uneasy.

One thing worth thinking about is that many deaths in stories seem absurd: being beaten to death, having sudden accidents, or dying in very cruel circumstances. But from the perspective of cause and effect, it is not "bad luck", but ripe karma. Some people have caused suffering to others, so in this life they have to suffer in return; Some people have created resentment, so their lives are demanded; Some people once underestimated life, so their own life was taken away in the blink of an eye. Cause and effect is not biased, nor is it overlooked. It's just that when the results have not yet come, people often mistakenly think that they are "fine". So how can we protect ourselves and not fall into painful realms like the spirits in the story? First of all, keep an upright mind and a good life. Besides, lay people can practice reciting mantras every day such as the Great Compassion Mantra, the Shurangama Mantra or the Six Syllables Dai Minh. This is not a superstition, but a method to help purify the mind, enhance inner energy, thereby creating a natural "protective field".

In addition, when reciting Buddha's mantras and strictly observing the five precepts, the dharma protectors immediately protect the body and mind so that the practitioner does not suffer unexpected accidents. In addition, worshiping and relying on Bodhisattvas such as Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, Medicine Buddha... is also a very good practice method. Not to pray blindly, but to learn from their compassionate vows to save suffering. When we worship and make offerings to them, our mind will gradually resemble the Bodhisattva's mind, and life will naturally change for the better. In addition, for example, in the 11th chapter (Dharma Protector of Earth Deity) in the Sutra of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, Kien Lao Earth Than (Earth God) told the Buddha that, wherever soil, stone, bamboo, wood is used to build huts or huts, or gold, silver, bronze, and iron are used to mold the image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, then burn incense, make offerings, and worship, that place will receive 10 benefits:
1. Fertile land: The sandy soil in that place becomes lush and fertile. 2.

Safe and secure home: The family is always peaceful and stable forever. 3. The dead are reborn in heaven: Ancestors and deceased family members are reborn in heaven. 4. Living people enjoy blessings: Those still living in the house enjoy many benefits and blessings. 5. Whatever you pray for, you will get: All legitimate prayers will be fulfilled. 6. No water and fire disasters: No flood or fire accidents. 7. Eliminate damage: No loss of assets, no business losses or wastage. 8. Completely stop nightmares: The family is no longer disturbed by nightmares, and sleeps well. 9. When going in and out, there is a guardian angel: When leaving the house or returning, there is a guardian angel accompanying you. 10. Frequently meet Saints: Frequently meet knowledgeable people and Saints who teach. In particular, one thing that cannot be overlooked is repentance to the unjust bondholders. A lot of suffering in life is not caused by external factors, but by unjust karma from the past that has not been resolved.

When you know how to return to repent, dedicate your merits, and apologize from your heart, resentments will gradually be removed, and life will become easier (below, we will talk more clearly about repentance for wrongful bondholders). Besides, doing good deeds such as giving alms, helping people, making offerings to the Three Jewels, not wasting food... is also a way to accumulate blessings very quickly. Blessings are the strongest "shield" that protects people from invisible disasters. For those who are fortunate, even if they encounter misfortune, it will turn out to be light, but for those who are unlucky, even small things can become big disasters. Finally, I would like to send a sincere message: the spirits in those stories are not strangers. They lived, thought, and made mistakes just like us today. The only difference is that they have run out of opportunities to correct their mistakes. And we - still breathing, still have tomorrow - still have a chance. Don't wait until you lose your human body to understand the religion, because at that time, no matter how much you regret it, you won't be able to go back.

While you are alive, keep the Five Precepts, practice the Ten Virtues, know how to repent and cultivate compassion. To do so, there is no need to pray for anything far-fetched, naturally there is a good spirit to protect you, your life will be peaceful, and the path ahead will gradually brighten with each good step you take.

REPENTANCE FOR LEFTOWNER'S FAITH AND THINGS YOU NEED TO KNOW
1. WHY SHOULD YOU REPENT? After passing away, many souls wandered around the world, refusing to escape, because they could not let go of their attachments and resentments towards the world. Among them, the most terrifying are the ghosts of the Oan family. They are the souls of humans or animals... in this life and countless past lives, they have formed many deep enmities with us. Sometimes we are animals that we force to kill and eat, sometimes we are humans that we beat, torture, rob, cheat, kill... Sometimes it's the fetuses aborted by their parents...creating countless hatreds and resentments. When the unjust bondholders' souls find the person who harmed them, even though that person has reincarnated, the unjust souls can still recognize them. What must happen of course is that they will follow and seek revenge. So in what ways do they take revenge? The spirits have a certain amount of divine power, more or less.

And they are also very smart, so they can think of many different ways to take revenge. Like causing us to get sick, in severe cases it's cancer, in mild cases it's in pain, all kinds of diseases. Or make the family stir, argue, and torture each other. Or "ghosts guide us, demons guide us" causing us to fail in business, they can even push us, cover our eyes while we are driving on the road, causing us to get injured in an accident, or die, etc. This is the reason why we need to repent of injustice.
This is the reason why it is necessary to repent of injustice
Not all disasters and suffering in life are caused by the Oan family, because many times, disasters are simply caused by Karma, without the presence of any ghosts. The revenge of the spirits of the Oan family causes diseases and disasters, which also account for a very large proportion. In fact, it is also a type of retribution, not outside of Cause and Effect.

So if you find that life is surrounded by many difficulties, suffering, illness, and bad luck, you should try to repent of the wrongful bondholders. If after a few times things change for the better, then you are on the right track. If not, you won't lose much, no one will collect money or tax you for this. To be honest, whoever is present in this world almost always has the spirits of the Oan family carrying revenge. Because most people have never killed this animal or that animal. If they don't directly kill them, they also eat the flesh and drink the blood of many lives. When those animals die, most of them follow the person who killed them and eat their flesh, waiting for the opportunity to take revenge and become unjust bondholders. Then there are many people who have gone through wars and killings, people who have had abortions, people who have gone through grudges and blood debts in life and become unjust partners with ghosts. Therefore, everyone needs to repent of injustice.

And if anyone insists that he was completely innocent until now since he was a child, there will still be many unjust people from many past lives coming to find him. Like the case of Ngo Dat Quoc Su - the author of the famous book Compassion and Repentance during the reign of King Y Tong. In his past life during the Han Dynasty, his name was Vien An. He once slandered a person named Trieu Tho, who died unjustly. He was executed and slashed across the waist. Trieu Tho's ghost followed Ngo Dat Quoc Su for 10 consecutive lifetimes without being able to take revenge, because during those 10 lifetimes, Ngo Dat Quoc Su diligently practiced and was closely protected by the Dharma Protectors and could not get close. At the end of his 10th life, when he reached the position of National Teacher, the ultimate glory, because he became arrogant, the Dharma Protectors left, and the unjust spirit of Trieu Tho took advantage of the opportunity and entered him, causing him to suffer from a cruel disease: ulcers in the shape of a human face on his knees. Speaking today, it is a malignant cancer, extremely painful and cannot be cured by any royal physician.

So, if even a highly virtuous person like Ngo Dat Quoc Su, after 10 lifetimes of standard practice, can still be avenged like that by an unjust family, then we mortals should not think that we do not have any wrongful people. It's just that it's not time for them to take revenge. So how to resolve the resentment of those unjust bondholders? Only by repenting of the unjust family, and making up for our mistakes by dedicating merit to them, until they let go, can we escape. And that is the purpose of the "Repentance Ritual for the Bondholders". Many people have recovered quickly from their illnesses, after repenting to their unjust bondholders, because simply, those people's illness was caused by unjust spirits. Now that they let go, the illness will disappear. There are even people who are very unlucky, but just by repenting to the unjust bondholder, the bad luck will disappear. This is like when we are riding a bicycle on the road, when the wheel gets caught in a plastic bag or tinder, it gets stuck and we can't run.

At this time, no matter how hard we try to pedal, the car just stays in one place. But as long as we go down and remove the tinder from the wheel, the car can run normally again. However, not all cases see good results come quickly. Because the number of unjust bondholders is different for each person. For example, if a person is gentle and kills less, the unjust family will be small, and repentance will quickly see results. For others, because they have killed many lives in many past lives, the Oan family is larger, and repenting of the Oan family once or twice is not enough. Then the psychology of unjust ghosts is also different. Some souls are easy to forgive, hearing repentance once is letting go, others are vindictive, repenting a few times still doesn't end their hatred, need to repent many more times. Therefore, perseverance is very important when praying for retribution.

Praying for one or two sessions has not seen much change. Let's persevere in praying for another 10 - 20 sessions (it doesn't need to be consecutive every day, repenting once every few days is fine), usually most people will see the effects and clear changes in this period. In a few cases, due to too many injustices (manifested by many illnesses, many misfortunes, many different types of suffering in life), it is necessary to repent hundreds of times to see changes in a good direction. And it is best if possible, each person should continue to repent with the unjust bondholders a few times a month for many years. 2. THINGS TO NOTE BEFORE PROCEEDING 
 LOCATION
"Repentance Ritual - Pray for Repentance of the Leftover Family", can be carried out right in the home of the person who needs to repent, and that is the best place, because the wrongful family members are already there, easily accepting repentance and salvation. If it's not convenient, we can find another place depending on the situation, like an acquaintance's house, or a quiet place where no one will bother us.

In pagodas, temples, shrines, and even Martyrs' cemeteries, there are often Dharma Protector deities. Sometimes the dead are allowed in, sometimes they cannot enter. If you choose to hold the event at a temple, it is best to get approval from the abbot and ask the Dharma Protector to allow the dead to enter. As for the organization at home, if there is a Buddha altar in the house, we conduct it in front of the Buddha altar (arrange the ceremony of worshiping the family and the fetus on a separate table, placed next to the left or right side of the Buddha altar).
If not, then we can arrange a clean place (including the bedroom) where no one or any problem will affect the worshiping ceremony. TIME
The best time to perform the ceremony is in the evening, when there is no more sun, so the spirits can easily come to attend the ceremony. Even during the day, some spirits can still walk, but not all spirits can do so. In July, the spirits from the underworld are free to travel to the earthly world, so they pray for requiem... in July, the most spirits come to attend the ceremony.

On other normal days of the year, you can still perform the Requiem Rituals, there is no need to be strict about choosing a day. Do good deeds, every day is a good day. Everyone can organize their own repentance ritual, regardless of whether they are lay people or monks, Buddhists or non-Buddhists. If we can invite more people to help chant, that would be great. Because injustice has a head, debt has an owner, the sincere repentance of the wrongdoer is what the spirits want to hear the most - it is the key thing that makes the unjust spirits and the unborn children agree to forgive and let go of their hatred to receive requiem.

THINGS NEED TO PREPARE
When we prepare the offering tray, regardless of the ritual, we must use vegetarian food, absolutely do not offer meat, fish, salty foods, alcohol... It is not necessary to have a full tray, nor do we need votive paper, because the sound of chanting Buddha's name is countless times more precious than all the offerings in the world. This is what psychic Nguyen Van Nha and a series of famous Vietnamese psychics simultaneously witnessed at Truong Son cemetery. At that time, psychic Nguyen Van Nha stood in the middle of the cemetery, clasped his hands in reverence and recited "Namo Amitabha Buddha" 108 times. Immediately, the heroic martyrs, regardless of whether they lived religiously or not, all joined their hands together to recite Buddha's name earnestly. And the martyrs' souls responded to Mr. Nguyen Van Nha and the psychics present that the sound of chanting Buddhist scriptures is the most valuable thing that living people can send to them.

So arrange offerings as much or as little as the homeowner wants, without being too strict. If there are not many conditions, then a little fruit, a little cake, a little porridge, a glass of water, a stick of incense... is fine. Anyway, while performing the Ritual, we will recite the wonderful mantras of the Buddhas such as the Transformation Mantra, the Nectar Mantra, and the As Y Bao Luan Vuong Mantra, which have the ability to transform many things invisibly, making everyone satisfied. While conducting the Ritual, if there is a bell or bell, it is good, but if there is not, it is also okay. If you can kneel throughout the session, that's great, but if not, changing your position to standing or sitting is fine. In the Rituals, the words in (...) are the instructions, we do not read them, we only pay attention to following those instructions correctly. However, in some situations where this cannot be followed, it can be flexibly ignored without the need for a machine. Forms are just supporting factors, but the core, deciding the success of the requiem ceremony is still sincerity.

That's why many people spend a lot of money to pick up shamans, monks, etc. to do extremely expensive requiem ceremonies. After burning votive papers to the sky, they don't see much of an impact, and life doesn't change at all. That's because the spiritual realm only values ​​sincerity, not formality. A shaman who only comes for money, no matter how professional his appearance, will be filled with greed, selfishness, self-interest... where can he find the sincerity that Buddhas and Bodhisattvas will bless? Where can I get the power to overcome the dead? It's better than the homeowner himself presenting a simple vegetarian offering and praying sincerely for salvation. The effect is thousands of times stronger. In "Repentance Ritual - Pray for Redress of the Bondholders", the sincerity is true repentance and regret for the wrongs and sins one has committed to the unjust bondholders and to the aborted fetuses.

Reading each sentence of repentance makes me feel tormented, ashamed, wanting to apologize from the bottom of my heart, to the point that some people burst into tears, wanting to make up for them, help them escape, and attain Rebirth, that is sincerity. WHY IS IT NEEDED IN THIS LIFE TO PRAY TO BE BIRTH IN THE WEST OF UTILITIES? WHY DON'T YOU STAY IN THIS EARTH AND REINCREATE? OR PRAY FOR BIRTH IN HEAVEN?

The Western Pure Land of Amitabha Buddha is described in sutras such as the Amitabha Sutra, the Infinite Life Sutra and the Infinite Life Sutra as a pure, dignified and peaceful realm beyond all the suffering of the Saha world. There is no birth, old age, illness, or death, no hatred, no competition, no winning or losing; All living beings live in the light of wisdom and compassion. The earth is made up of seven treasures, the lakes and ponds are clear, the water has eight merits, the birds sing Dharma sounds, and the wind blows as reminders to practice. People born in the Pure Land have a dignified body, a mind free of afflictions, day by day they are close to Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, listen to the Dharma, and practice without turning back until they achieve enlightenment. Amitabha Buddha, countless eons ago, made a great vow to guide all sentient beings. When he was about to die, he only needed to have true faith, earnestly pray and recite His name for 10 times, then he would be guided back to that world.

This is an open path, suitable for everyone, whether of high or low ability, they just need to know how to turn towards goodness. From beginningless kalpas to the present, we have been drifting in and out of birth and death for countless kalpas. There are many kalpas where we have developed a strong Bodhi mind and are determined to practice diligently to escape samsara. But after a period of time from the first kalpa to the following kalpas, we are infected with the world, lose our Bodhi mind, and create many evil karma from the realms of Heaven, God, Human, Hungry Ghosts, Animals, and Hell. We have all experienced it, but we just don't remember it. The force of karma leads to continuous birth and death, so after countless lifetimes as many as the grains of sand in the Ganges River, we still have not escaped birth and death.

The truth is that if we have the thought of staying in this world and cultivating to attain Arahantship (Saint status to escape the cycle of birth and death), or the first Sotapanna status (the first of the Four Noble Paths that guarantee one's attainment of Arhatship in the future), it is very difficult, it can be said that if we stay in the world and practice for 1,000,000 lifetimes, we may not be able to attain it. Why is that? Because ours is an evil realm, maybe in this life we practice vegetarianism and do many good deeds, in the next life we can be born into a rich family, then forget the original Bodhi mind and happily enjoy the five desires. Because of good fortune, it is easy to create bad karma, so when we die, we fall into hell again, then maybe in the next life we practice good deeds, until just one thought of pride, lust, anger arises... when we are about to die, we can fall into hell..... then it's like that when we create good karma. then you will enjoy blessings, if you create bad karma you will be damned...it is very difficult to attain enlightenment.

Even if one is born in a heaven like the Dao Loi heaven and enjoys blissful blessings (which in some religions call it heaven) and has a lifespan of millions of years compared to earthly years, when the blessings run out, one will still fall into hell as usual (hell, hungry ghosts or animals depending on karma). Today we know about the method of reciting the Buddha's name. As long as you have a deep belief in the world of Ultimate Bliss, about Amitabha Buddha, courageously practice, fast and maintain the precepts, vow to recite the Buddha's name and pray to be reborn in the Western Pure Land, you can be reborn in the Pure Land. If you are reborn in the position of Middle-class Middle-born when you come here, then after 7 days the lotus blooms, listen to Amitabha Buddha preach the Dharma and immediately attain Sotapanna-initiated fruition, after half a lifetime ~ about 8 million years, you will attain Arahantship and then continue practicing until you become a Buddha, or if you are in the middle-ranking High-born when you return here, as soon as the lotus blooms, you will immediately hear the sounds praising the Four Truths, immediately become Arhat (According to the Infinite Life Sutra), then continue practicing until you become Buddha.

We see that if we try to practice in this life, after rebirth, we can be assured of liberation, even if we are born in the lower level of birth, we will never have to suffer from reincarnation. This method can save us from the karma of rebirth (i.e. carry our karma to rebirth). It is very convenient for sentient beings in the Dharma Ending Age today. Just at the time of death, we only need to recite Amitabha Buddha's name 10 times, and pray to be reborn in that realm. Amitabha Buddha will immediately be born. come to pick you up, even though you are currently an ordinary person, full of bad thoughts, but at the moment of death, if you diligently recite the Buddha's name and let go of all conditions, you will definitely be reborn. This is due to His 18th great vow, we can rely on His power to be reborn. Think about it, which is easier than spending hundreds of millions of lives in samsara? Therefore, in this life, when we learn about the Buddhist recitation method, we absolutely cannot ignore it!

CONCLUSION
Thus, closing the journey "MISSION OF DEGREE" are fifty stories, also fifty different destinies, fifty pieces of life drifting in the flow of cause and effect, and most of all, fifty silent lessons for each of us. Each story is not simply a slice of the underworld or the mystery behind death, but also clearly reflects human life on earth: greed - anger - ignorance, love - hate, good - evil are constantly interwoven. I don't know how you feel when you read these last lines, whether you feel a bit shaken, worried, or silent because you see a glimpse of yourself somewhere in each fate that has been recounted. “MISSION OF DIVINENESS” does not stop here. That journey just closed a door to open a new path, deeper, more life-like and closer to each of us.

The next part titled "Yin-yang Junction" will be a different journey, where the boundary between the living and the dead gradually fades, where the stories are no longer too strange or purely horror, but very real, very real, very painful and also very humane. There, each character can be a friend, a relative, or even ourselves in a wrong moment of life. Throughout all parts, the general purpose of the story is not to instill fear, nor to sanctify hell or the underworld. The most important thing is still to remind people to live better, look back at themselves, correct themselves and try to do useful things for life and others. Because hell is not something that just waits for us after we close our eyes and give up. Hell sometimes exists while still alive, in the pangs of conscience, in sleepless nights because of mistakes, in the emptiness of losing the good things you once had.

If you know how to stop at the right time, know how to keep the precepts, correct your body, control your speech and purify your mind, then your current life can completely become a peaceful world. Heaven or hell, after all, starts with the way we think, speak and act every day. An evil word can push others into suffering, but a good word is enough to save a soul in despair. One wrong action can have lifelong consequences, but one turn can also open up a new path. If when reading these stories, some people do not believe, please consider this as an entertaining spiritual book, read to reflect, listen and feel. And if someone finds something useful in it, a detail that touches their inner self, then draw their own lessons. As long as one person lives better after reading, one person knows how to stop before mistakes, then this journey will not be meaningless.

During the compilation process, it is inevitable that there will be shortcomings and limitations in both content and expression. We hope readers will be happy, tolerant and understanding. The journey ahead is still long, and hopefully at the upcoming "Yin-Yang Junction", we will meet again not with fear, but with awareness and kindness.

COMMENTS:
After reading the story of VIRGINITY TRADING, I sat quietly for a long time. Not because of fear, but because we see one thing clearly: in each of us there are times of weakness, times when due to circumstances, pressure, or for some reason we have chosen paths that we can't help but feel sad when looking back on.

This story reminds me that Karma is not something far away or only exists after death. It is present in the small, everyday choices. A word, an action, a decision for "love" or for "money" - all are sowing seeds. And sooner or later, we will be the ones reaping the harvest.

But what warms my heart after every story like this is: it's never too late. Even though they have caused heavy karma, even though they have endured suffering for many years and many lifetimes, the spirits in the book still have the opportunity to let go, have the opportunity to be guided, repented and transformed. That is the power of mindfulness and compassion.

For those of you reading these lines, perhaps you are not someone who has caused great karma like the character in the story. But each of us has times when we make mistakes, times when we hurt others because of selfishness or ignorance. This story is a gentle reminder: stop while you still can. Let's choose a way to live so that when night comes, we can sleep peacefully with a peaceful conscience.

An act of kindness, a sincere apology, a decision to live a good life today - no matter how small - can change the fate of ourselves and those around us for many lifetimes to come. That's what I want to convey after listening to this story.
